event.corvee.options.0.desc.default.context: Event corvee, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Sweat spent where the powerful can see it.

event.corvee.options.0.effects.log.defau.context: Durable event log for corvee, authored option 0, effects.

event.corvee.options.0.label.default.context: Event corvee, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.corvee.options.1.desc.default.context: Event corvee, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Save your strength — if the reeve’s stick stays elsewhere.

event.corvee.options.1.failure.text.defa.context: Event corvee, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The reeve notices, and his stick argues the point.

event.corvee.options.1.label.default.context: Event corvee, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.corvee.options.1.success.text.defa.context: Event corvee, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: You shirk artfully and save your strength.

event.corvee.options.2.desc.default.context: Event corvee, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: A few coins, and the dawn knock is not for you.

event.corvee.options.2.label.default.context: Event corvee, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Bribe the reeve to overlook you.

event.corvee.text.default.context: Event corvee, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The reeve bangs on doors at dawn: {lord} requires labor — hauling stone, mending the mill-race, digging ditches.

event.corvee.title.default.context: Event corvee, title, faith branch default.

event.council_charter.options.0.desc.def.context: Event council_charter, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Yield a little power now, keep the crown and their love.

event.council_charter.options.0.effects..context: Durable event log for council_charter, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Sealed a charter of liberties for the great council.

event.council_charter.options.0.label.de.context: Event council_charter, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.council_charter.options.1.desc.def.context: Event council_charter, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: The crown answers to God, not to its own servants.

event.council_charter.options.1.failure..context: Event council_charter, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The eldest of them picks up the pieces, bows with insulting correctness, and rides home. Within the month, his defiance is armed.

event.council_charter.options.1.label.de.context: Event council_charter, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Tear it up before their faces.

event.council_charter.options.1.success..context: Event council_charter, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: A long, dangerous silence — and then they kneel, one by one. The crown stands alone, and stands supreme. They will remember this.

event.council_charter.text.default.context: Event council_charter, text, faith branch default.

source.text: They come to you together — the whole council, unsmiling, with a parchment already drafted. Extraordinary taxes without consent. Revocations without judgment. They ask — the word "ask" doing heavy work — that the crown bind itself by charter to govern with its great officers, as kings are meant to govern.

event.council_charter.title.default.context: Event council_charter, title, faith branch default.

event.council_demand_office.options.0.de.context: Event council_demand_office, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Better a schemer watched at your board than whispering in his hall.

event.council_demand_office.options.0.la.context: Event council_demand_office, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.council_demand_office.options.1.de.context: Event council_demand_office, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: The crown gives; it is not taken from.

event.council_demand_office.options.1.la.context: Event council_demand_office, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.council_demand_office.text.default.context: Event council_demand_office, text, faith branch default.

source.text: An ambitious vassal makes his case in public, voice carrying: has he not served? Is his house not great? Every eye at court turns to see whether the crown rewards merit — or can be seen to refuse it.

event.council_demand_office.title.defaul.context: Event council_demand_office, title, faith branch default.

event.council_domain_pressure.options.0..context: Event council_domain_pressure, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: No land changes hands here. The existing Governance grant flow remains the only way to name and confirm a recipient.

event.council_domain_pressure.options.0..context: Durable event log for council_domain_pressure, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Ordered the council to prepare an orderly grant.

event.council_domain_pressure.options.0..context: Event council_domain_pressure, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Open the grant rolls and prepare an orderly transfer. ({money:10})

event.council_domain_pressure.options.1..context: Event council_domain_pressure, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: A charter buys patience without pretending that a grant has already occurred.

event.council_domain_pressure.options.1..context: Event council_domain_pressure, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Confirm the county’s customs while you consider.

event.council_domain_pressure.options.2..context: Event council_domain_pressure, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Keep every county for now and let the refusal settle into local resentment.

event.council_domain_pressure.options.2..context: Event council_domain_pressure, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: The crown grants when the crown chooses.

event.council_domain_pressure.text.defau.context: Event council_domain_pressure, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The council returns to the counties held in your own hand. The rolls are too long, the judgments late, and every magnate can count the fiefs the crown has not granted. They recommend that you prepare a county for enfeoffment.

event.council_domain_pressure.title.defa.context: Event council_domain_pressure, title, faith branch default.

source.text: Too Much in the Crown’s Hand

event.council_feud.options.0.desc.defaul.context: Event council_feud, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Justice first; the loser must swallow it.

event.council_feud.options.0.label.defau.context: Event council_feud, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Side with the one in the right.

event.council_feud.options.1.desc.defaul.context: Event council_feud, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

event.council_feud.options.1.failure.tex.context: Event council_feud, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Your mediation convinces each that you favor the other. Masterful.

event.council_feud.options.1.label.defau.context: Event council_feud, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Make them shake hands like children.

event.council_feud.options.1.success.tex.context: Event council_feud, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: You talk them around the table and out the far side of it. They leave laughing — at you, a little, but together.

event.council_feud.text.default.context: Event council_feud, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Two of your great officers have not spoken in a month, and today the quarrel spills onto the council table — an old boundary, an older insult, voices rising. Both look to you. Both will remember who you favored.

event.council_feud.title.default.context: Event council_feud, title, faith branch default.

event.council_flattery.options.0.desc.de.context: Event council_flattery, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Flattery is cheap; let him feel heard.

event.council_flattery.options.0.label.d.context: Event council_flattery, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.council_flattery.options.1.desc.de.context: Event council_flattery, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: A king who feeds sycophants breeds them.

event.council_flattery.options.1.label.d.context: Event council_flattery, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.council_flattery.text.default.context: Event council_flattery, text, faith branch default.

source.text: One of your councillors — all smiles and low bows — waylays you after the sitting with a small gift and large praise: your wisdom, your justice, your very profile on the coinage. He wants something, of course. They always do.

event.council_flattery.title.default.context: Event council_flattery, title, faith branch default.

event.council_gift.options.0.desc.defaul.context: Event council_gift, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Coin is coin, whatever the motive.

event.council_gift.options.0.label.defau.context: Event council_gift, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.council_gift.options.1.desc.defaul.context: Event council_gift, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Some gifts cost more than they pay.

event.council_gift.options.1.label.defau.context: Event council_gift, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.council_gift.text.default.context: Event council_gift, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A devoted councillor sends a casket to your chamber: silver, and a letter protesting — at tedious length — that loyalty like his needs no reward. It is, of course, itemized.

event.council_gift.title.default.context: Event council_gift, title, faith branch default.

event.council_market_charter.options.0.d.context: Event council_market_charter, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Pay for clerks and enforcement; trade grows under rules everyone can read.

event.council_market_charter.options.0.l.context: Event council_market_charter, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.council_market_charter.options.1.d.context: Event council_market_charter, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: The treasury gains at once; the villages pay for the favoritism.

event.council_market_charter.options.1.l.context: Event council_market_charter, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Sell the privilege to the highest guild.

event.council_market_charter.options.2.d.context: Event council_market_charter, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: No charter, no concession, and no agreement over who may collect.

event.council_market_charter.options.2.l.context: Event council_market_charter, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Refuse both petitions and keep the old tolls.

event.council_market_charter.text.defaul.context: Event council_market_charter, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The Treasurer lays two petitions beside the accounts. Guild masters ask for fixed tolls and protected stalls; their rivals offer ready silver for the same privileges without the inconvenient limits. The seal can make either bargain law.

event.council_market_charter.title.defau.context: Event council_market_charter, title, faith branch default.

event.council_muster_burden.options.0.de.context: Event council_muster_burden, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: More spears now; the burden and its duration are written plainly.

event.council_muster_burden.options.0.la.context: Event council_muster_burden, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.council_muster_burden.options.1.de.context: Event council_muster_burden, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Keep the county’s hands at home and accept a smaller host.

event.council_muster_burden.options.1.la.context: Event council_muster_burden, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.council_muster_burden.options.2.de.context: Event council_muster_burden, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Protect the roads feeding the host without another call on the fields.

event.council_muster_burden.options.2.la.context: Event council_muster_burden, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Fund patrols and supply officers instead. ({money:18})

event.council_muster_burden.text.default.context: Event council_muster_burden, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The Constable spreads the muster roll across the board. One more levy from the crown county would stiffen the host, but the Almoner warns that ploughs already stand idle and every extra spear leaves a hungry household.

event.council_muster_burden.title.defaul.context: Event council_muster_burden, title, faith branch default.

event.council_petition.options.0.desc.de.context: Event council_petition, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A bought friend is still a friend.

event.council_petition.options.0.label.d.context: Event council_petition, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.council_petition.options.1.desc.de.context: Event council_petition, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: The treasury is not a tit for officers.

event.council_petition.options.1.label.d.context: Event council_petition, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.council_petition.text.default.context: Event council_petition, text, faith branch default.

source.text: One of the great officers lingers after the business is done: his roof timbers are rotten, his second son needs a company of spears, his cousin’s widow — it hardly matters. Office, he hints, should carry some profit.

event.council_petition.title.default.context: Event council_petition, title, faith branch default.

event.council_sanctuary_claim.options.0..context: Event council_sanctuary_claim, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Honor the sacred claim and write the local levy concession in full.

event.council_sanctuary_claim.options.0..context: Event council_sanctuary_claim, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.council_sanctuary_claim.options.1..context: Event council_sanctuary_claim, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Ready coin for the crown, followed by a toll dispute no seal quite settles.

event.council_sanctuary_claim.options.1..context: Event council_sanctuary_claim, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Tax the immunity and close the argument.

event.council_sanctuary_claim.options.2..context: Event council_sanctuary_claim, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Public relief and guarded roads answer both the Almoner and the market.

event.council_sanctuary_claim.options.2..context: Event council_sanctuary_claim, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Fund alms and patrol the pilgrim roads. ({money:16})

event.council_sanctuary_claim.text.defau.context: Event council_sanctuary_claim, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The {holy} asks the Almoner to confirm the {temple}’s old sanctuary from levy and toll. The Chamberlain calls the claim convenient invention; outside the doors, petitioners wait to learn whether sacred custom still restrains the crown.

event.council_sanctuary_claim.title.defa.context: Event council_sanctuary_claim, title, faith branch default.

event.council_scheme_discovered.options..context: Event council_scheme_discovered, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Let every magnate watch what becomes of plotters.

event.council_scheme_discovered.options..context: Event council_scheme_discovered, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Drag him from the board in disgrace.

event.council_scheme_discovered.options..context: Event council_scheme_discovered, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: A forgiven traitor is a debtor for life. Usually.

event.council_scheme_discovered.options..context: Event council_scheme_discovered, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Show him you know — and spare him.

event.council_scheme_discovered.text.def.context: Event council_scheme_discovered, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Your Chamberlain asks for a private word, and lays it out with a clerk’s calm: letters intercepted, retainers quietly paid, a seat at your board measuring you for a shroud. One of your own great officers weaves against the crown.

event.council_scheme_discovered.title.de.context: Event council_scheme_discovered, title, faith branch default.

event.council_scheme_strikes.options.0.d.context: Event council_scheme_strikes, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Your own agents against his — intrigue answers intrigue.

event.council_scheme_strikes.options.0.f.context: Event council_scheme_strikes, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Your agents find only dead ends and dead witnesses. The whispers grow bolder, and the treasury lighter.

event.council_scheme_strikes.options.0.l.context: Event council_scheme_strikes, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.council_scheme_strikes.options.0.s.context: Event council_scheme_strikes, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: Your agents bring you names, letters, witnesses. The spider sits at your own board — and now the whole court knows it.

event.council_scheme_strikes.options.1.d.context: Event council_scheme_strikes, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: A crown that jumps at shadows looks afraid of everything.

event.council_scheme_strikes.options.1.l.context: Event council_scheme_strikes, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.council_scheme_strikes.text.defaul.context: Event council_scheme_strikes, text, faith branch default.

source.text: It begins with small things: a tax convoy that never arrives, your orders mysteriously delayed, a song about the king’s weakness in the ale-houses of your own capital. Somewhere on your council, ambition has stopped waiting.

event.council_scheme_strikes.title.defau.context: Event council_scheme_strikes, title, faith branch default.

event.council_war_chest.options.0.desc.d.context: Event council_war_chest, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Their coin, their strings — but the war needs both.

event.council_war_chest.options.0.label..context: Event council_war_chest, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.council_war_chest.options.1.desc.d.context: Event council_war_chest, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Independence is bought one refusal at a time.

event.council_war_chest.options.1.label..context: Event council_war_chest, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Refuse: the crown funds its own wars.

event.council_war_chest.text.default.context: Event council_war_chest, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The great officers sit in council on the war: the realm bleeds, they say, and the realm’s silver should bleed with it. They offer a subsidy from their own coffers — for the duration, and not, they make clear, as a precedent. It is absolutely a precedent.

event.council_war_chest.title.default.context: Event council_war_chest, title, faith branch default.

event.council_wise_counsel.options.0.des.context: Event council_wise_counsel, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Good servants should know they are seen.

event.council_wise_counsel.options.0.lab.context: Event council_wise_counsel, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Note it, and them, with favor.

event.council_wise_counsel.text.default.context: Event council_wise_counsel, text, faith branch default.

source.text: For once, the council earns its keep: the Seneschal’s tidy ledgers, the Almoner’s quiet wisdom, a long evening of actual governance. It is almost pleasant. You understand why your grandfather drank.

event.council_wise_counsel.title.default.context: Event council_wise_counsel, title, faith branch default.

event.county_petition.options.0.desc.def.context: Event county_petition, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A neighbor’s fief hangs on the liege’s mood.

event.county_petition.options.0.failure..context: Event county_petition, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: “You ask much,” the liege says coldly, and turns to other petitioners. The courtiers’ smiles follow you out.

event.county_petition.options.0.label.de.context: Event county_petition, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.county_petition.options.0.success..context: Durable event log for county_petition, authored option 0, success.effects.

source.text: Won a neighbor’s fief by petition.

event.county_petition.options.0.success..context: Event county_petition, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: The liege’s jaw tightens at the name. “That fief was wasted on him.” The patent is drawn — {cname} is yours, and the court sees exactly whose star is rising.

event.county_petition.text.default.context: Event county_petition, text, faith branch default.

source.text: You kneel before your liege with a recital of the lord of {cname}’s failures — some real, some invented — and humbly suggest the fief would serve the realm better in your hand.

event.county_petition.title.default.context: Event county_petition, title, faith branch default.

event.court_feast.options.0.desc.default.context: Event court_feast, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: They will talk of this table for years.

event.court_feast.options.0.label.defaul.context: Event court_feast, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.court_feast.options.1.desc.default.context: Event court_feast, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Enough to impress, not enough to beggar.

event.court_feast.options.1.label.defaul.context: Event court_feast, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.court_feast.options.2.desc.default.context: Event court_feast, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: A cheap trick — if no tongue catches it.

event.court_feast.options.2.failure.text.context: Event court_feast, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Everyone notices. “The Watered Cup,” they toast, snickering.

event.court_feast.options.2.label.defaul.context: Event court_feast, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.court_feast.options.2.success.text.context: Event court_feast, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

event.court_feast.options.3.desc.default.context: Event court_feast, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: Sweetened water, if no one tastes the difference.

event.court_feast.options.3.failure.text.context: Event court_feast, authored option 3, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Everyone notices. “The Watered Cup,” they murmur, snickering.

event.court_feast.options.3.label.defaul.context: Event court_feast, authored option 3, label, branch default.

event.court_feast.options.3.success.text.context: Event court_feast, authored option 3, success text, branch default.

event.court_feast.text.default.context: Event court_feast, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Your hall blazes with candles. Neighbors, vassals, and rivals eat your meat and drink your mead — and measure you all the while.

event.court_feast.text.muslim.context: Event court_feast, text, faith branch muslim.

source.text: Your hall blazes with lamps. Neighbors, vassals, and rivals eat your meat and drink your chilled sherbet — and measure you all the while.

event.court_feast.title.default.context: Event court_feast, title, faith branch default.

event.courting_above.options.0.desc.defa.context: Event courting_above, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

event.courting_above.options.0.label.def.context: Event courting_above, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.courting_above.options.1.desc.defa.context: Event courting_above, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Gifts open doors that love alone cannot.

event.courting_above.options.1.label.def.context: Event courting_above, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.courting_above.options.2.desc.defa.context: Event courting_above, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Some heights are not worth the climb.

event.courting_above.options.2.effects.l.context: Durable event log for courting_above, authored option 2, effects.

event.courting_above.options.2.label.def.context: Event courting_above, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.courting_above.text.default.context: Event courting_above, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The kin of {suitor} have taken your measure, and their looks are cold. Fine words at the gate, and behind them the plain question: what business has a {title} with their house?

event.courting_above.title.default.context: Event courting_above, title, faith branch default.

event.crown_precedence.options.0.desc.de.context: Event crown_precedence, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Let records settle what pride cannot.

event.crown_precedence.options.0.failure.context: Event crown_precedence, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Each side produces an older document than the last.

event.crown_precedence.options.0.label.d.context: Event crown_precedence, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.crown_precedence.options.0.success.context: Event crown_precedence, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: A forgotten precedent ends the quarrel cleanly.

event.crown_precedence.options.1.desc.de.context: Event crown_precedence, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: A crown may define the customs it inherits.

event.crown_precedence.options.1.failure.context: Event crown_precedence, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The compromise gives both men a fresh grievance.

event.crown_precedence.options.1.label.d.context: Event crown_precedence, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Create a new order of precedence.

event.crown_precedence.options.1.success.context: Event crown_precedence, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: Both magnates accept a rule that honors each without yielding to either.

event.crown_precedence.options.2.desc.de.context: Event crown_precedence, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Nearness to the throne is yours to grant or deny.

event.crown_precedence.options.2.label.d.context: Event crown_precedence, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.crown_precedence.text.default.context: Event crown_precedence, text, faith branch default.

source.text: At a great ceremony, two magnates claim the place nearest your throne. Genealogy, old privilege, and naked ambition have turned a pace of floor into a contest for the realm to watch.

event.crown_precedence.title.default.context: Event crown_precedence, title, faith branch default.

event.cultural_backlash.options.0.desc.d.context: Event cultural_backlash, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Iron will teach them who rules this hall.

event.cultural_backlash.options.0.failur.context: Event cultural_backlash, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The traditionalists ambush your retainers at the narrows, forcing an ignominious retreat.

event.cultural_backlash.options.0.label..context: Event cultural_backlash, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Put down the traditionalists by force.

event.cultural_backlash.options.0.succes.context: Durable event log for cultural_backlash, authored option 0, success.effects.
Event cultural_backlash, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: Your soldiers disperse the gathering. The rebel leaders are paraded in chains.

event.cultural_backlash.options.1.desc.d.context: Event cultural_backlash, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: A concession to ancestral tradition may calm the county.

event.cultural_backlash.options.1.effect.context: Durable event log for cultural_backlash, authored option 1, effects.

source.text: Conceded traditional rights to quell revolt.

event.cultural_backlash.options.1.label..context: Event cultural_backlash, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.cultural_backlash.text.default.context: Event cultural_backlash, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Armed traditionalists and local headmen assemble in {province}, denouncing foreign customs and demanding you govern by ancestral ways.

event.cultural_backlash.title.default.context: Event cultural_backlash, title, faith branch default.

event.debt_labor_sentence.options.0.desc.context: Event debt_labor_sentence, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: The debt is cleared. Your station does not change.

event.debt_labor_sentence.options.0.effe.context: Durable event log for debt_labor_sentence, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Worked off a debt in the lord’s fields.

event.debt_labor_sentence.options.0.labe.context: Event debt_labor_sentence, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.debt_labor_sentence.options.1.desc.context: Event debt_labor_sentence, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Remain a serf, but carry the debt and default into a new parish.

event.debt_labor_sentence.options.1.effe.context: Durable event log for debt_labor_sentence, authored option 1, effects.

source.text: Fled rather than labor for a debt.

event.debt_labor_sentence.options.1.labe.context: Event debt_labor_sentence, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.debt_labor_sentence.text.default.context: Event debt_labor_sentence, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The bailiffs find nothing more to take. You are already bound to the lord’s land, so the steward adds extraordinary labor in the demesne fields until the creditor’s claim is satisfied.

event.debt_labor_sentence.title.default.context: Event debt_labor_sentence, title, faith branch default.

event.devastation_protection.options.0.d.context: Event devastation_protection, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: His wall, his men, his protection — his serfs. The free days end; the burnings end with them.

event.devastation_protection.options.0.e.context: Durable event log for devastation_protection, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Commended the family to the lord for protection.

event.devastation_protection.options.0.l.context: Event devastation_protection, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Commend the family to the lord.

event.devastation_protection.options.1.d.context: Event devastation_protection, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Better a freehold in ashes than a warm cot in bondage.

event.devastation_protection.options.1.e.context: Durable event log for devastation_protection, authored option 1, effects.

event.devastation_protection.options.1.l.context: Event devastation_protection, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.devastation_protection.text.defaul.context: Event devastation_protection, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The lord’s steward finds you among the ashes and is almost kind: “This will keep happening while the wars last. My lord’s wall is high and his men are many. Bring your household inside it, and no host will touch what is his. All he asks is what every protected man owes: service.” Freedom or safety — the old bargain.

event.devastation_protection.title.defau.context: Event devastation_protection, title, faith branch default.

event.devastation_raiders.options.0.desc.context: Event devastation_raiders, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A night’s work and a bribe for the guide — the household’s wealth waits out the raid in the greenwood.

event.devastation_raiders.options.0.effe.context: Durable event log for devastation_raiders, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Hid the household goods from raiders.

event.devastation_raiders.options.0.labe.context: Event devastation_raiders, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Cart the goods into the woods. ({money:10})

event.devastation_raiders.options.1.desc.context: Event devastation_raiders, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

event.devastation_raiders.options.1.fail.context: Event devastation_raiders, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: They do not pass. What cannot be carried is burned; what cannot be burned is broken.

event.devastation_raiders.options.1.labe.context: Event devastation_raiders, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Trust to luck and locked doors.

event.devastation_raiders.options.1.succ.context: Event devastation_raiders, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: They pass down the valley — close enough to smell the smoke, not close enough to stop. This time.

event.devastation_raiders.text.default.context: Event devastation_raiders, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Smoke on the home road, and the church bell ringing backwards from the next village: a hostile host is living off this land, and your holding lies in its path. They take what burns slowest — grain, beasts, tools — and leave the rest to the crows.

event.devastation_raiders.title.default.context: Event devastation_raiders, title, faith branch default.

event.devoted_friend.options.0.desc.defa.context: Event devoted_friend, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Coin and counsel, from the one who means it.

event.devoted_friend.options.0.label.def.context: Event devoted_friend, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Take the gift, and the warning.

event.devoted_friend.options.1.desc.defa.context: Event devoted_friend, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Pride keeps the ledger clean between friends.

event.devoted_friend.options.1.label.def.context: Event devoted_friend, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.devoted_friend.text.default.context: Event devoted_friend, text, faith branch default.

source.text: {friend} catches you alone at dusk, glancing over a shoulder. “You have enemies, and I hear things. Watch your back — and take this. You would do the same for me.”

event.devoted_friend.title.default.context: Event devoted_friend, title, faith branch default.

event.df_claim_declared.options.0.desc.d.context: Event df_claim_declared, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A heavy purse buys back a quiet name.

event.df_claim_declared.options.0.effect.context: Durable event log for df_claim_declared, authored option 0, effects.

event.df_claim_declared.options.0.label..context: Event df_claim_declared, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.df_claim_declared.options.1.desc.d.context: Event df_claim_declared, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Unravel their witnesses before yours unravel.

event.df_claim_declared.options.1.failur.context: Event df_claim_declared, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Your agent is caught, and talks. Now the claim has a martyr’s righteousness about it — and backers with spears.

event.df_claim_declared.options.1.label..context: Event df_claim_declared, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.df_claim_declared.options.1.succes.context: Durable event log for df_claim_declared, authored option 1, success.effects.
Event df_claim_declared, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: Their bought witness recants, loudly, in the wrong company. The claim collapses into laughter.

event.df_claim_declared.options.2.desc.d.context: Event df_claim_declared, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Shouts unanswered start to sound like truth.

event.df_claim_declared.options.2.label..context: Event df_claim_declared, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.df_claim_declared.text.default.context: Event df_claim_declared, text, faith branch default.

source.text: It is done openly now: {rival} publishes a claim to everything you hold — a worm-eaten genealogy, a bought witness, and promises to every malcontent in the county, with foreign coin behind all of it. Men begin choosing which side to kneel to.

event.df_claim_declared.title.default.context: Event df_claim_declared, title, faith branch default.

event.df_claim_whispers.options.0.desc.d.context: Event df_claim_whispers, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Loyalty, like cattle, can be purchased by the head.

event.df_claim_whispers.options.0.effect.context: Durable event log for df_claim_whispers, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Spent freely to keep the fence-sitters loyal.

event.df_claim_whispers.options.0.label..context: Event df_claim_whispers, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.df_claim_whispers.options.1.desc.d.context: Event df_claim_whispers, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Accuse {rival} openly, and hope the court believes.

event.df_claim_whispers.options.1.failur.context: Event df_claim_whispers, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Your accusation rings hollow — half the court had already dined at {rival}’s table. They smile, and work faster.

event.df_claim_whispers.options.1.label..context: Event df_claim_whispers, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.df_claim_whispers.options.1.succes.context: Event df_claim_whispers, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: You name names before the assembled court, and watch {rival}’s friends find urgent business elsewhere.

event.df_claim_whispers.options.2.desc.d.context: Event df_claim_whispers, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

event.df_claim_whispers.options.2.label..context: Event df_claim_whispers, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.df_claim_whispers.text.default.context: Event df_claim_whispers, text, faith branch default.

source.text: {rival} dines your neighbors, remembers their sons’ names, and asks — always lightly — whether the land might not be better served. A spy in their household brings worse: parchments are being drawn up.

event.df_claim_whispers.title.default.context: Event df_claim_whispers, title, faith branch default.

event.df_conspiracy.options.0.desc.defau.context: Event df_conspiracy, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Terror may find the knife — or blind your friends.

event.df_conspiracy.options.0.failure.te.context: Event df_conspiracy, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: You seize the wrong people, and the true conspirators use the fear — half your servants flee, and the rest dare not warn you now.

event.df_conspiracy.options.0.label.defa.context: Event df_conspiracy, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.df_conspiracy.options.0.success.ef.context: Durable event log for df_conspiracy, authored option 0, success.effects.

event.df_conspiracy.options.0.success.te.context: Event df_conspiracy, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: Three servants taken in the night; one talks. The paid knife flees your hall ahead of the rope, and the silence lifts.

event.df_conspiracy.options.1.desc.defau.context: Event df_conspiracy, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: A season away cools even hot blood.

event.df_conspiracy.options.1.label.defa.context: Event df_conspiracy, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Lie low at a kinsman’s hall. ({money:10})

event.df_conspiracy.options.2.desc.defau.context: Event df_conspiracy, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: The stars have never yet held a shield.

event.df_conspiracy.options.2.label.defa.context: Event df_conspiracy, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.df_conspiracy.text.default.context: Event df_conspiracy, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Your oldest armsman is found in the millrace, drowned in a foot of water — and he could swim. Someone inside your walls is paid. The household eats in silence and watches itself; the net is closing, and you cannot see its ropes.

event.df_conspiracy.title.default.context: Event df_conspiracy, title, faith branch default.

event.df_knife.options.0.desc.default.context: Event df_knife, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Three knives in the dark, and only your own arm.

event.df_knife.options.0.failure.effects.context: Durable event log for df_knife, authored option 0, failure.effects.

source.text: Left for dead; the house was cast down in the night.

event.df_knife.options.0.failure.text.de.context: Event df_knife, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Steel finds you again and again, and the world goes white, then strange. You wake to a physician’s face and impossible news: in the confusion your enemies have taken the seat, the keys, everything but your life.

event.df_knife.options.0.label.default.context: Event df_knife, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.df_knife.options.0.success.effects.context: Durable event log for df_knife, authored option 0, success.effects.

event.df_knife.options.0.success.text.de.context: Event df_knife, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: You take a blade through the arm and give better than you get — two flee, one dies on the floorboards, and the conspiracy dies with him. You rule from a sickbed for a season, but you rule.

event.df_knife.options.1.desc.default.context: Event df_knife, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Throw yourself on the mercy of {god} — and flee.

event.df_knife.options.1.effects.log.def.context: Durable event log for df_knife, authored option 1, effects.

source.text: Fled into sanctuary; the lands were seized behind you.

event.df_knife.options.1.label.default.context: Event df_knife, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.df_knife.text.default.context: Event df_knife, text, faith branch default.

source.text: You wake with a hand over your mouth and steel already moving. There are three of them, and they know the room — someone drew them a map. {god} help you, the guards are not coming.

event.df_knife.title.default.context: Event df_knife, title, faith branch default.

event.df_league.options.0.desc.default.context: Event df_league, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Silver unmakes oaths faster than steel.

event.df_league.options.0.effects.log.de.context: Durable event log for df_league, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Bought off a rising against the house.

event.df_league.options.0.label.default.context: Event df_league, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Buy the ringleaders, one by one. ({money:25})

event.df_league.options.1.desc.default.context: Event df_league, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Strike the night-drill before it becomes an army.

event.df_league.options.1.failure.text.d.context: Event df_league, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: They were ready, and your men come home bloody. Now every fence-sitter knows you can be stood against.

event.df_league.options.1.label.default.context: Event df_league, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.df_league.options.1.success.text.d.context: Event df_league, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: Your men descend on the night-drill. The league scatters into the dark, leaderless and done.

event.df_league.options.2.desc.default.context: Event df_league, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Words in barns become banners in fields.

event.df_league.options.2.label.default.context: Event df_league, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Barns and talk. Let them meet.

event.df_league.text.default.context: Event df_league, text, faith branch default.

source.text: It is no longer songs. Headmen from a dozen villages meet in barns, and a disgraced captain drills them at night. Your bailiff names it plainly: a league, sworn against your house.

event.df_league.title.default.context: Event df_league, title, faith branch default.

event.df_murmurs.options.0.desc.default.context: Event df_murmurs, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A full belly sings no rebel songs.

event.df_murmurs.options.0.label.default.context: Event df_murmurs, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Feast and gift the worst parishes. ({money:15})

event.df_murmurs.options.1.desc.default.context: Event df_murmurs, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Patrols may quiet the songs — or give them a martyr.

event.df_murmurs.options.1.failure.text..context: Event df_murmurs, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: A patrol is stoned, an armsman killed. Now there is a martyr, and the murmurs have a name to gather around.

event.df_murmurs.options.1.label.default.context: Event df_murmurs, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: A show of force on the roads.

event.df_murmurs.options.1.success.text..context: Event df_murmurs, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: Patrols at every ford and fair. The songs quiet — for now.

event.df_murmurs.options.2.desc.default.context: Event df_murmurs, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Neglect is a slow road downhill.

event.df_murmurs.options.2.label.default.context: Event df_murmurs, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.df_murmurs.text.default.context: Event df_murmurs, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The reeves report it carefully, eyes down: the villages are sullen, the tax carts need armed escorts, and an old song about kinder lords is sung again in the taverns of {province}.

event.df_murmurs.title.default.context: Event df_murmurs, title, faith branch default.

event.df_omen.options.0.desc.default.context: Event df_omen, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Watched doors sleep better at night.

event.df_omen.options.0.label.default.context: Event df_omen, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Double the guard, reward the loyal. ({money:15})

event.df_omen.options.1.desc.default.context: Event df_omen, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Catch the poisoner — or teach him your defenses.

event.df_omen.options.1.failure.text.def.context: Event df_omen, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Your trap catches a scullion — innocent, probably. The real agent reports your defenses in detail.

event.df_omen.options.1.label.default.context: Event df_omen, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Set a trap for their agent.

event.df_omen.options.1.success.text.def.context: Event df_omen, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: The poisoner walks into it, and under questioning gives up a name. The knives stop — and {rival} knows that you know.

event.df_omen.options.2.desc.default.context: Event df_omen, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Dead dogs do not cut their own throats.

event.df_omen.options.2.label.default.context: Event df_omen, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.df_omen.text.default.context: Event df_omen, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A dead dog at your threshold, its throat cut. A serving girl who knew your habits, gone in the night. Your spymaster — you pay him well — says the pattern points one way: {rival} is done waiting for you to die naturally.

event.df_omen.title.default.context: Event df_omen, title, faith branch default.

event.df_revolt.options.0.desc.default.context: Event df_revolt, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Everything you hold rides on one field.

event.df_revolt.options.0.failure.effect.context: Durable event log for df_revolt, authored option 0, failure.effects.

source.text: Cast down by a rising of the commons.

event.df_revolt.options.0.failure.text.d.context: Event df_revolt, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Your line breaks — and when it breaks, everything breaks. You ride from the field with a dozen men and the clothes you stand in.

event.df_revolt.options.0.label.default.context: Event df_revolt, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.df_revolt.options.0.success.effect.context: Durable event log for df_revolt, authored option 0, success.effects.

source.text: Crushed the great rising of the commons.

event.df_revolt.options.0.success.text.d.context: Event df_revolt, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: Their harvest-king falls in the first press and the host melts back to its plows. You are merciless in victory, and no one sings that song again.

event.df_revolt.options.1.desc.default.context: Event df_revolt, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Yield the lands and flee abroad with what you can carry.

event.df_revolt.options.1.effects.log.de.context: Durable event log for df_revolt, authored option 1, effects.

source.text: Fled a rising of the commons.

event.df_revolt.options.1.label.default.context: Event df_revolt, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.df_revolt.options.2.desc.default.context: Event df_revolt, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: His swords end it — and his price follows.

event.df_revolt.options.2.effects.log.de.context: Durable event log for df_revolt, authored option 2, effects.

source.text: The liege’s host put down the rising — at a price.

event.df_revolt.options.2.label.default.context: Event df_revolt, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.df_revolt.text.default.context: Event df_revolt, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Fire in the night, from one end of your lands to the other. The league marches under a harvest-king of its own making, and your garrisons yield their towers rather than fight their neighbors. This is no riot — it is a war for your seat.

event.df_revolt.title.default.context: Event df_revolt, title, faith branch default.

event.df_usurp.options.0.desc.default.context: Event df_usurp, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: One battle decides whose name the gate bears.

event.df_usurp.options.0.failure.effects.context: Durable event log for df_usurp, authored option 0, failure.effects.

event.df_usurp.options.0.failure.text.de.context: Event df_usurp, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Your men would not stand — some would not even draw. You watch your own banner come down from the gate tower.

event.df_usurp.options.0.label.default.context: Event df_usurp, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.df_usurp.options.0.success.effects.context: Durable event log for df_usurp, authored option 0, success.effects.

source.text: Destroyed a pretender in open war.

event.df_usurp.options.0.success.text.de.context: Event df_usurp, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: The pretender’s host breaks like rotten wood, and the pretender hangs from the gate they would have entered in triumph.

event.df_usurp.options.1.desc.default.context: Event df_usurp, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Surrender the lands for your lives and your strongboxes.

event.df_usurp.options.1.effects.log.def.context: Durable event log for df_usurp, authored option 1, effects.

source.text: Yielded everything to a rival claimant.

event.df_usurp.options.1.label.default.context: Event df_usurp, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.df_usurp.text.default.context: Event df_usurp, text, faith branch default.

source.text: {rival} has raised a banner, and half the countryside flocks to it — the malcontents, the bought, the bored. Riders in your own colors are seen changing cloaks at the crossroads. There is no more law in this, only spears — or surrender.

event.df_usurp.title.default.context: Event df_usurp, title, faith branch default.

event.diplomacy_alliance_concession.opti.context: Event diplomacy_alliance_concession, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Warm the alliance at a domestic Common Voice cost.

event.diplomacy_alliance_concession.opti.context: Event diplomacy_alliance_concession, authored option 0, label, branch default.
Event diplomacy_alliance_concession, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Diplomacy may preserve both the alliance and domestic support.

event.diplomacy_alliance_concession.opti.context: Event diplomacy_alliance_concession, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Each side hears only what it was denied.

event.diplomacy_alliance_concession.opti.context: Event diplomacy_alliance_concession, authored option 1, label, branch default.
Event diplomacy_alliance_concession, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: Both merchant benches accept the equal charter.

event.diplomacy_alliance_concession.opti.context: Event diplomacy_alliance_concession, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: A deliberate cooling of relations; the generation-bound compact ends cleanly.

event.diplomacy_alliance_concession.opti.context: Event diplomacy_alliance_concession, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: End the alliance before it buys your law.

event.diplomacy_alliance_concession.text.context: Event diplomacy_alliance_concession, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Merchants of {rname} ask privileged access to your harbor and invoke the alliance at every sentence. The concession would please {rulername} and anger domestic traders.

event.diplomacy_alliance_concession.titl.context: Event diplomacy_alliance_concession, title, faith branch default.

event.diplomacy_alliance_subsidy.options.context: Event diplomacy_alliance_subsidy, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Support the relationship without adding an alliance-command system.

event.diplomacy_alliance_subsidy.options.context: Event diplomacy_alliance_subsidy, authored option 0, label, branch default.
Event diplomacy_alliance_subsidy, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Meet part of the request and preserve goodwill.

event.diplomacy_alliance_subsidy.options.context: Event diplomacy_alliance_subsidy, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Send arms worth less than coin. ({money:8})

event.diplomacy_alliance_subsidy.options.context: Event diplomacy_alliance_subsidy, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Keep the treasury and cool the alliance.

event.diplomacy_alliance_subsidy.options.context: Event diplomacy_alliance_subsidy, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Refuse: the oath is defensive, not tributary.

event.diplomacy_alliance_subsidy.text.de.context: Event diplomacy_alliance_subsidy, text, faith branch default.

source.text: {rulername} of {rname} asks for silver to keep frontier companies under arms. The alliance promises defense, not command of your host, and the request is deliberately bounded.

event.diplomacy_alliance_subsidy.title.d.context: Event diplomacy_alliance_subsidy, title, faith branch default.

event.diplomacy_border_arbitration.optio.context: Event diplomacy_border_arbitration, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Coin and patience buy a durable improvement in Standing.

event.diplomacy_border_arbitration.optio.context: Event diplomacy_border_arbitration, authored option 0, label, branch default.
Event diplomacy_border_arbitration, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Trade a little prestige for warmer relations and quiet fields.

event.diplomacy_border_arbitration.optio.context: Event diplomacy_border_arbitration, authored option 1, label, branch default.
Event diplomacy_border_arbitration, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Keep face at home and waste the work of Improve.

event.diplomacy_border_arbitration.optio.context: Event diplomacy_border_arbitration, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.diplomacy_border_arbitration.text..context: Event diplomacy_border_arbitration, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Surveyors from {rname} dispute three old boundary stones and one newer sheep-track. {rulername} offers joint arbitration before armed shepherds make law of their own.

event.diplomacy_border_arbitration.title.context: Event diplomacy_border_arbitration, title, faith branch default.

event.diplomacy_border_riders.options.0..context: Event diplomacy_border_riders, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Repair the incident without pretending it began a lawful war.

event.diplomacy_border_riders.options.0..context: Event diplomacy_border_riders, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Pay restitution and recall the captains. ({money:12})

event.diplomacy_border_riders.options.1..context: Event diplomacy_border_riders, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Intrigue may preserve deniability; failure deepens the provocation.

event.diplomacy_border_riders.options.1..context: Event diplomacy_border_riders, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: A captured rider names your captain and his orders.

event.diplomacy_border_riders.options.1..context: Event diplomacy_border_riders, authored option 1, label, branch default.
Event diplomacy_border_riders, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: The saddlecloth proves common enough to buy in three markets.

event.diplomacy_border_riders.options.2..context: Event diplomacy_border_riders, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Escalate hostility and prestige, but still gain no undeclared war.

event.diplomacy_border_riders.options.2..context: Event diplomacy_border_riders, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Praise the riders before your hall.

event.diplomacy_border_riders.text.defau.context: Event diplomacy_border_riders, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Armed riders cross from your side, scatter a patrol of {rname}, and return before the banners can be named. {rulername} sends the captured saddlecloth as an accusation.

event.diplomacy_border_riders.title.defa.context: Event diplomacy_border_riders, title, faith branch default.

event.diplomacy_disputed_tolls.options.0.context: Event diplomacy_disputed_tolls, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Profit from the dispute while Standing falls.

event.diplomacy_disputed_tolls.options.0.context: Event diplomacy_disputed_tolls, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Keep the toll and the coin.

event.diplomacy_disputed_tolls.options.1.context: Event diplomacy_disputed_tolls, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Reverse course and repair the foreign relationship.

event.diplomacy_disputed_tolls.options.1.context: Event diplomacy_disputed_tolls, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.diplomacy_disputed_tolls.options.2.context: Event diplomacy_disputed_tolls, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Learning may find an old lawful rate both courts can accept.

event.diplomacy_disputed_tolls.options.2.context: Event diplomacy_disputed_tolls, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Every archive contains a different rate.

event.diplomacy_disputed_tolls.options.2.context: Event diplomacy_disputed_tolls, authored option 2, label, branch default.
Event diplomacy_disputed_tolls, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: An old schedule fixes a modest toll and saves both faces.

event.diplomacy_disputed_tolls.text.defa.context: Event diplomacy_disputed_tolls, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Your officers chain the border road and tax carts from {rname} twice. {rulername} calls it theft under a banner; your treasurer calls it revenue.

event.diplomacy_disputed_tolls.title.def.context: Event diplomacy_disputed_tolls, title, faith branch default.

event.diplomacy_insulted_envoy.options.0.context: Event diplomacy_insulted_envoy, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Repair some of the damage your Provoke direction invited.

event.diplomacy_insulted_envoy.options.0.context: Event diplomacy_insulted_envoy, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Apologize and send a cup of silver. ({money:6})

event.diplomacy_insulted_envoy.options.1.context: Event diplomacy_insulted_envoy, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Gain face at court and sharpen hostility.

event.diplomacy_insulted_envoy.options.1.context: Event diplomacy_insulted_envoy, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Confirm that the seat was deliberate.

event.diplomacy_insulted_envoy.options.2.context: Event diplomacy_insulted_envoy, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: A plausible denial may keep both pride and peace.

event.diplomacy_insulted_envoy.options.2.context: Event diplomacy_insulted_envoy, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The marshal produces your written order.

event.diplomacy_insulted_envoy.options.2.context: Event diplomacy_insulted_envoy, authored option 2, label, branch default.
Event diplomacy_insulted_envoy, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: The envoy accepts the dismissal of one careless servant.

event.diplomacy_insulted_envoy.text.defa.context: Event diplomacy_insulted_envoy, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Your marshal seats {rulername}’s envoy below a minor abbot and lets the hall laugh. {rname} demands an apology before the insult becomes policy.

event.diplomacy_insulted_envoy.title.def.context: Event diplomacy_insulted_envoy, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Envoy at the Lower Bench

event.diplomacy_pact_renewal.options.0.d.context: Event diplomacy_pact_renewal, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Extend the existing pact through its authoritative expiry record.

event.diplomacy_pact_renewal.options.0.l.context: Event diplomacy_pact_renewal, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.diplomacy_pact_renewal.options.1.d.context: Event diplomacy_pact_renewal, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: The pact remains valid until its existing end.

event.diplomacy_pact_renewal.options.1.l.context: Event diplomacy_pact_renewal, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Keep the present term and promise nothing.

event.diplomacy_pact_renewal.options.2.d.context: Event diplomacy_pact_renewal, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Deliberately cool relations without creating a war.

event.diplomacy_pact_renewal.options.2.l.context: Event diplomacy_pact_renewal, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.diplomacy_pact_renewal.text.defaul.context: Event diplomacy_pact_renewal, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Envoys from {rname} ask whether today’s peace should outlive the current parchment. Renewal requires another concession, not merely warm prose.

event.diplomacy_pact_renewal.title.defau.context: Event diplomacy_pact_renewal, title, faith branch default.

event.diplomacy_pact_safe_conduct.option.context: Event diplomacy_pact_safe_conduct, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Preserve the pact’s spirit at a domestic cost.

event.diplomacy_pact_safe_conduct.option.context: Event diplomacy_pact_safe_conduct, authored option 0, label, branch default.
Event diplomacy_pact_safe_conduct, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Gain Common Voice and a useful defector while straining the pact.

event.diplomacy_pact_safe_conduct.option.context: Event diplomacy_pact_safe_conduct, authored option 1, label, branch default.
Event diplomacy_pact_safe_conduct, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Avoid the sharpest choice and satisfy neither side.

event.diplomacy_pact_safe_conduct.option.context: Event diplomacy_pact_safe_conduct, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.diplomacy_pact_safe_conduct.text.d.context: Event diplomacy_pact_safe_conduct, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A disgraced officer of {rname} reaches your gate under safe conduct. {rulername} asks that the pact mean enough for you to send the fugitive home unharmed.

event.diplomacy_pact_safe_conduct.title..context: Event diplomacy_pact_safe_conduct, title, faith branch default.

event.diplomacy_safe_conduct.options.0.d.context: Event diplomacy_safe_conduct, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Pay the first claims and make the Improve direction concrete.

event.diplomacy_safe_conduct.options.0.l.context: Event diplomacy_safe_conduct, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.diplomacy_safe_conduct.options.1.d.context: Event diplomacy_safe_conduct, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Diplomacy may make a promise carry without coin.

event.diplomacy_safe_conduct.options.1.f.context: Event diplomacy_safe_conduct, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Without compensation behind it, the seal impresses nobody.

event.diplomacy_safe_conduct.options.1.l.context: Event diplomacy_safe_conduct, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Offer your seal, but no treasury.

event.diplomacy_safe_conduct.options.1.s.context: Event diplomacy_safe_conduct, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: The merchants accept the narrow guarantee, and {rname} matches it.

event.diplomacy_safe_conduct.options.2.d.context: Event diplomacy_safe_conduct, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

event.diplomacy_safe_conduct.options.2.l.context: Event diplomacy_safe_conduct, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Leave merchants to buy their own guards.

event.diplomacy_safe_conduct.text.defaul.context: Event diplomacy_safe_conduct, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Merchants ask you and {rulername} of {rname} to recognize one another’s safe-conducts. Guards, compensation, and honest seals will cost both courts.

event.diplomacy_safe_conduct.title.defau.context: Event diplomacy_safe_conduct, title, faith branch default.

event.diplomacy_succession_compact.optio.context: Event diplomacy_succession_compact, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Use the existing pact record; do not revive an invalid alliance by prose.

event.diplomacy_succession_compact.optio.context: Event diplomacy_succession_compact, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Offer a fresh two-year peace pact. ({money:10})

event.diplomacy_succession_compact.optio.context: Event diplomacy_succession_compact, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Extend only a pact that remains valid in state.

event.diplomacy_succession_compact.optio.context: Event diplomacy_succession_compact, authored option 1, label, branch default.
Event diplomacy_succession_compact, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Acknowledge the new reign without inheriting the old Standing.

event.diplomacy_succession_compact.optio.context: Event diplomacy_succession_compact, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.diplomacy_succession_compact.title.context: Event diplomacy_succession_compact, title, faith branch default.

event.diplomacy_succession_embassy.optio.context: Event diplomacy_succession_embassy, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Buy a strong beginning with the exact new ruler generation.

event.diplomacy_succession_embassy.optio.context: Event diplomacy_succession_embassy, authored option 0, label, branch default.
Event diplomacy_succession_embassy, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Build the new reign’s own Standing with courtesy rather than coin.

event.diplomacy_succession_embassy.optio.context: Event diplomacy_succession_embassy, authored option 1, label, branch default.
Event diplomacy_succession_embassy, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Make no hidden inheritance of the old relationship.

event.diplomacy_succession_embassy.optio.context: Event diplomacy_succession_embassy, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Wait for the new ruler to write first.

event.diplomacy_succession_embassy.text..context: Event diplomacy_succession_embassy, text, faith branch default.

source.text: {rulername} now rules {rname}. The predecessor’s Standing is gone with the predecessor; only regard already earned with this exact person can meet the new seal.

event.diplomacy_succession_embassy.title.context: Event diplomacy_succession_embassy, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A New Hand on the Seal

event.diplomacy_warm_opening.options.0.d.context: Event diplomacy_warm_opening, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Turn goodwill into the existing bounded pact, if your diplomacy carries it.

event.diplomacy_warm_opening.options.0.f.context: Event diplomacy_warm_opening, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The court receives the gifts but avoids the oath.

event.diplomacy_warm_opening.options.0.l.context: Event diplomacy_warm_opening, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.diplomacy_warm_opening.options.0.s.context: Event diplomacy_warm_opening, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: The gifts are received and the oaths exchanged.

event.diplomacy_warm_opening.options.1.d.context: Event diplomacy_warm_opening, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Eligible crowns may use this opening for the existing generation-bound alliance.

event.diplomacy_warm_opening.options.1.f.context: Event diplomacy_warm_opening, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Warm words stop short of a military oath.

event.diplomacy_warm_opening.options.1.l.context: Event diplomacy_warm_opening, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.diplomacy_warm_opening.options.1.s.context: Event diplomacy_warm_opening, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: The crowns pledge mutual defense until either ruler changes.

event.diplomacy_warm_opening.options.2.d.context: Event diplomacy_warm_opening, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Take modest goodwill without adding a compact.

event.diplomacy_warm_opening.options.2.l.context: Event diplomacy_warm_opening, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Ask only for another exchange of envoys.

event.diplomacy_warm_opening.text.defaul.context: Event diplomacy_warm_opening, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Months of patient courtesies have opened a private door at {rname}. {rulername} will hear a concrete proposal while the mood remains warm.

event.diplomacy_warm_opening.title.defau.context: Event diplomacy_warm_opening, title, faith branch default.

event.distraint_seizure.options.0.desc.d.context: Event distraint_seizure, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Let them take what the law says is owed. Hiding goods from a writ costs more than goods.

event.distraint_seizure.options.0.effect.context: Durable event log for distraint_seizure, authored option 0, effects.

event.distraint_seizure.options.0.label..context: Event distraint_seizure, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.distraint_seizure.options.1.desc.d.context: Event distraint_seizure, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Coin, counted out in the mud — and the cart goes home empty.

event.distraint_seizure.options.1.effect.context: Durable event log for distraint_seizure, authored option 1, effects.

source.text: Paid off a called debt on the doorstep.

event.distraint_seizure.options.1.label..context: Event distraint_seizure, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Pay them off on the doorstep.

event.distraint_seizure.options.2.desc.d.context: Event distraint_seizure, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: The law has long arms, but today it has only two porters.

event.distraint_seizure.options.2.failur.context: Event distraint_seizure, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The door gives. So does your lip. They take what the writ allows, and a little dignity besides.

event.distraint_seizure.options.2.label..context: Event distraint_seizure, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Bar the door and dare the writ.

event.distraint_seizure.options.2.succes.context: Event distraint_seizure, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: Shouting, shoving, a slammed door — and they withdraw, vowing to return. You have won a season, no more.

event.distraint_seizure.text.default.context: Event distraint_seizure, text, faith branch default.

source.text: They came at first light with the writ and a cart: the bailiff, two porters, and the reeve to see it done lawfully. What the debt is owed, the household holds — and they mean to carry it away piece by piece.

event.distraint_seizure.title.default.context: Event distraint_seizure, title, faith branch default.

event.distraint_writ.options.0.desc.defa.context: Event distraint_writ, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Every penny, here and now — and the writ burns.

event.distraint_writ.options.0.effects.l.context: Durable event log for distraint_writ, authored option 0, effects.

event.distraint_writ.options.0.label.def.context: Event distraint_writ, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.distraint_writ.options.1.desc.defa.context: Event distraint_writ, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Hand over what will quiet them — a holding, a plot — and keep the rest.

event.distraint_writ.options.1.effects.l.context: Durable event log for distraint_writ, authored option 1, effects.

source.text: Yielded goods toward a called debt.

event.distraint_writ.options.1.label.def.context: Event distraint_writ, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.distraint_writ.options.2.desc.defa.context: Event distraint_writ, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: “Come back after the harvest.” They will — with more men.

event.distraint_writ.options.2.label.def.context: Event distraint_writ, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.distraint_writ.text.default.context: Event distraint_writ, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The creditor has been to the lord’s court, and the court has listened. Two men with a writ wait by your door, patient as stones: the debt is called, every penny of it, and the law of the manor is on their side of it.

event.distraint_writ.title.default.context: Event distraint_writ, title, faith branch default.

event.doubt.options.0.desc.default.context: Event doubt, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Kneel until the kneeling feels true again.

event.doubt.options.0.label.default.context: Event doubt, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.doubt.options.1.desc.default.context: Event doubt, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Live as though the sky is empty.

event.doubt.options.1.label.default.context: Event doubt, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.doubt.options.2.desc.default.context: Event doubt, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

event.doubt.options.2.label.default.context: Event doubt, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Sleep takes you before an answer comes.

event.doubt.text.default.context: Event doubt, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Lying awake, you wonder: does {god} see you at all? Has any of it mattered?

event.doubt.title.default.context: Event doubt, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A Dark Night of the Soul

event.drink_trouble.options.0.desc.defau.context: Event drink_trouble, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Glory or a ditch — the ale decides.

event.drink_trouble.options.0.failure.te.context: Event drink_trouble, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: You wake in a ditch, short a pouch and long a black eye.

event.drink_trouble.options.0.label.defa.context: Event drink_trouble, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.drink_trouble.options.0.success.te.context: Event drink_trouble, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: You crack heads and emerge grinning, a small legend by morning.

event.drink_trouble.options.1.desc.defau.context: Event drink_trouble, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: No songs are sung about the one who leaves early.

event.drink_trouble.options.1.label.defa.context: Event drink_trouble, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.drink_trouble.options.2.desc.defau.context: Event drink_trouble, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: A cool tongue could spare many teeth — including yours.

event.drink_trouble.options.2.failure.te.context: Event drink_trouble, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: A stray fist finds you anyway.

event.drink_trouble.options.2.label.defa.context: Event drink_trouble, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.drink_trouble.options.2.success.te.context: Event drink_trouble, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: Somehow, you turn rage to laughter. Men remember it.

event.drink_trouble.options.3.desc.defau.context: Event drink_trouble, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: End the spectacle with unmistakable authority.

event.drink_trouble.options.3.label.defa.context: Event drink_trouble, authored option 3, label, branch default.

event.drink_trouble.title.default.context: Event drink_trouble, title, faith branch default.

event.family_ambition_request.options.0..context: Event family_ambition_request, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

event.family_ambition_request.options.0..context: Event family_ambition_request, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.family_ambition_request.options.1..context: Event family_ambition_request, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

event.family_ambition_request.options.1..context: Event family_ambition_request, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.family_ambition_request.options.2..context: Event family_ambition_request, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

event.family_ambition_request.options.2..context: Event family_ambition_request, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.famine_relief.options.0.desc.defau.context: Event famine_relief, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

event.famine_relief.options.0.effects.lo.context: Durable event log for famine_relief, authored option 0, effects.

event.famine_relief.options.0.label.defa.context: Event famine_relief, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.famine_relief.options.1.desc.defau.context: Event famine_relief, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

event.famine_relief.options.1.effects.lo.context: Durable event log for famine_relief, authored option 1, effects.

event.famine_relief.options.1.label.defa.context: Event famine_relief, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.famine_relief.options.2.desc.defau.context: Event famine_relief, authored option 2, desc, branch default.
