source.text: Your motion is a quiet one: that the old customs of your home county — the gleaning rights, the mill tolls, the parish feasts — be written and confirmed, so no steward’s whim can tax them away. The commons will hear of whoever speaks for this, and of whoever does not.

event.parliament_local_custom.title.defa.context: Event parliament_local_custom, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A Motion to Confirm Local Custom

event.parliament_local_redress.options.0.context: Event parliament_local_redress, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Compensate the rival claimants, end the toll dispute, and replace it with a measured charter.

event.parliament_local_redress.options.0.context: Durable event log for parliament_local_redress, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Settled the county’s disputed tolls before the estates.

event.parliament_local_redress.options.0.context: Event parliament_local_redress, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.parliament_local_redress.options.1.context: Event parliament_local_redress, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Pay for redress, end the grudge, and bind the judgment by charter.

event.parliament_local_redress.options.1.context: Durable event log for parliament_local_redress, authored option 1, effects.

source.text: Won local redress through the estates.

event.parliament_local_redress.options.1.context: Event parliament_local_redress, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Hear the grievance and confirm the old custom. ({money:10})

event.parliament_local_redress.options.2.context: Event parliament_local_redress, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: The active local consequence remains until another settlement or its natural expiry.

event.parliament_local_redress.options.2.context: Event parliament_local_redress, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.parliament_local_redress.text.defa.context: Event parliament_local_redress, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A delegation from {province} waits while the estates read the petitions. The quarrel is no abstraction now: toll receipts, sworn grievances, and names of households that still remember the last settlement.

event.parliament_local_redress.title.def.context: Event parliament_local_redress, title, faith branch default.

event.parliament_market_charter.options..context: Event parliament_market_charter, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Spend locally, gain the liege’s notice, and put the bargain in writing.

event.parliament_market_charter.options..context: Event parliament_market_charter, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Accept a fair charter and help enforce it. ({money:10})

event.parliament_market_charter.options..context: Event parliament_market_charter, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Put the trade bargain to the benches as a service concession.

event.parliament_market_charter.options..context: Event parliament_market_charter, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The bargain collapses in accusation. Toll collectors return to the roads with rival instructions.

event.parliament_market_charter.options..context: Event parliament_market_charter, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Demand lower aid in return for your support.

event.parliament_market_charter.options..context: Event parliament_market_charter, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: The benches join trade and redress in one settlement. The charter passes, and the liege’s aid falls a step.

event.parliament_market_charter.options..context: Event parliament_market_charter, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: No one yields a right; no trader knows which right will be demanded next.

event.parliament_market_charter.options..context: Event parliament_market_charter, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Reject the charter and keep every old claim alive.

event.parliament_market_charter.text.def.context: Event parliament_market_charter, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Merchants and guild masters crowd the lower end of the hall while {liege}’s officers argue over tolls. A fixed charter would make trade predictable; a failed settlement would leave every bridge and market claiming a different due.

event.parliament_market_charter.title.de.context: Event parliament_market_charter, title, faith branch default.

event.parliament_market_charter_grant.op.context: Event parliament_market_charter_grant, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: The charter is granted under the assembly’s seal. Within the month the first stalls go up by the church door.

event.parliament_market_charter_grant.op.context: Durable event log for parliament_market_charter_grant, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Won a market charter for the home county in the estates.

event.parliament_market_charter_grant.op.context: Event parliament_market_charter_grant, authored option 0, label, branch default.
Event parliament_market_charter_grant, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: The toll-farmers have too many friends on the benches. The charter dies unsealed.

event.parliament_market_charter_grant.op.context: Event parliament_market_charter_grant, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.parliament_market_charter_grant.te.context: Event parliament_market_charter_grant, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Your motion asks {liege}’s grace for a chartered market in your home county: stalls by the church door, tolls honestly taken, building timber bought without a week’s bargaining. The guild men smile; the lords who farm their own tolls do not.

event.parliament_market_charter_grant.ti.context: Event parliament_market_charter_grant, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A Motion for a Market Charter

event.parliament_redress.options.0.desc..context: Event parliament_redress, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: It carries — first by voices, then by a show of hands the steward cannot ignore. The aid falls, and the liege’s courtesy promises nothing good.

event.parliament_redress.options.0.effec.context: Durable event log for parliament_redress, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Won redress of grievances in the estates.

event.parliament_redress.options.0.label.context: Event parliament_redress, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.parliament_redress.options.1.desc..context: Event parliament_redress, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: The hands stay down. Your motion dies in a long silence, and the liege’s smile finds you across the hall.

event.parliament_redress.options.1.label.context: Event parliament_redress, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.parliament_redress.text.default.context: Event parliament_redress, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Your own parchment is read to the assembled lords: a motion for redress of grievances — that the aid exacted by {liege} is heavier than custom allows, and should be lowered. The benches murmur. The liege’s face gives nothing away, which says everything.

event.parliament_redress.title.default.context: Event parliament_redress, title, faith branch default.

event.parliament_revocation_consent.opti.context: Event parliament_revocation_consent, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Against every expectation, it carries. The liege’s steward writes the oath into the roll with a hand that does not shake. Much.

event.parliament_revocation_consent.opti.context: Durable event log for parliament_revocation_consent, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Bound the liege to seek the estates’ consent for new aids.

event.parliament_revocation_consent.opti.context: Event parliament_revocation_consent, authored option 0, label, branch default.
Event parliament_revocation_consent, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Too many benches are owed, bought, or frightened. The motion fails — and the crown now knows exactly who reached for its purse.

event.parliament_revocation_consent.opti.context: Event parliament_revocation_consent, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.parliament_revocation_consent.text.context: Event parliament_revocation_consent, text, faith branch default.

source.text: This is no small parchment. Your motion would bind {liege} by oath: no aid raised, no new exaction laid, without the consent of the assembled estates. The hall has gone very quiet. Every lord here has dreamed of such a law; few have dared to move it.

event.parliament_revocation_consent.titl.context: Event parliament_revocation_consent, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A Motion for the Consent of the Estates

event.parliament_sanctuary_relief.option.context: Event parliament_sanctuary_relief, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A bounded exemption answers the clergy and the county together.

event.parliament_sanctuary_relief.option.context: Event parliament_sanctuary_relief, authored option 0, label, branch default.
Event parliament_sanctuary_relief, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Pay for public relief and the riders who keep it moving.

event.parliament_sanctuary_relief.option.context: Event parliament_sanctuary_relief, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Fund relief and patrol the roads. ({money:16})

event.parliament_sanctuary_relief.option.context: Event parliament_sanctuary_relief, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: The crown is pleased; the county remembers that its petition was refused.

event.parliament_sanctuary_relief.option.context: Event parliament_sanctuary_relief, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Give the liege the service demanded.

event.parliament_sanctuary_relief.text.d.context: Event parliament_sanctuary_relief, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The clergy ask the estates to protect sanctuary and relief in {province}; the liege’s officers answer that every exemption leaves another household to serve. The hall must decide whether legitimacy is bought with spears, silver, or mercy.

event.parliament_sanctuary_relief.title..context: Event parliament_sanctuary_relief, title, faith branch default.

event.parliament_scutage.options.0.desc..context: Event parliament_scutage, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: The motion carries. Henceforth the liege’s summons can be answered with a purse, and the aid creeps up to pay for the privilege.

event.parliament_scutage.options.0.effec.context: Durable event log for parliament_scutage, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Carried a scutage motion in the estates.

event.parliament_scutage.options.0.label.context: Event parliament_scutage, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.parliament_scutage.options.1.desc..context: Event parliament_scutage, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: The war-hungry lords shout it down. The liege looks pleased, and looks at you.

event.parliament_scutage.options.1.label.context: Event parliament_scutage, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.parliament_scutage.text.default.context: Event parliament_scutage, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Your motion before the estates: that the lords of the realm may answer {liege}’s banner call with silver instead of service — scutage, the shield-tax, as the old charters name it. The young lords who love a campaign scoff; the old ones with roofs to mend lean forward.

event.parliament_scutage.title.default.context: Event parliament_scutage, title, faith branch default.

event.parliament_session.options.0.desc..context: Event parliament_session, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A kind word here, a promised favor there — court craft in miniature.

event.parliament_session.options.0.failu.context: Event parliament_session, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: You mistake a proud old lord for a petitioner and compound it with a joke. A few smiles, poorly hidden.

event.parliament_session.options.0.label.context: Event parliament_session, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.parliament_session.options.0.succe.context: Event parliament_session, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: You leave the hall with three new friends and a standing invitation. Your name is warming in the realm.

event.parliament_session.options.1.desc..context: Event parliament_session, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: How the great ones argue, flatter, and threaten — a free education.

event.parliament_session.options.1.label.context: Event parliament_session, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.parliament_session.options.2.desc..context: Event parliament_session, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: The unremarked lord keeps what he has.

event.parliament_session.options.2.label.context: Event parliament_session, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Sit quiet and keep your head down.

event.parliament_session.text.default.context: Event parliament_session, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The lords of the realm gather at {liege}’s summons: petty business mostly — a boundary dispute, a widow’s dower, a reading of old charters — but every bench is a pair of ears, and every recess a market of favors.

event.parliament_session.title.default.context: Event parliament_session, title, faith branch default.

event.parliament_subsidy.options.0.desc..context: Event parliament_subsidy, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: The crown’s gratitude, on the record.

event.parliament_subsidy.options.0.label.context: Event parliament_subsidy, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Vote the subsidy, and give generously. ({money:20})

event.parliament_subsidy.options.1.desc..context: Event parliament_subsidy, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Wars are the lord’s affair — let the lord’s treasure pay for them.

event.parliament_subsidy.options.1.label.context: Event parliament_subsidy, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.parliament_subsidy.text.default.context: Event parliament_subsidy, text, faith branch default.

source.text: War has emptied {liege}’s coffers, and the estates are summoned to refill them: a subsidy, voted lord by lord, “for the defense of the realm.” The steward’s clerk has already written your name on the roll, with a space beside it for a number.

event.parliament_subsidy.title.default.context: Event parliament_subsidy, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A Subsidy for the Liege’s War

event.parliament_war_authorization.optio.context: Event parliament_war_authorization, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: The authorization carries, and your name leads it. The liege’s gratitude is real, and publicly given.

event.parliament_war_authorization.optio.context: Durable event log for parliament_war_authorization, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Carried the authorization of the liege’s war in the estates.

event.parliament_war_authorization.optio.context: Event parliament_war_authorization, authored option 0, label, branch default.
Event parliament_war_authorization, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: The hall will not bless the war. You stood for the crown and the crown watched you fall.

event.parliament_war_authorization.optio.context: Event parliament_war_authorization, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.parliament_war_authorization.text..context: Event parliament_war_authorization, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Your motion asks the estates to say aloud what the crown wants heard: that {liege}’s war is just, necessary, and backed by the assembled lords of the realm. The hawks are already nodding. The older lords are counting their sons.

event.parliament_war_authorization.title.context: Event parliament_war_authorization, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A Motion to Authorize the War

event.parliament_war_condemnation.option.context: Event parliament_war_condemnation, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: The condemnation carries. In the county lanes your name is spoken with something like hope; in the liege’s hall, with something else.

event.parliament_war_condemnation.option.context: Durable event log for parliament_war_condemnation, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Carried a condemnation of the liege’s war in the estates.

event.parliament_war_condemnation.option.context: Event parliament_war_condemnation, authored option 0, label, branch default.
Event parliament_war_condemnation, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: The motion dies, and every lord who feared it now knows exactly who moved it.

event.parliament_war_condemnation.option.context: Event parliament_war_condemnation, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.parliament_war_condemnation.text.d.context: Event parliament_war_condemnation, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Your motion is the dangerous one: that the estates declare {liege}’s war a waste of the realm’s blood and silver, and call for its end. Some lords meet your eye and nod. Others are already composing their report to the crown.

event.parliament_war_condemnation.title..context: Event parliament_war_condemnation, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A Motion to Condemn the War

event.partner_offer.options.0.desc.defau.context: Event partner_offer, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: His markets could pay richly — or swallow your stake.

event.partner_offer.options.0.failure.te.context: Event partner_offer, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The letters stop coming. So does the money.

event.partner_offer.options.0.label.defa.context: Event partner_offer, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.partner_offer.options.0.success.te.context: Event partner_offer, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: His letters prove good as gold. The partnership pays handsomely.

event.partner_offer.options.1.desc.defau.context: Event partner_offer, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: No coin risked; knowledge travels both ways.

event.partner_offer.options.1.label.defa.context: Event partner_offer, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.partner_offer.options.2.desc.defau.context: Event partner_offer, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Suspicious silk is cheap to refuse.

event.partner_offer.options.2.label.defa.context: Event partner_offer, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.partner_offer.text.default.context: Event partner_offer, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A foreign merchant — silk cuffs, careful eyes — proposes a joint venture: your local knowledge, his distant markets.

event.partner_offer.title.default.context: Event partner_offer, title, faith branch default.

event.peasant_revolt.options.0.desc.defa.context: Event peasant_revolt, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Iron ends rebellions — or feeds them martyrs.

event.peasant_revolt.options.0.failure.t.context: Event peasant_revolt, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Pitchforks in the dark defeat proud steel. You flee your own lands for a season, humiliated.

event.peasant_revolt.options.0.label.def.context: Event peasant_revolt, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.peasant_revolt.options.0.success.e.context: Durable event log for peasant_revolt, authored option 0, success.effects.

event.peasant_revolt.options.0.success.t.context: Event peasant_revolt, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: The revolt breaks against your armed men. The Ploughman King hangs at the crossroads.

event.peasant_revolt.options.1.desc.defa.context: Event peasant_revolt, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: A listening lord risks being thought a weak one.

event.peasant_revolt.options.1.failure.t.context: Event peasant_revolt, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: They take patience for weakness and demand more, emboldened.

event.peasant_revolt.options.1.label.def.context: Event peasant_revolt, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.peasant_revolt.options.1.success.e.context: Durable event log for peasant_revolt, authored option 1, success.effects.

event.peasant_revolt.options.1.success.t.context: Event peasant_revolt, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: You remit the worst taxes; the crowd disperses, grudging but calm. Wise lords bend.

event.peasant_revolt.text.default.context: Event peasant_revolt, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Torches in the night. Your taxmen beaten, your granary seized — the peasants of {province} have risen, led by a man they call the Ploughman King.

event.peasant_revolt.title.default.context: Event peasant_revolt, title, faith branch default.

event.peddler_knock.options.0.desc.defau.context: Event peddler_knock, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

event.peddler_knock.options.0.label.defa.context: Event peddler_knock, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.peddler_knock.options.1.desc.defau.context: Event peddler_knock, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Curiosity is cheap; its prizes are not.

event.peddler_knock.options.1.label.defa.context: Event peddler_knock, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.peddler_knock.title.default.context: Event peddler_knock, title, faith branch default.

event.pestilence_arrives.options.0.desc..context: Event pestilence_arrives, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: There is little to do now but bar the door and pray.

event.pestilence_arrives.options.0.effec.context: Durable event log for pestilence_arrives, authored option 0, effects.

event.pestilence_arrives.options.0.label.context: Event pestilence_arrives, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.pestilence_arrives.text.default.context: Event pestilence_arrives, text, faith branch default.

source.text: It came with the traders, they say. First the fever, then the marks, then the bells. The pestilence has reached {province}.

event.pestilence_arrives.text.muslim.context: Event pestilence_arrives, text, faith branch muslim.

source.text: It came with the traders, they say. First the fever, then the marks, then the wailing. The pestilence has reached {province}.

event.pestilence_arrives.text.pagan.context: Event pestilence_arrives, text, faith branch pagan.

source.text: It came with the traders, they say. First the fever, then the marks, then the pyres. The pestilence has reached {province}.

event.pestilence_arrives.title.default.context: Event pestilence_arrives, title, faith branch default.

event.pestilence_ends.options.0.desc.def.context: Event pestilence_ends, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Count the living and begin again.

event.pestilence_ends.options.0.effects..context: Durable event log for pestilence_ends, authored option 0, effects.

event.pestilence_ends.options.0.label.de.context: Event pestilence_ends, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.pestilence_ends.text.default.context: Event pestilence_ends, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A season passes with no new graves. Thin, wary, the survivors of {province} step into the sun and count who remains.

event.pestilence_ends.title.default.context: Event pestilence_ends, title, faith branch default.

event.pestilence_rages.options.0.desc.de.context: Event pestilence_rages, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Hide from the sickness and hope it passes your door.

event.pestilence_rages.options.0.failure.context: Event pestilence_rages, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: It finds a crack. The fever takes you.

event.pestilence_rages.options.0.label.d.context: Event pestilence_rages, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.pestilence_rages.options.0.success.context: Event pestilence_rages, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

event.pestilence_rages.options.1.desc.de.context: Event pestilence_rages, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: The village will remember — if the fever does not claim you too.

event.pestilence_rages.options.1.failure.context: Event pestilence_rages, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The dead share their sickness with the living.

event.pestilence_rages.options.1.label.d.context: Event pestilence_rages, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.pestilence_rages.options.1.success.context: Event pestilence_rages, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: Grim work, holy work. The village will not forget.

event.pestilence_rages.options.2.desc.de.context: Event pestilence_rages, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Somewhere the bells are not ringing. Perhaps.

event.pestilence_rages.options.2.effects.context: Durable event log for pestilence_rages, authored option 2, effects.

event.pestilence_rages.options.2.label.d.context: Event pestilence_rages, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.pestilence_rages.options.3.desc.de.context: Event pestilence_rages, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: Pay, protection, and firm orders can keep the dead from the lanes.

event.pestilence_rages.options.3.label.d.context: Event pestilence_rages, authored option 3, label, branch default.

event.pestilence_rages.options.4.desc.de.context: Event pestilence_rages, authored option 4, desc, branch default.

source.text: Harsh boundaries may save the wider realm.

event.pestilence_rages.options.4.label.d.context: Event pestilence_rages, authored option 4, label, branch default.

source.text: Close the roads and isolate the sick.

event.pestilence_rages.text.default.context: Event pestilence_rages, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Carts in the lanes, lime on the doors. Every family has a grave to dig; some have no one left to dig it.

event.pestilence_rages.title.default.context: Event pestilence_rages, title, faith branch default.

event.physician_book_of_remedies.options.context: Event physician_book_of_remedies, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A durable family work — knowledge no fever can burn.

event.physician_book_of_remedies.options.context: Durable event log for physician_book_of_remedies, authored option 0, effects.
Event physician_book_of_remedies, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Set down the Book of Remedies.

event.physician_book_of_remedies.options.context: Event physician_book_of_remedies, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Knowledge carried is knowledge never borrowed.

event.physician_book_of_remedies.options.context: Event physician_book_of_remedies, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.physician_book_of_remedies.text.de.context: Event physician_book_of_remedies, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Years of fevers, births, wounds, and slow recoveries fill your memory and your margins. A copyist offers to set it all down properly: one book of remedies, written in your hand, that would outlive you.

event.physician_book_of_remedies.title.d.context: Event physician_book_of_remedies, title, faith branch default.

event.physician_noble_patient.options.0..context: Event physician_noble_patient, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A lord’s gratitude is a rich medicine; a lord’s grief is a dangerous one.

event.physician_noble_patient.options.0..context: Event physician_noble_patient, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The child worsens despite everything. {lord} says nothing at all, which is worse than shouting.

event.physician_noble_patient.options.0..context: Event physician_noble_patient, authored option 0, label, branch default.
Durable event log for physician_noble_patient, authored option 0, success.effects.
Event physician_noble_patient, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: You break the fever on the third night with willow-bark and patience. {lord} pays in silver and in memory.

event.physician_noble_patient.options.1..context: Event physician_noble_patient, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Safer for you, if colder for them.

event.physician_noble_patient.options.1..context: Event physician_noble_patient, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.physician_noble_patient.text.defau.context: Event physician_noble_patient, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A rider comes at dusk: {lord}’s own child burns with fever, and the household remedies have failed. “Come,” the rider says. “Whatever you ask — only come.”

event.physician_noble_patient.title.defa.context: Event physician_noble_patient, title, faith branch default.

event.physician_outbreak.options.0.desc..context: Event physician_outbreak, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Your art against the fever, at arm’s length from it.

event.physician_outbreak.options.0.failu.context: Event physician_outbreak, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The fever does not read books. Three days later your own brow burns, and the lane buries its dead without you.

event.physician_outbreak.options.0.label.context: Event physician_outbreak, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Tend the sick in their homes.

event.physician_outbreak.options.0.succe.context: Durable event log for physician_outbreak, authored option 0, success.effects.

source.text: Tended the sick through a fever outbreak.

event.physician_outbreak.options.0.succe.context: Event physician_outbreak, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: Cool cloths, bitter infusions, and clean dressings: more rise from their beds than are carried out. The lane remembers.

event.physician_outbreak.options.1.desc..context: Event physician_outbreak, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Guard the water, keep the sick apart, and keep your distance.

event.physician_outbreak.options.1.label.context: Event physician_outbreak, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.physician_outbreak.options.2.desc..context: Event physician_outbreak, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Bar the door and boil the water at home; the lanes must manage.

event.physician_outbreak.options.2.label.context: Event physician_outbreak, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: See your own household safe first.

event.physician_outbreak.text.default.context: Event physician_outbreak, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A sweating sickness moves through {location} — first the dyer’s house, then the lane behind it. Neighbors bar their doors; the sick call for water. Every eye that knows your craft turns to you.

event.physician_outbreak.title.default.context: Event physician_outbreak, title, faith branch default.

event.player_comes_of_age.options.0.desc.context: Event player_comes_of_age, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

event.player_comes_of_age.options.0.labe.context: Event player_comes_of_age, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.player_comes_of_age.options.1.desc.context: Event player_comes_of_age, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

event.player_comes_of_age.options.1.labe.context: Event player_comes_of_age, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.player_comes_of_age.options.2.desc.context: Event player_comes_of_age, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: A literate mind is a quiet weapon.

event.player_comes_of_age.options.2.labe.context: Event player_comes_of_age, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.player_comes_of_age.options.3.desc.context: Event player_comes_of_age, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: Know men, and you need fear few of them.

event.player_comes_of_age.options.3.labe.context: Event player_comes_of_age, authored option 3, label, branch default.

event.player_comes_of_age.text.default.context: Event player_comes_of_age, text, faith branch default.

source.text: You are sixteen — grown, in the eyes of {god} and the law. No tutor shaped your years, so what has your family’s household taught you best?

event.player_comes_of_age.title.default.context: Event player_comes_of_age, title, faith branch default.

event.player_educated.options.0.desc.def.context: Event player_educated, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: The lessons are yours to spend now.

event.player_educated.options.0.label.de.context: Event player_educated, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: I will do the family proud.

event.player_educated.options.1.desc.def.context: Event player_educated, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: The world is the last and hardest tutor.

event.player_educated.options.1.label.de.context: Event player_educated, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.player_educated.text.default.context: Event player_educated, text, faith branch default.

source.text: You turn sixteen. The years of lessons are over — whatever your teachers drilled into you, for good or ill, is yours to carry now.

event.player_educated.title.default.context: Event player_educated, title, faith branch default.

event.plot_council_counter.options.0.des.context: Event plot_council_counter, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Drive this exact scheming officer from the board if the evidence holds.

event.plot_council_counter.options.0.fai.context: Event plot_council_counter, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The chain breaks at the final witness. {rulername} survives, and every magnate sees the crown reaching without proof.

event.plot_council_counter.options.0.lab.context: Event plot_council_counter, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Expose the scheme before the full Council.

event.plot_council_counter.options.0.suc.context: Event plot_council_counter, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: Seal follows witness follows payment. {rulername} cannot explain the chain, and the chair is emptied in disgrace.

event.plot_council_counter.options.1.des.context: Event plot_council_counter, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Trade leniency for warmer Standing and lower crown authority.

event.plot_council_counter.options.1.lab.context: Event plot_council_counter, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.plot_council_counter.options.2.des.context: Event plot_council_counter, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: A manufactured charge may finish the case, or turn the whole board against the crown.

event.plot_council_counter.options.2.fai.context: Event plot_council_counter, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The ink is too fresh. The true evidence is buried beneath the exposed forgery.

event.plot_council_counter.options.2.lab.context: Event plot_council_counter, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Add one letter that was never written.

event.plot_council_counter.options.2.suc.context: Event plot_council_counter, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: The false link sits neatly among the true ones. Nobody questions the complete chain.

event.plot_council_counter.options.3.des.context: Event plot_council_counter, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: The ordinary Council crisis may still come.

event.plot_council_counter.options.3.lab.context: Event plot_council_counter, authored option 3, label, branch default.

event.plot_council_counter.text.default.context: Event plot_council_counter, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The intercepted letters name {rulername} of {rname}: payments to singers, promises to dissatisfied captains, careful guesses at how long your crown would survive a bad harvest. The evidence is real. How honestly you use it is another question.

event.plot_council_counter.title.default.context: Event plot_council_counter, title, faith branch default.

event.plot_court_whispers.options.0.desc.context: Event plot_court_whispers, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: One whisper, if it lands, reshapes the hall.

event.plot_court_whispers.options.0.fail.context: Event plot_court_whispers, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The whisper is traced back along the chain of mouths — to yours.

event.plot_court_whispers.options.0.labe.context: Event plot_court_whispers, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.plot_court_whispers.options.0.succ.context: Event plot_court_whispers, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: Your obstacle leaves court under a cloud, and his place in the lord’s regard falls quietly to you.

event.plot_court_whispers.options.1.desc.context: Event plot_court_whispers, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Unspoken words can never be traced.

event.plot_court_whispers.options.1.labe.context: Event plot_court_whispers, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.plot_court_whispers.text.default.context: Event plot_court_whispers, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Months of patience have shaped the hall’s opinion the way water shapes stone. One final whisper will finish it.

event.plot_court_whispers.title.default.context: Event plot_court_whispers, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Word in the Right Ear

event.plot_diplomatic_correspondence.opt.context: Event plot_diplomatic_correspondence, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Learn the court’s present posture and move Standing sharply downward when the theft becomes suspected.

event.plot_diplomatic_correspondence.opt.context: Event plot_diplomatic_correspondence, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The wax cracks twice. The returning packet carries proof of the hand that opened it.

event.plot_diplomatic_correspondence.opt.context: Event plot_diplomatic_correspondence, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Keep the letters and use what they reveal.

event.plot_diplomatic_correspondence.opt.context: Event plot_diplomatic_correspondence, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: The seals are remade perfectly. You keep the knowledge; {rulername} keeps only a growing suspicion.

event.plot_diplomatic_correspondence.opt.context: Event plot_diplomatic_correspondence, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Preserve the relationship, warm Standing, and modestly extend an active pact.

event.plot_diplomatic_correspondence.opt.context: Event plot_diplomatic_correspondence, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Return the letters with a private warning.

event.plot_diplomatic_correspondence.opt.context: Event plot_diplomatic_correspondence, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Provoke a border incident and sour Standing without declaring a free war.

event.plot_diplomatic_correspondence.opt.context: Event plot_diplomatic_correspondence, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Insert an insult and send the packet onward.

event.plot_diplomatic_correspondence.opt.context: Event plot_diplomatic_correspondence, authored option 3, desc, branch default.
Event plot_diplomatic_correspondence, authored option 3, label, branch default.

event.plot_diplomatic_correspondence.tex.context: Event plot_diplomatic_correspondence, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Your copyists finish before dawn. The letters of {rulername} of {rname} lie open: border reports, private courtesies, and the language used when courts prepare for peace or test the road to war.

event.plot_diplomatic_correspondence.tit.context: Event plot_diplomatic_correspondence, title, faith branch default.

event.plot_discovered.options.0.desc.def.context: Event plot_discovered, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Cut every thread. The endangered relationship or institution will still remember the smoke.

event.plot_discovered.options.0.label.de.context: Event plot_discovered, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.plot_discovered.options.1.desc.def.context: Event plot_discovered, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Contain this breach, lose some progress, and accept greater discovery risk from now on.

event.plot_discovered.options.1.label.de.context: Event plot_discovered, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Buy the evidence and keep weaving. ({money:15})

event.plot_discovered.options.2.desc.def.context: Event plot_discovered, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Strike half-ready, and pray speed makes up for it.

event.plot_discovered.options.2.failure..context: Event plot_discovered, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Half-ready is not ready. The whole scheme collapses on your head in daylight.

event.plot_discovered.options.2.label.de.context: Event plot_discovered, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.plot_discovered.options.2.success..context: Event plot_discovered, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: Half-ready proves ready enough — barely. What you sought, you seize, and the talkers fall silent.

event.plot_discovered.text.default.context: Event plot_discovered, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Someone has talked. Conversations die when you approach; eyes follow you out of rooms. The plot is known — or nearly.

event.plot_discovered.title.default.context: Event plot_discovered, title, faith branch default.

event.plot_fabricate_claim.options.0.des.context: Event plot_fabricate_claim, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Intrigue, learning, and renown must carry a document older-looking than it is.

event.plot_fabricate_claim.options.0.fai.context: Event plot_fabricate_claim, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: A witness changes his story. The seals are named false, and the charter is torn in open court.

event.plot_fabricate_claim.options.0.lab.context: Event plot_fabricate_claim, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.plot_fabricate_claim.options.0.suc.context: Durable event log for plot_fabricate_claim, authored option 0, success.effects.
Event plot_fabricate_claim, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: The objections tangle and fail. Your right to {cname} is entered into the rolls.

event.plot_fabricate_claim.options.1.des.context: Event plot_fabricate_claim, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Abandon the scheme without testing the lie.

event.plot_fabricate_claim.options.1.lab.context: Event plot_fabricate_claim, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Burn it before anyone reads it.

event.plot_fabricate_claim.text.default.context: Event plot_fabricate_claim, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The ink is dry, the seals are warm, and three well-paid witnesses remember that {cname} belonged to your forebears. Only the final recital before the court remains.

event.plot_fabricate_claim.title.default.context: Event plot_fabricate_claim, title, faith branch default.

event.plot_feudal_obligation.options.0.d.context: Event plot_feudal_obligation, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Success strengthens the next redress vote; failure strengthens the liege’s hand and raises the aid.

event.plot_feudal_obligation.options.0.f.context: Event plot_feudal_obligation, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: A clerk recognizes the copied hand. The rolls are corrected against you, and the liege answers suspicion with a heavier aid.

event.plot_feudal_obligation.options.0.l.context: Event plot_feudal_obligation, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Keep the evidence for a motion of redress.

event.plot_feudal_obligation.options.0.s.context: Event plot_feudal_obligation, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: The copies, witnesses, and seals agree. Hidden safely, they will carry weight when the estates next vote.

event.plot_feudal_obligation.options.1.d.context: Event plot_feudal_obligation, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Reduce the existing aid one step without bypassing the estates permanently; lose coin, prestige, and Standing.

event.plot_feudal_obligation.options.1.l.context: Event plot_feudal_obligation, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.plot_feudal_obligation.options.2.d.context: Event plot_feudal_obligation, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

event.plot_feudal_obligation.options.2.l.context: Event plot_feudal_obligation, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Return every copy to the fire.

event.plot_feudal_obligation.text.defaul.context: Event plot_feudal_obligation, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Your agents have copied the rolls behind {liege}’s aid: double-counted rents, convenient omissions, and one seal impressed on a night its keeper was elsewhere. The evidence could strengthen a later motion, or the rolls could simply change.

event.plot_feudal_obligation.title.defau.context: Event plot_feudal_obligation, title, faith branch default.

event.plot_guild_monopoly.options.0.desc.context: Event plot_guild_monopoly, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: End this exact monopoly, gain Common Voice, and make enemies of those it favored.

event.plot_guild_monopoly.options.0.fail.context: Event plot_guild_monopoly, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: A missing leaf turns proof into insinuation. The charter’s defenders name you a liar.

event.plot_guild_monopoly.options.0.labe.context: Event plot_guild_monopoly, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Publish the accounts and break the charter.

event.plot_guild_monopoly.options.0.succ.context: Event plot_guild_monopoly, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: The figures survive every challenge. The charter is struck down before a jeering hall.

event.plot_guild_monopoly.options.1.desc.context: Event plot_guild_monopoly, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: The monopoly survives. Coin buys your silence, while the public pays the price.

event.plot_guild_monopoly.options.1.labe.context: Event plot_guild_monopoly, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Take compensation and keep the charter.

event.plot_guild_monopoly.options.2.desc.context: Event plot_guild_monopoly, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Preserve the charter and gain guild support at the Common Voice’s expense.

event.plot_guild_monopoly.options.2.labe.context: Event plot_guild_monopoly, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Defend the privilege before the guild.

event.plot_guild_monopoly.options.3.desc.context: Event plot_guild_monopoly, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: Leave the charter and its enemies untouched.

event.plot_guild_monopoly.options.3.labe.context: Event plot_guild_monopoly, authored option 3, label, branch default.

event.plot_guild_monopoly.text.default.context: Event plot_guild_monopoly, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The duplicate accounts are finally in your hands. Fees vanish, weights change after dusk, and the monopoly’s public promises lead to private purses. The charter can be broken, milked, or defended.

event.plot_guild_monopoly.title.default.context: Event plot_guild_monopoly, title, faith branch default.

event.plot_locked_chest.options.0.desc.d.context: Event plot_locked_chest, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: One careful hour against the dog’s memory.

event.plot_locked_chest.options.0.failur.context: Event plot_locked_chest, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The dog remembered its duty after all. You go over the wall torn, and known.

event.plot_locked_chest.options.0.label..context: Event plot_locked_chest, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.plot_locked_chest.options.0.succes.context: Event plot_locked_chest, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: Coin — and a bundle wrapped in wool. Whether it holds anything your family lacks remains to be seen.

event.plot_locked_chest.options.1.desc.d.context: Event plot_locked_chest, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Some chests are best left singing.

event.plot_locked_chest.options.1.label..context: Event plot_locked_chest, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.plot_locked_chest.text.default.context: Event plot_locked_chest, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The household sleeps; the dog knows you now. The chest waits where the steward believes nobody knows.

event.plot_locked_chest.title.default.context: Event plot_locked_chest, title, faith branch default.

event.plot_rival_claimant.options.0.desc.context: Event plot_rival_claimant, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Attack the real political foothold behind the feud.

event.plot_rival_claimant.options.0.fail.context: Event plot_rival_claimant, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The witnesses contradict one another, then name your purse. {rival} leaves with the stronger grievance.

event.plot_rival_claimant.options.0.labe.context: Event plot_rival_claimant, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.plot_rival_claimant.options.0.succ.context: Event plot_rival_claimant, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: Every answer opens another contradiction. {rival}’s political footing gives way before the watching court.

event.plot_rival_claimant.options.1.desc.context: Event plot_rival_claimant, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Spend coin and hard-won leverage to end the feud without inventing another enemy.

event.plot_rival_claimant.options.1.labe.context: Event plot_rival_claimant, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.plot_rival_claimant.options.2.desc.context: Event plot_rival_claimant, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Gain intrigue and public leverage, but drive the rivalry toward its dangerous end.

event.plot_rival_claimant.options.2.labe.context: Event plot_rival_claimant, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Keep the dossier and sharpen the feud.

event.plot_rival_claimant.options.3.desc.context: Event plot_rival_claimant, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: The political opening closes; the feud remains.

event.plot_rival_claimant.options.3.labe.context: Event plot_rival_claimant, authored option 3, label, branch default.

event.plot_rival_claimant.text.default.context: Event plot_rival_claimant, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The witnesses are ready and the papers arranged. What began as a private feud now reaches {rival}’s claim, office, Council seat, or royal connection. One public move could make the quarrel political forever.

event.plot_rival_claimant.title.default.context: Event plot_rival_claimant, title, faith branch default.

event.plot_ruin_rival.options.0.desc.def.context: Event plot_ruin_rival, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: One word, and {rival} falls — if the web holds.

event.plot_ruin_rival.options.0.failure..context: Event plot_ruin_rival, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: A thread snaps — a bought man sells you back. Every neighbor knows whose hand held the knife.

event.plot_ruin_rival.options.0.label.de.context: Event plot_ruin_rival, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.plot_ruin_rival.options.0.success..context: Durable event log for plot_ruin_rival, authored option 0, success.effects.

source.text: Brought a rival low by intrigue.

event.plot_ruin_rival.options.0.success..context: Event plot_ruin_rival, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: Debts, rumors, and old friends turn all at once. {rival} is ruined — everyone suspects you, and no one can prove it.

event.plot_ruin_rival.options.1.desc.def.context: Event plot_ruin_rival, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: A sprung trap can catch the hunter.

event.plot_ruin_rival.options.1.label.de.context: Event plot_ruin_rival, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Let it go. Mercy — or nerves.

event.plot_ruin_rival.text.default.context: Event plot_ruin_rival, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Every thread is in place and {rival} suspects nothing. One word from you and the web draws tight.

event.plot_ruin_rival.title.default.context: Event plot_ruin_rival, title, faith branch default.

event.plot_skim_taxes.options.0.desc.def.context: Event plot_skim_taxes, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: The difference is yours — if no clerk looks twice.

event.plot_skim_taxes.options.0.failure..context: Event plot_skim_taxes, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: An honest clerk — the rarest hazard. The liege’s displeasure arrives with an audit.

event.plot_skim_taxes.options.0.label.de.context: Event plot_skim_taxes, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.plot_skim_taxes.options.0.success..context: Event plot_skim_taxes, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: The liege’s clerks stamp it without a second glance. The difference is yours, this year and after.

event.plot_skim_taxes.options.1.desc.def.context: Event plot_skim_taxes, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

event.plot_skim_taxes.options.1.label.de.context: Event plot_skim_taxes, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.plot_skim_taxes.text.default.context: Event plot_skim_taxes, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The false ledger is perfect — every hide and hearth accounted for, and a fifth of it quietly missing.

event.plot_skim_taxes.title.default.context: Event plot_skim_taxes, title, faith branch default.

event.plot_spouse_end.options.0.desc.def.context: Event plot_spouse_end, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: One nod, and the house mourns on cue.

event.plot_spouse_end.options.0.failure..context: Event plot_spouse_end, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The cup is knocked aside — {spouse} reads your face and knows. What lives in your house now is not a marriage but a watch.

event.plot_spouse_end.options.0.label.de.context: Event plot_spouse_end, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.plot_spouse_end.options.0.success..context: Durable event log for plot_spouse_end, authored option 0, success.effects.
Event plot_spouse_end, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: A sudden illness, the neighbors say. The house mourns, and none mourn louder than you.

event.plot_spouse_end.options.1.desc.def.context: Event plot_spouse_end, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Some doors, once opened, never close.

event.plot_spouse_end.options.1.effects..context: Durable event log for plot_spouse_end, authored option 1, effects.

event.plot_spouse_end.options.1.label.de.context: Event plot_spouse_end, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.plot_spouse_end.text.default.context: Event plot_spouse_end, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Everything is in place: the draught measured, the stair loosened, the witnesses elsewhere. {spouse} suspects nothing. One nod from you and it is done.

event.plot_spouse_end.title.default.context: Event plot_spouse_end, title, faith branch default.

event.plot_tithe_barn.options.0.desc.def.context: Event plot_tithe_barn, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: One night’s nerve against a winter’s hunger.

event.plot_tithe_barn.options.0.failure..context: Event plot_tithe_barn, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: A new watchman, unbought. You run for the trees and leave your good name behind.

event.plot_tithe_barn.options.0.label.de.context: Event plot_tithe_barn, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.plot_tithe_barn.options.0.success..context: Event plot_tithe_barn, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: By dawn the sacks are hidden and the ledger is none the wiser. Winter holds no fear this year.

event.plot_tithe_barn.options.1.desc.def.context: Event plot_tithe_barn, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Stolen bread is never quite free.

event.plot_tithe_barn.options.1.label.de.context: Event plot_tithe_barn, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.plot_tithe_barn.text.default.context: Event plot_tithe_barn, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The watchman is bought, the dogs are fed, and the cart waits in the alder grove. Tonight the lord’s plenty can become yours.

event.plot_tithe_barn.title.default.context: Event plot_tithe_barn, title, faith branch default.

event.poacher_before_bench.options.0.des.context: Event poacher_before_bench, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Mercy without inviting every hunter into the wood.

event.poacher_before_bench.options.0.lab.context: Event poacher_before_bench, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Pardon the hunger, confiscate the bow.

event.poacher_before_bench.options.1.des.context: Event poacher_before_bench, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Let the offense repay the demesne.

event.poacher_before_bench.options.1.lab.context: Event poacher_before_bench, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Set labor in place of the fine.

event.poacher_before_bench.options.2.des.context: Event poacher_before_bench, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: A right unenforced soon ceases to be a right.

event.poacher_before_bench.options.2.lab.context: Event poacher_before_bench, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.poacher_before_bench.text.default.context: Event poacher_before_bench, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A poacher stands before your bench with a thin hare, three hungry children, and a forester demanding the full penalty.

event.poacher_before_bench.title.default.context: Event poacher_before_bench, title, faith branch default.

event.poetry_quarrel.options.0.desc.defa.context: Event poetry_quarrel, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A keen reply could shame him — or you.

event.poetry_quarrel.options.0.failure.t.context: Event poetry_quarrel, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: You stumble on the meter. The laughter is not with you.

event.poetry_quarrel.options.0.label.def.context: Event poetry_quarrel, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Answer with sharper verses of your own.

event.poetry_quarrel.options.0.success.t.context: Event poetry_quarrel, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: Your reply cuts twice as deep. The gathering roars; his shame will outlive him.

event.poetry_quarrel.options.1.desc.defa.context: Event poetry_quarrel, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Some insults die faster than feuds.

event.poetry_quarrel.options.1.label.def.context: Event poetry_quarrel, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Smile and let the verses die.

event.poetry_quarrel.options.2.desc.defa.context: Event poetry_quarrel, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Simpler than verse, and bloodier to lose.

event.poetry_quarrel.options.2.failure.t.context: Event poetry_quarrel, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: His friends pull you apart — after the worst of it.

event.poetry_quarrel.options.2.label.def.context: Event poetry_quarrel, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.poetry_quarrel.options.2.success.t.context: Event poetry_quarrel, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: Poetry has its place; so does a good grip. He recants, wheezing.

event.poetry_quarrel.text.default.context: Event poetry_quarrel, text, faith branch default.

source.text: At the evening majlis a braggart recites verses mocking your family — polished, cruel, and already being repeated with delight.

event.poetry_quarrel.title.default.context: Event poetry_quarrel, title, faith branch default.

event.polly_arms.options.0.desc.default.context: Event polly_arms, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A keen blade close at hand is worth more than the coppers it costs.

event.polly_arms.options.0.label.default.context: Event polly_arms, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Take a good fighting knife from the cart.

event.polly_arms.options.1.desc.default.context: Event polly_arms, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: It will not stop a lance, but it has turned many a tired sword.

event.polly_arms.options.1.label.default.context: Event polly_arms, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Take a padded jack for your back and ribs.

event.polly_arms.options.2.desc.default.context: Event polly_arms, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Coin keeps; borrowed iron does not. Travel light.

event.polly_arms.options.2.label.default.context: Event polly_arms, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Pocket every coin and trust your spear.

event.polly_arms.text.default.context: Event polly_arms, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Before a war is fought it must be paid for. The paymaster counts thin coins into every calloused palm — your first soldier’s wage, earned as a man — and the quartermaster’s cart stands open beside him: dented iron and stiff leather for anyone who came without their own. Kit yourself now; tomorrow the column turns toward the enemy.

event.polly_arms.title.default.context: Event polly_arms, title, faith branch default.

event.polly_battle.options.0.desc.defaul.context: Event polly_battle, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Glory and grave both live in the shield-wall. Stand.

event.polly_battle.options.0.failure.tex.context: Event polly_battle, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The wall buckles where you least expect it. A blow you never see punches the wind and the sense clean out of you, and the rout washes over you like cold black water.

event.polly_battle.options.0.label.defau.context: Event polly_battle, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Set your feet and hold the line.

event.polly_battle.options.0.success.eff.context: Durable event log for polly_battle, authored option 0, success.effects.

event.polly_battle.options.0.success.tex.context: Event polly_battle, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: The world shrinks to the man in front of you — and then he is down, and their wall breaks and runs, and you are alive, shaking, splashed to the elbow, and alive. The field and its dead lie open for the looting.

event.polly_battle.options.1.desc.defaul.context: Event polly_battle, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: If you fall, fall at his shoulder. Reckless — and human.

event.polly_battle.options.1.failure.tex.context: Event polly_battle, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: You never reach him. The line folds first, and a spear-butt or a boot-heel — you will never know which — drops you into the churned mud as the rout howls past overhead.

event.polly_battle.options.1.label.defau.context: Event polly_battle, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Fight your way along the line to {suitor}.

event.polly_battle.options.1.success.eff.context: Durable event log for polly_battle, authored option 1, success.effects.

source.text: Cut her way to her beloved’s shoulder and held.

event.polly_battle.options.1.success.tex.context: Event polly_battle, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: You carve sideways through the press and plant yourself at his shoulder, a nameless recruit who fights like something loosed from a cage. Back to back you hold until the enemy breaks — and he stares at you as a man stares at a face he half-remembers from a dream.

event.polly_battle.text.default.context: Event polly_battle, text, faith branch default.

source.text: It is nothing like the drill-yard. The line locks shield to shield, the horns wail, and across a hundred paces of trampled barley the enemy comes on like a grey tide. Somewhere down the wall is {suitor}, white-knuckled on his spear. There is no hiding left now — only the wall, and whether you hold your span of it.

event.polly_battle.title.default.context: Event polly_battle, title, faith branch default.

event.polly_drill.options.0.desc.default.context: Event polly_drill, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Sweat now, live later — and grow strong enough to matter.

event.polly_drill.options.0.label.defaul.context: Event polly_drill, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.polly_drill.options.1.desc.default.context: Event polly_drill, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Bathe alone, sleep in your shirt, trust no one. Caution over glory.

event.polly_drill.options.1.label.defaul.context: Event polly_drill, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Guard the secret above all else.

event.polly_drill.options.2.desc.default.context: Event polly_drill, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Comrades who love you look less closely at you.

event.polly_drill.options.2.failure.text.context: Event polly_drill, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: You fumble a verse every farm boy has known since the cradle, and a one-eyed veteran squints at you a beat too long before he lets it pass.

event.polly_drill.options.2.label.defaul.context: Event polly_drill, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Win the men with a wineskin and a song.

event.polly_drill.options.2.success.text.context: Event polly_drill, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: You stand a round with your last coppers and bawl the filthy marching songs louder than any. They call you a good lad and mean it — and a good lad is never questioned.

event.polly_drill.text.default.context: Event polly_drill, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Days blur into blisters and bruises. The serjeant’s stick finds every dropped shield, and the men wash and boast and sprawl with no thought for the slight recruit who always slips off alone. Your arms harden; the spear stops feeling like a stranger in your hands. And once, across the cook-fire, {suitor} passes you the bread without a second glance — and your treacherous heart nearly betrays you where the serjeant’s eye never could.

event.polly_drill.text.muslim.context: Event polly_drill, text, faith branch muslim.

Your arms harden; the spear stops feeling like a stranger in your hands. And once, across the cook-fire, {suitor} passes you the bread without a second glance — and your treacherous heart nearly betrays you where that hard old eye never could.

event.polly_drill.title.default.context: Event polly_drill, title, faith branch default.

event.polly_enlist.options.0.desc.defaul.context: Event polly_enlist, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Because now it does. Hard drill, and no one looking too closely.

event.polly_enlist.options.0.effects.log.context: Durable event log for polly_enlist, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Took a man’s name in the ranks.

event.polly_enlist.options.0.label.defau.context: Event polly_enlist, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Learn the spear as if your life depends on it.

event.polly_enlist.options.1.desc.defaul.context: Event polly_enlist, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Learn by watching; draw no eyes to a jaw too smooth.

event.polly_enlist.options.1.label.defau.context: Event polly_enlist, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Keep to the edges and copy the veterans.

event.polly_enlist.text.default.context: Event polly_enlist, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The shears bite; your braid coils on the barn floor and you are someone else. Chest bound flat under a dead brother’s shirt, voice pitched low, a man’s name ready on your tongue, you fall in at the tail of the column. Ahead in the ranks — close enough to see, too close to be safe — marches {suitor}, who does not know you from any other raw recruit.

event.polly_enlist.title.default.context: Event polly_enlist, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A Braid on the Barn Floor

event.polly_farewell.options.0.desc.defa.context: Event polly_farewell, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Bind your chest, take a man’s name, and march. Madness — or the only road left.

event.polly_farewell.options.0.effects.l.context: Durable event log for polly_farewell, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Cut off her braid and followed the muster to war.

event.polly_farewell.options.0.label.def.context: Event polly_farewell, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Cut your hair and follow him to war.

event.polly_farewell.options.1.desc.defa.context: Event polly_farewell, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Some things are not to be. Swallow it, and stay who you are.

event.polly_farewell.options.1.label.def.context: Event polly_farewell, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Watch the dust settle, and let him go.

event.polly_farewell.text.default.context: Event polly_farewell, text, faith branch default.

source.text: There is a young man of the next holding — quick to laugh, quicker to blush — and you had half a mind to make him yours. But the war has swallowed the season: the lord’s serjeants are taking every unwed man who can hold a spear, and this morning he stands in the muster line with a borrowed shield on his arm and no notion that you exist. By dusk the company will be a smudge of dust on the war road, and him with it. A woman does not follow an army. Everyone knows that.

event.polly_farewell.text.muslim.context: Event polly_farewell, text, faith branch muslim.

source.text: There is a young man of the next quarter — quick to laugh, quicker to blush — and you had half a mind to make him yours. But the war has swallowed the season: the amir’s men are calling up every unwed youth who can level a spear, and this morning he stands in the muster with a borrowed shield on his arm and no notion that you exist. By dusk the column will be a smudge of dust on the war-road, and him with it. A woman does not ride with an army, they say — but they have not read the old tales as closely as you have.

event.polly_farewell.text.pagan.context: Event polly_farewell, text, faith branch pagan.

source.text: There is a young man of the next steading — quick to laugh, quicker to blush — and you had half a mind to make him yours. But the war has swallowed the season: the chief’s men are taking every unwed lad who can hold a spear, and this morning he stands in the muster with a borrowed shield on his arm and no notion that you exist. By dusk the war-band will be a smudge of dust on the road, and him with it. They will say a woman has no place in the shield-ring. The old songs, which you know by heart, say otherwise.

event.polly_farewell.title.default.context: Event polly_farewell, title, faith branch default.

event.polly_propose_war.options.0.desc.d.context: Event polly_propose_war, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: If he cannot be given to you, go and take your place at his side — in a man’s clothes.

event.polly_propose_war.options.0.effect.context: Durable event log for polly_propose_war, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Cut off her braid and followed her intended to war.

event.polly_propose_war.options.0.label..context: Event polly_propose_war, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Cut your hair and follow him to war.

event.polly_propose_war.options.1.desc.d.context: Event polly_propose_war, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Keep the hearth, keep the faith, and pray the war gives him back to ask again.

event.polly_propose_war.options.1.label..context: Event polly_propose_war, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Let him march, and wait for his return.

event.polly_propose_war.text.default.context: Event polly_propose_war, text, faith branch default.

source.text: You have chosen your moment and rehearsed your words; today you mean to ask {suitor} for a life together. But the war reaches your door first. Even as you square your shoulders to speak, the lord’s serjeants are working down the lane — and {suitor}’s name is among those called, every unwed man who can hold a spear. There will be no answer today: only a borrowed shield thrust into his arms, and dust on the war road by dusk.

event.polly_propose_war.text.muslim.context: Event polly_propose_war, text, faith branch muslim.

event.polly_reunion.options.0.desc.defau.context: Event polly_reunion, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Wed him, and let the whole muddy camp make of it what it will.

event.polly_reunion.options.0.effects.lo.context: Durable event log for polly_reunion, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Wed the soldier she followed to war.

event.polly_reunion.options.0.label.defa.context: Event polly_reunion, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Take his hand — you did not cross a war to lose him now.

event.polly_reunion.options.1.desc.defau.context: Event polly_reunion, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Spurn him grandly. You have outgrown the blushing boy from the muster line.

event.polly_reunion.options.1.effects.lo.context: Durable event log for polly_reunion, authored option 1, effects.

source.text: Spurned her sweetheart and marched home her own woman.

event.polly_reunion.options.1.label.defa.context: Event polly_reunion, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: “I crossed a war to find you — and found I like myself better.”

event.polly_reunion.options.2.desc.defau.context: Event polly_reunion, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Let him wonder to his grave who that soldier was. Keep the tale for yourself.

event.polly_reunion.options.2.effects.lo.context: Durable event log for polly_reunion, authored option 2, effects.

source.text: Vanished from the field a stranger, and went home to her own life.

event.polly_reunion.options.2.label.defa.context: Event polly_reunion, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Pull the helm back on and slip away a stranger.

event.polly_reunion.text.default.context: Event polly_reunion, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The fighting is done and the crows have come down to their work. Battered or triumphant, you find {suitor} among the living — and when you drag the helm off your cropped head and speak in your own true voice at last, he goes white, then red, then utterly and gratifyingly speechless. A year of blisters and terror and midnight fear, all for this face gaping at you like a fish just landed.

event.polly_reunion.text.muslim.context: Event polly_reunion, text, faith branch muslim.

source.text: The fighting is done and the carrion birds have come down to their work. Battered or triumphant, you find {suitor} among the living — and when you drag the helm off your cropped head and speak in your own true voice at last, he goes white, then red, then utterly and gratifyingly speechless. A year of blisters and terror and midnight fear, all for this face gaping at you like a fish just landed. Let the poets make of it what they will; they have sung of stranger women under armor.

event.polly_reunion.text.pagan.context: Event polly_reunion, text, faith branch pagan.

source.text: The fighting is done and the ravens have come down to their work. Battered or triumphant, you find {suitor} among the living — and when you drag the helm off your cropped head and speak in your own true voice at last, he goes white, then red, then utterly and gratifyingly speechless. A year of blisters and terror and midnight fear, all for this face gaping at you like a fish just landed. Let them keep their talk of a woman’s place; the skalds will know where you stood.

event.polly_reunion.title.default.context: Event polly_reunion, title, faith branch default.

event.prison_ransom.options.0.desc.defau.context: Event prison_ransom, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Silver buys the key — the price scales with your dignity.

event.prison_ransom.options.0.effects.lo.context: Durable event log for prison_ransom, authored option 0, effects.

event.prison_ransom.options.0.label.defa.context: Event prison_ransom, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.prison_ransom.options.1.desc.defau.context: Event prison_ransom, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: A border county signs the ransom roll. The war, mark you, goes on.

event.prison_ransom.options.1.effects.lo.context: Durable event log for prison_ransom, authored option 1, effects.

event.prison_ransom.options.1.label.defa.context: Event prison_ransom, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.prison_ransom.options.2.desc.defau.context: Event prison_ransom, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Let them wait. Gaolers can be bribed, wars end, and chains are mortal things.

event.prison_ransom.options.2.effects.lo.context: Durable event log for prison_ransom, authored option 2, effects.

event.prison_ransom.options.2.label.defa.context: Event prison_ransom, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.prison_ransom.text.default.context: Event prison_ransom, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A courteous letter and a heavy chain: {enemy} names the price of your freedom, and will wait — comfortably — while your household counts its silver. A prisoner of rank is an asset, and an asset can wait for its market.

event.prison_ransom.title.default.context: Event prison_ransom, title, faith branch default.

event.proposal_made.options.0.desc.defau.context: Event proposal_made, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Your standing and your silver are on the scales now.

event.proposal_made.options.0.failure.te.context: Event proposal_made, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The family refuses — politely, but firmly. Perhaps with more standing, or more silver…

event.proposal_made.options.0.label.defa.context: Event proposal_made, authored option 0, label, branch default.
