event.proposal_made.text.default.context: Event proposal_made, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Families gather, terms are weighed — your standing, your prospects, the size of your purse. You ask for the hand of {suitor}.

event.proposal_made.title.default.context: Event proposal_made, title, faith branch default.

event.quiet_garrison.options.0.desc.defa.context: Event quiet_garrison, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

event.quiet_garrison.options.0.label.def.context: Event quiet_garrison, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.quiet_garrison.options.1.desc.defa.context: Event quiet_garrison, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Dull roads, and pay that mostly arrives.

event.quiet_garrison.options.1.failure.t.context: Event quiet_garrison, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The caravan master pays late and short.

event.quiet_garrison.options.1.label.def.context: Event quiet_garrison, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Hire out as a caravan guard.

event.quiet_garrison.options.1.success.t.context: Event quiet_garrison, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

event.quiet_garrison.options.2.desc.defa.context: Event quiet_garrison, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Friendship with the man who counts the loaves.

event.quiet_garrison.options.2.label.def.context: Event quiet_garrison, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.quiet_garrison.text.default.context: Event quiet_garrison, text, faith branch default.

source.text: No war, no drills worth the name — just walls, weather, and wages. A soldier’s enemy in peacetime is the calendar.

event.quiet_garrison.title.default.context: Event quiet_garrison, title, faith branch default.

event.raiders_come.options.0.desc.defaul.context: Event raiders_come, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Better a lighter purse than a shallow grave.

event.raiders_come.options.0.effects.log.context: Durable event log for raiders_come, authored option 0, effects.

event.raiders_come.options.0.label.defau.context: Event raiders_come, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Flee to the woods with what you can carry.

event.raiders_come.options.1.desc.defaul.context: Event raiders_come, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Glory if the line holds; a wound and ashes if it breaks.

event.raiders_come.options.1.failure.tex.context: Event raiders_come, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The line breaks in moments. You wake wounded among the ashes.

event.raiders_come.options.1.label.defau.context: Event raiders_come, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Stand with the levy at the bridge.

event.raiders_come.options.1.success.eff.context: Durable event log for raiders_come, authored option 1, success.effects.

event.raiders_come.options.1.success.tex.context: Event raiders_come, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: Against all odds the bridge holds. The raiders take their dead and go. You are a hero.

event.raiders_come.options.2.desc.defaul.context: Event raiders_come, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: {god} may shield the altar — or the raiders may look there first.

event.raiders_come.options.2.failure.tex.context: Event raiders_come, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The church is exactly where they went first.

event.raiders_come.options.2.label.defau.context: Event raiders_come, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Hide in the church and pray.

event.raiders_come.options.2.success.tex.context: Event raiders_come, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: The raiders, laden elsewhere, pass the church by. A miracle, plainly.

event.raiders_come.text.default.context: Event raiders_come, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Dragon-prowed ships ground on the shingle and armed men pour out, moving with terrible practice toward the village and its church.

event.raiders_come.title.default.context: Event raiders_come, title, faith branch default.

event.realm_policy_persecution_unrest.op.context: Event realm_policy_persecution_unrest, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Fines and examples fill the treasury and empty the streets. The persecuted will remember.

event.realm_policy_persecution_unrest.op.context: Durable event log for realm_policy_persecution_unrest, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Fined and harried a minority congregation.

event.realm_policy_persecution_unrest.op.context: Event realm_policy_persecution_unrest, authored option 0, label, branch default.
Event realm_policy_persecution_unrest, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Protection costs clerical goodwill, but the square goes home unbloodied.

event.realm_policy_persecution_unrest.op.context: Durable event log for realm_policy_persecution_unrest, authored option 1, effects.
Event realm_policy_persecution_unrest, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.realm_policy_persecution_unrest.te.context: Event realm_policy_persecution_unrest, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Word comes from a minority parish: your informers named a gathering, the sheriff’s men broke the doors, and the prayer-house burned with its scrolls inside. The survivors stand silent in the market square, and every hand in the crowd is watching yours.

event.realm_policy_persecution_unrest.ti.context: Event realm_policy_persecution_unrest, title, faith branch default.

event.realm_policy_refugees_shelter.opti.context: Event realm_policy_refugees_shelter, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Feed and settle them; the letter of your protection becomes fact.

event.realm_policy_refugees_shelter.opti.context: Durable event log for realm_policy_refugees_shelter, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Sheltered faith refugees under the charter.

event.realm_policy_refugees_shelter.opti.context: Event realm_policy_refugees_shelter, authored option 0, label, branch default.
Event realm_policy_refugees_shelter, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Their own lord’s problem remains his own; your neighbors note the charter’s worth.

event.realm_policy_refugees_shelter.opti.context: Durable event log for realm_policy_refugees_shelter, authored option 1, effects.

source.text: Turned faith refugees back at the border.

event.realm_policy_refugees_shelter.opti.context: Event realm_policy_refugees_shelter, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Turn them back at the border.

event.realm_policy_refugees_shelter.text.context: Event realm_policy_refugees_shelter, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A ragged column reaches your seat: families of another faith, burned out by a harder lord across the border, who have heard that your written protection holds. Their priests carry what books they saved. The foreign court that expelled them is watching what your charter is worth.

event.realm_policy_refugees_shelter.titl.context: Event realm_policy_refugees_shelter, title, faith branch default.

event.realm_policy_settlers_arrive.optio.context: Event realm_policy_settlers_arrive, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Coin for seed and timber; new fields answer within the year.

event.realm_policy_settlers_arrive.optio.context: Durable event log for realm_policy_settlers_arrive, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Settled newcomers on the waste plots.

event.realm_policy_settlers_arrive.optio.context: Event realm_policy_settlers_arrive, authored option 0, label, branch default.
Event realm_policy_settlers_arrive, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: A fee for the license, and the learned among them copy and teach.

event.realm_policy_settlers_arrive.optio.context: Durable event log for realm_policy_settlers_arrive, authored option 1, effects.
Event realm_policy_settlers_arrive, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Take their surety and put the specialists to work.

event.realm_policy_settlers_arrive.optio.context: Event realm_policy_settlers_arrive, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: The villages approve; the roads learn to pass you by.

event.realm_policy_settlers_arrive.optio.context: Durable event log for realm_policy_settlers_arrive, authored option 2, effects.

source.text: Turned newcomers away at the boundary stones.

event.realm_policy_settlers_arrive.optio.context: Event realm_policy_settlers_arrive, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.realm_policy_settlers_arrive.text..context: Event realm_policy_settlers_arrive, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Drawn by your posted protections, a train of newcomers asks leave to settle: ditchers and thatchers, a lettered physician, and a merchant family with their weights and bales. Their ways are not wholly your ways, and the older villagers are counting heads.

event.realm_policy_settlers_arrive.title.context: Event realm_policy_settlers_arrive, title, faith branch default.

event.recovery.options.0.desc.default.context: Event recovery, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: The world kept turning without you.

event.recovery.options.0.label.default.context: Event recovery, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.recovery.text.default.context: Event recovery, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Strength returns to your limbs at last. The sickness has run its course.

event.recovery.title.default.context: Event recovery, title, faith branch default.

event.reeve_false_ledgers.options.0.desc.context: Event reeve_false_ledgers, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Patient figures may find where the coin vanished.

event.reeve_false_ledgers.options.0.fail.context: Event reeve_false_ledgers, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The figures multiply until suspicion outruns proof.

event.reeve_false_ledgers.options.0.labe.context: Event reeve_false_ledgers, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.reeve_false_ledgers.options.0.succ.context: Event reeve_false_ledgers, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: A trail of small omissions leads to one very comfortable reeve.

event.reeve_false_ledgers.options.1.desc.context: Event reeve_false_ledgers, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Truth may be worth more than punishment.

event.reeve_false_ledgers.options.1.fail.context: Event reeve_false_ledgers, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: He mistakes mercy for weakness and denies everything.

event.reeve_false_ledgers.options.1.labe.context: Event reeve_false_ledgers, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Offer mercy for a full confession.

event.reeve_false_ledgers.options.1.succ.context: Event reeve_false_ledgers, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: The reeve names every partner and returns what remains.

event.reeve_false_ledgers.options.2.desc.context: Event reeve_false_ledgers, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: End the loss and deny the court its entertainment.

event.reeve_false_ledgers.options.2.labe.context: Event reeve_false_ledgers, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.reeve_false_ledgers.text.default.context: Event reeve_false_ledgers, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Two copies of the reeve’s seasonal tally reach your table. They agree upon every rent except the silver that should have reached your chest.

event.reeve_false_ledgers.title.default.context: Event reeve_false_ledgers, title, faith branch default.

event.relic_found.options.0.desc.default.context: Event relic_found, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Pilgrims and silver — unless the bishop counts sheep bones.

event.relic_found.options.0.failure.text.context: Event relic_found, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The bishop’s examiner declares them sheep bones. Humiliation.

event.relic_found.options.0.label.defaul.context: Event relic_found, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.relic_found.options.0.success.effe.context: Durable event log for relic_found, authored option 0, success.effects.

event.relic_found.options.0.success.text.context: Event relic_found, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: Miracles are soon reported. Pilgrims flood in, and the house prospers — as do you.

event.relic_found.options.1.desc.default.context: Event relic_found, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: No profit, but a clear conscience.

event.relic_found.options.1.label.defaul.context: Event relic_found, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Bury them again with honest prayers.

event.relic_found.text.default.context: Event relic_found, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Workmen shoring the crypt uncover an ancient coffer: bones, a rusted ring, a scrap of cloth. The prior’s eyes gleam. Relics draw pilgrims — and pilgrims draw silver.

event.relic_found.title.default.context: Event relic_found, title, faith branch default.

event.retinue_at_door.options.0.desc.def.context: Event retinue_at_door, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A full table buys the captain’s goodwill.

event.retinue_at_door.options.0.label.de.context: Event retinue_at_door, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.retinue_at_door.options.1.desc.def.context: Event retinue_at_door, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Earn from the war instead of feeding it.

event.retinue_at_door.options.1.failure..context: Event retinue_at_door, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: A hasty repair fails inspection. They take food in place of payment.

event.retinue_at_door.options.1.label.de.context: Event retinue_at_door, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.retinue_at_door.options.1.success..context: Event retinue_at_door, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: Straps, rivets, and wheels leave sounder than they arrived.

event.retinue_at_door.options.2.desc.def.context: Event retinue_at_door, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: News is worth a meal — if the tales are true.

event.retinue_at_door.options.2.failure..context: Event retinue_at_door, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Soldiers eat your supper and tell lies for sport.

event.retinue_at_door.options.2.label.de.context: Event retinue_at_door, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.retinue_at_door.options.2.success..context: Event retinue_at_door, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: By midnight you know where the banners march and which captain fears whom.

event.retinue_at_door.options.3.desc.def.context: Event retinue_at_door, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

event.retinue_at_door.options.3.failure..context: Event retinue_at_door, authored option 3, failure text, branch default.

source.text: He interprets the custom differently, with six hungry men behind him.

event.retinue_at_door.options.3.label.de.context: Event retinue_at_door, authored option 3, label, branch default.

source.text: Cite the custom limiting their demands.

event.retinue_at_door.options.3.success..context: Event retinue_at_door, authored option 3, success text, branch default.

source.text: The captain recognizes the words and takes only what is owed.

event.retinue_at_door.options.4.desc.def.context: Event retinue_at_door, authored option 4, desc, branch default.

source.text: Defy them to their faces, and pay if it fails.

event.retinue_at_door.options.4.failure..context: Event retinue_at_door, authored option 4, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The door gives, then you do. They leave bruises and an empty larder.

event.retinue_at_door.options.4.label.de.context: Event retinue_at_door, authored option 4, label, branch default.

event.retinue_at_door.options.4.success..context: Event retinue_at_door, authored option 4, success text, branch default.

source.text: The first man through finds himself back in the mud. The rest decide another roof is easier.

event.retinue_at_door.text.default.context: Event retinue_at_door, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Men wearing the lord’s colors fill the lane. They require food, fodder, and dry floor before they march again — and requirement sounds very much like command.

event.retinue_at_door.title.default.context: Event retinue_at_door, title, faith branch default.

event.rival_common_cause.options.0.desc..context: Event rival_common_cause, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Shared labor may do what argument could not.

event.rival_common_cause.options.0.failu.context: Event rival_common_cause, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Every shouted order becomes an argument. The roof is saved, but neither of you credits the other.

event.rival_common_cause.options.0.label.context: Event rival_common_cause, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Work beside them until the fire is beaten.

event.rival_common_cause.options.0.succe.context: Event rival_common_cause, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: At dawn the house still stands. {rival} meets your eye across the smoking yard and, for once, nods without mockery.

event.rival_common_cause.options.1.desc..context: Event rival_common_cause, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: The feud has already taught you where mercy leads.

event.rival_common_cause.options.1.label.context: Event rival_common_cause, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Save your own people and leave theirs struggling.

event.rival_common_cause.options.2.desc..context: Event rival_common_cause, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Make common work the first witness to reconciliation.

event.rival_common_cause.options.2.failu.context: Event rival_common_cause, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: {rival} pulls away. “Put out the fire first.” By dawn the moment has gone.

event.rival_common_cause.options.2.label.context: Event rival_common_cause, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Propose peace while both crews are watching.

event.rival_common_cause.options.2.succe.context: Durable event log for rival_common_cause, authored option 2, success.effects.

source.text: Ended a rivalry after facing a common danger.

event.rival_common_cause.options.2.succe.context: Event rival_common_cause, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: Exhaustion strips the pride from both of you. Hands are clasped in the smoking street, and the feud ends before witnesses.

event.rival_common_cause.text.default.context: Event rival_common_cause, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Fire takes a neighbor’s roof in a hard wind. You and {rival} arrive from opposite lanes, each with people and ladders, and find yourselves holding the same sagging beam while sparks fall around you.

event.rival_common_cause.title.default.context: Event rival_common_cause, title, faith branch default.

event.rival_legacy.options.0.desc.defaul.context: Event rival_legacy, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Give the next generation a clean beginning.

event.rival_legacy.options.0.effects.log.context: Durable event log for rival_legacy, authored option 0, effects.

event.rival_legacy.options.0.label.defau.context: Event rival_legacy, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.rival_legacy.options.1.desc.defaul.context: Event rival_legacy, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Take up the feud and the obligations of the dead.

event.rival_legacy.options.1.effects.log.context: Durable event log for rival_legacy, authored option 1, effects.

event.rival_legacy.options.1.label.defau.context: Event rival_legacy, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: “An injury to this house is mine.”

event.rival_legacy.options.2.desc.defaul.context: Event rival_legacy, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: A new heir can say what the dead could not.

event.rival_legacy.options.2.failure.tex.context: Event rival_legacy, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: {rival} has not forgotten enough. The old quarrel finds a new name in you.

event.rival_legacy.options.2.label.defau.context: Event rival_legacy, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Offer peace, if they will take it.

event.rival_legacy.options.2.success.tex.context: Event rival_legacy, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: The clean beginning is accepted. Old accusations are withdrawn, and both houses step back from the edge.

event.rival_legacy.text.default.context: Event rival_legacy, text, faith branch default.

source.text: {rival} was the enemy of the one whose place you have taken. Kin wait to hear whether the old injury belongs to the whole house now — or whether it will be buried with the dead.

event.rival_legacy.title.default.context: Event rival_legacy, title, faith branch default.

event.rival_mediation.options.0.desc.def.context: Event rival_mediation, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Silver admits that an injury was done without making you crawl.

event.rival_mediation.options.0.failure..context: Event rival_mediation, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: {rival} pushes the purse back. “Silver cannot buy what was taken.” The go-between has no peace to witness.

event.rival_mediation.options.0.label.de.context: Event rival_mediation, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.rival_mediation.options.0.success..context: Durable event log for rival_mediation, authored option 0, success.effects.

source.text: Made peace with a rival through compensation.

event.rival_mediation.options.0.success..context: Event rival_mediation, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: The purse changes hands. Your enemy names the injury answered, and the witnesses bind you both to peace.

event.rival_mediation.options.1.desc.def.context: Event rival_mediation, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Put pride aside and accept an outsider’s terms.

event.rival_mediation.options.1.failure..context: Event rival_mediation, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Every term becomes another argument. At last the mediator rises and leaves you to your anger.

event.rival_mediation.options.1.label.de.context: Event rival_mediation, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.rival_mediation.options.1.success..context: Durable event log for rival_mediation, authored option 1, success.effects.

source.text: Accepted a mediated peace with a rival.

event.rival_mediation.options.1.success..context: Event rival_mediation, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: The judgment leaves neither side wholly pleased, which is how the witnesses know it is fair. Both sides swear to let the matter rest.

event.rival_mediation.options.2.desc.def.context: Event rival_mediation, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Peace is welcome, but not at the price of surrendering your claim.

event.rival_mediation.options.2.failure..context: Event rival_mediation, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: {rival} laughs at the demand. The mediator’s table has merely given the quarrel a new insult.

event.rival_mediation.options.2.label.de.context: Event rival_mediation, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.rival_mediation.options.2.success..context: Durable event log for rival_mediation, authored option 2, success.effects.

source.text: Took compensation to end a rivalry.

event.rival_mediation.options.2.success..context: Event rival_mediation, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: Rather than feed the feud another year, your enemy pays a smaller purse and names the matter closed.

event.rival_mediation.options.3.desc.def.context: Event rival_mediation, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

event.rival_mediation.options.3.label.de.context: Event rival_mediation, authored option 3, label, branch default.

event.rival_mediation.text.default.context: Event rival_mediation, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A respected go-between seats you and {rival} beneath the same roof. The terms are old and plain: amends for the injury, witnesses to the promise, and an end to every private revenge.

event.rival_mediation.text.jewish.context: Event rival_mediation, text, faith branch jewish.

source.text: A respected elder seats you and {rival} before witnesses. The terms are plain: restitution for the injury and a sworn end to the quarrel.

event.rival_mediation.text.muslim.context: Event rival_mediation, text, faith branch muslim.

source.text: A respected go-between seats you and {rival} beneath the same roof and urges ṣulḥ: fair amends, named witnesses, and a binding end to the quarrel.

event.rival_mediation.text.pagan.context: Event rival_mediation, text, faith branch pagan.

source.text: An elder seats you and {rival} before the assembly. The terms are old and plain: compensation for the injury, hands clasped before witnesses, and no private revenge.

event.rival_mediation.title.default.context: Event rival_mediation, title, faith branch default.

event.rival_peace_oath.options.0.desc.de.context: Event rival_peace_oath, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A public oath closes doors that private anger keeps opening.

event.rival_peace_oath.options.0.effects.context: Durable event log for rival_peace_oath, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Swore a public peace with a rival.

event.rival_peace_oath.options.0.label.d.context: Event rival_peace_oath, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.rival_peace_oath.options.1.desc.de.context: Event rival_peace_oath, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Let a small concession prove that the words have weight.

event.rival_peace_oath.options.1.failure.context: Event rival_peace_oath, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The token becomes a price, the price an insult. The witnesses go home without hearing an oath.

event.rival_peace_oath.options.1.label.d.context: Event rival_peace_oath, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Ask one token of good faith.

event.rival_peace_oath.options.1.success.context: Event rival_peace_oath, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: The token is yielded without haggling. The witnesses murmur approval, and the oath is made.

event.rival_peace_oath.options.2.desc.de.context: Event rival_peace_oath, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Some injuries deserve a longer memory.

event.rival_peace_oath.options.2.label.d.context: Event rival_peace_oath, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.rival_peace_oath.text.default.context: Event rival_peace_oath, text, faith branch default.

source.text: {rival} comes with witnesses and a careful proposal: speak the injuries aloud, renounce revenge, and seal the peace before the altar with an oath and the kiss of peace.

event.rival_peace_oath.text.jewish.context: Event rival_peace_oath, text, faith branch jewish.

source.text: {rival} comes with elders and a careful proposal: speak the injuries plainly, make restitution where it is owed, and swear before witnesses that the quarrel is ended.

event.rival_peace_oath.text.muslim.context: Event rival_peace_oath, text, faith branch muslim.

source.text: {rival} comes with witnesses and a careful proposal of ṣulḥ: speak the claims plainly, settle them fairly, and swear before {god} that the quarrel is ended.

event.rival_peace_oath.text.pagan.context: Event rival_peace_oath, text, faith branch pagan.

source.text: {rival} comes before the assembly with a careful proposal: speak the injuries aloud, renounce revenge, and clasp hands over an oath of peace.

event.rival_peace_oath.title.default.context: Event rival_peace_oath, title, faith branch default.

event.rival_scheme.options.0.desc.defaul.context: Event rival_scheme, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Drag the poison into daylight and dare them to repeat it.

event.rival_scheme.options.0.failure.tex.context: Event rival_scheme, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: They double down, and the crowd murmurs against you.

event.rival_scheme.options.0.label.defau.context: Event rival_scheme, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.rival_scheme.options.0.success.tex.context: Event rival_scheme, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: They stammer and withdraw the words. The witnesses laugh at them.

event.rival_scheme.options.1.desc.defaul.context: Event rival_scheme, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Lies starve slower than truth feeds.

event.rival_scheme.options.1.label.defau.context: Event rival_scheme, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Let the lie die on its own.

event.rival_scheme.options.2.desc.defaul.context: Event rival_scheme, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Poison for poison, and yours brewed better.

event.rival_scheme.options.2.label.defau.context: Event rival_scheme, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.rival_scheme.title.default.context: Event rival_scheme, title, faith branch default.

event.royal_progress.options.0.desc.defa.context: Event royal_progress, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Let distant subjects see the full weight of the crown.

event.royal_progress.options.0.label.def.context: Event royal_progress, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.royal_progress.options.1.desc.defa.context: Event royal_progress, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Be seen without devouring every host’s stores.

event.royal_progress.options.1.label.def.context: Event royal_progress, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.royal_progress.options.2.desc.defa.context: Event royal_progress, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Roads waste time better spent governing.

event.royal_progress.options.2.label.def.context: Event royal_progress, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.royal_progress.text.default.context: Event royal_progress, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Councillors propose a progress through the realm: justice beneath open skies, feasts in loyal towns, and a royal household consuming supplies everywhere it passes.

event.royal_progress.title.default.context: Event royal_progress, title, faith branch default.

event.ruler_marriage_offer.options.0.des.context: Event ruler_marriage_offer, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Seal the betrothal. If both are grown, the wedding follows now; any dowry is settled by the bride’s house.

event.ruler_marriage_offer.options.0.lab.context: Event ruler_marriage_offer, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.ruler_marriage_offer.options.1.des.context: Event ruler_marriage_offer, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: No match is made, and the proposing court cools toward you.

event.ruler_marriage_offer.options.1.lab.context: Event ruler_marriage_offer, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.ruler_marriage_offer.title.default.context: Event ruler_marriage_offer, title, faith branch default.

event.ruler_overture.options.0.desc.defa.context: Event ruler_overture, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Open a warmer relationship with this ruler.

event.ruler_overture.options.0.label.def.context: Event ruler_overture, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.ruler_overture.options.1.desc.defa.context: Event ruler_overture, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Coin makes the answer harder to mistake.

event.ruler_overture.options.1.label.def.context: Event ruler_overture, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.ruler_overture.options.2.desc.defa.context: Event ruler_overture, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

event.ruler_overture.options.2.label.def.context: Event ruler_overture, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Keep this court at a distance.

event.ruler_overture.text.default.context: Event ruler_overture, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A courier from {rulername} of {rname} brings compliments, small news, and a carefully worded invitation to warmer dealings. The letter is friendly; the purpose behind it is not hidden.

event.ruler_overture.title.default.context: Event ruler_overture, title, faith branch default.

event.ruler_rebel_intrigue.options.0.des.context: Event ruler_rebel_intrigue, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: End the funding and publicly shame its sponsor.

event.ruler_rebel_intrigue.options.0.lab.context: Event ruler_rebel_intrigue, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Expose the payments before the court.

event.ruler_rebel_intrigue.options.1.des.context: Event ruler_rebel_intrigue, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: End the foreign support by giving the vassal a better reason to stay.

event.ruler_rebel_intrigue.options.1.lab.context: Event ruler_rebel_intrigue, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.ruler_rebel_intrigue.options.2.des.context: Event ruler_rebel_intrigue, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: The rebel funding remains active for now.

event.ruler_rebel_intrigue.options.2.lab.context: Event ruler_rebel_intrigue, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Watch, and learn who takes the coin.

event.ruler_rebel_intrigue.text.default.context: Event ruler_rebel_intrigue, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Agents of {rulername} in {rname} are funding one of your discontented vassals. The money buys messengers, retainers, and the confidence to test an oath already worn thin.

event.ruler_rebel_intrigue.title.default.context: Event ruler_rebel_intrigue, title, faith branch default.

event.save_the_lord.options.0.desc.defau.context: Event save_the_lord, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Risk your neck; a grateful lord pays for years.

event.save_the_lord.options.0.failure.te.context: Event save_the_lord, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: You reach him — then something bursts against your helm. You wake in the surgeons’ tent, honored and broken.

event.save_the_lord.options.0.label.defa.context: Event save_the_lord, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.save_the_lord.options.0.success.ef.context: Durable event log for save_the_lord, authored option 0, success.effects.

source.text: Saved the lord’s life in battle!

event.save_the_lord.options.0.success.te.context: Event save_the_lord, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: You stand over the fallen lord, roaring, until help arrives. He grips your arm: “I will not forget this.”

event.save_the_lord.options.1.desc.defau.context: Event save_the_lord, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Cold sense — and men will see that it was cold.

event.save_the_lord.options.1.label.defa.context: Event save_the_lord, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: A dead lord pays no wages. Keep formation.

event.save_the_lord.text.default.context: Event save_the_lord, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Through the din you see it: {lord} down, horse screaming, enemies closing like crows. No one else is near enough. You are.

event.save_the_lord.title.default.context: Event save_the_lord, title, faith branch default.

event.scholar_disputation.options.0.desc.context: Event scholar_disputation, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A public contest of learning, with a public price for losing.

event.scholar_disputation.options.0.fail.context: Event scholar_disputation, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: He turns your own argument against you before the whole square. The crowd enjoys that too.

event.scholar_disputation.options.0.labe.context: Event scholar_disputation, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.scholar_disputation.options.0.succ.context: Durable event log for scholar_disputation, authored option 0, success.effects.

source.text: Bested a visiting master in disputation.

event.scholar_disputation.options.0.succ.context: Event scholar_disputation, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: Your distinctions hold; his do not. The crowd laughs with you, and the purse is yours.

event.scholar_disputation.options.1.desc.context: Event scholar_disputation, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Another mind’s method is worth more than one afternoon’s pride.

event.scholar_disputation.options.1.labe.context: Event scholar_disputation, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.scholar_disputation.text.default.context: Event scholar_disputation, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Outside the {temple}, a traveling master takes all comers in disputation, and a crowd gathers to watch scholars bleed. A place beside him is open — and so is his purse, for the one who bests him.

event.scholar_disputation.title.default.context: Event scholar_disputation, title, faith branch default.

event.scriptorium.options.0.desc.default.context: Event scriptorium, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Steady work that sharpens the mind.

event.scriptorium.options.0.label.defaul.context: Event scriptorium, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.scriptorium.options.1.desc.default.context: Event scriptorium, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Golden lions could delight the abbot — or scandalize him.

event.scriptorium.options.1.failure.text.context: Event scriptorium, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: “Is that a DOG in the Gospel?” Scraping vellum for a month.

event.scriptorium.options.1.label.defaul.context: Event scriptorium, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.scriptorium.options.1.success.text.context: Event scriptorium, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: Your golden lions delight the abbot.

event.scriptorium.text.default.context: Event scriptorium, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Cold fingers, aching eyes, and the slow miracle of letters spreading down the page. The abbot watches your copying with interest.

event.scriptorium.title.default.context: Event scriptorium, title, faith branch default.

event.seek_blessing.options.0.desc.defau.context: Event seek_blessing, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: The next harvest will fare better.

event.seek_blessing.options.0.effects.lo.context: Durable event log for seek_blessing, authored option 0, effects.

event.seek_blessing.options.0.label.defa.context: Event seek_blessing, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: A blessing on the fields. (30 piety)

event.seek_blessing.options.1.desc.defau.context: Event seek_blessing, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Grace rides with you into your next battle.

event.seek_blessing.options.1.effects.lo.context: Durable event log for seek_blessing, authored option 1, effects.

event.seek_blessing.options.1.label.defa.context: Event seek_blessing, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: A blessing on the sword. (30 piety)

event.seek_blessing.options.2.desc.defau.context: Event seek_blessing, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Ask {god} to knit what the flesh cannot.

event.seek_blessing.options.2.effects.lo.context: Durable event log for seek_blessing, authored option 2, effects.

event.seek_blessing.options.2.label.defa.context: Event seek_blessing, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.seek_blessing.options.3.desc.defau.context: Event seek_blessing, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: Ask for the patter of small feet.

event.seek_blessing.options.3.label.defa.context: Event seek_blessing, authored option 3, label, branch default.

event.seek_blessing.options.4.desc.defau.context: Event seek_blessing, authored option 4, desc, branch default.

source.text: A good word from the pulpit weighs with the great.

event.seek_blessing.options.4.effects.lo.context: Durable event log for seek_blessing, authored option 4, effects.

source.text: The clergy praised your name at the manor.

event.seek_blessing.options.4.label.defa.context: Event seek_blessing, authored option 4, label, branch default.

source.text: The {holy} speaks well of you to the lord. (35 piety)

event.seek_blessing.options.5.desc.defau.context: Event seek_blessing, authored option 5, desc, branch default.

source.text: The dead are honored, and the living speak of it.

event.seek_blessing.options.5.effects.lo.context: Durable event log for seek_blessing, authored option 5, effects.

source.text: Masses were sung for the family dead.

event.seek_blessing.options.5.label.defa.context: Event seek_blessing, authored option 5, label, branch default.

source.text: Masses sung for your ancestors. (25 piety)

event.seek_blessing.options.6.desc.defau.context: Event seek_blessing, authored option 6, desc, branch default.

source.text: Grace settles over hearth and home.

event.seek_blessing.options.6.effects.lo.context: Durable event log for seek_blessing, authored option 6, effects.

event.seek_blessing.options.6.label.defa.context: Event seek_blessing, authored option 6, label, branch default.

source.text: A blessing upon your house. (30 piety)

event.seek_blessing.options.7.desc.defau.context: Event seek_blessing, authored option 7, desc, branch default.

event.seek_blessing.options.7.label.defa.context: Event seek_blessing, authored option 7, label, branch default.

event.seek_blessing.options.8.desc.defau.context: Event seek_blessing, authored option 8, desc, branch default.

source.text: The clergy’s public favor strengthens your standing at court.

event.seek_blessing.options.8.effects.lo.context: Durable event log for seek_blessing, authored option 8, effects.

source.text: The clergy praised your rule before the liege.

event.seek_blessing.options.8.label.defa.context: Event seek_blessing, authored option 8, label, branch default.

event.seek_blessing.options.9.desc.defau.context: Event seek_blessing, authored option 9, desc, branch default.

source.text: Let every pulpit commend peace beneath your rule.

event.seek_blessing.options.9.effects.lo.context: Durable event log for seek_blessing, authored option 9, effects.

source.text: The clergy offered public prayers for the realm.

event.seek_blessing.options.9.label.defa.context: Event seek_blessing, authored option 9, label, branch default.

event.seek_blessing.text.default.context: Event seek_blessing, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Cool shadow and quiet within the {temple}. The {holy} hears you out, then asks what you would have of {god}.

event.seek_blessing.title.default.context: Event seek_blessing, title, faith branch default.

event.serf_boon_harvest.options.0.desc.d.context: Event serf_boon_harvest, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: The lord’s grain comes in while yours waits under the weather.

event.serf_boon_harvest.options.0.label..context: Event serf_boon_harvest, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Send every hand to the demesne.

event.serf_boon_harvest.options.1.desc.d.context: Event serf_boon_harvest, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Buy back the day your own harvest needs.

event.serf_boon_harvest.options.1.label..context: Event serf_boon_harvest, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Hire someone to answer for you. ({money:4})

event.serf_boon_harvest.options.2.desc.d.context: Event serf_boon_harvest, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: One pair of hands for your field, if the tally misses them.

event.serf_boon_harvest.options.2.failur.context: Event serf_boon_harvest, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The missing hand is named before noon. The amercement costs more than the grain it saved.

event.serf_boon_harvest.options.2.label..context: Event serf_boon_harvest, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Keep one reaper hidden at home.

event.serf_boon_harvest.options.2.succes.context: Event serf_boon_harvest, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: The reeve counts heads, not shadows. Your hidden reaper saves the ripest rows.

event.serf_boon_harvest.text.default.context: Event serf_boon_harvest, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Your own grain stands ripe when the reeve’s horn sounds. Every able hand is summoned to reap {lord}’s demesne before a sickle may touch a household strip.

event.serf_boon_harvest.title.default.context: Event serf_boon_harvest, title, faith branch default.

event.serf_bridge_cartage.options.0.desc.context: Event serf_bridge_cartage, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A sound bridge for everyone, paid for by your bones.

event.serf_bridge_cartage.options.0.labe.context: Event serf_bridge_cartage, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Take the cart road and haul it.

event.serf_bridge_cartage.options.1.desc.context: Event serf_bridge_cartage, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Let wheel and axle suffer in your place.

event.serf_bridge_cartage.options.1.labe.context: Event serf_bridge_cartage, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Lend the household cart and stay afield.

event.serf_bridge_cartage.options.2.desc.context: Event serf_bridge_cartage, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Save half the road if your eye for ground is true.

event.serf_bridge_cartage.options.2.fail.context: Event serf_bridge_cartage, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: A wheel sinks to the hub. Dragging it free costs the strength you meant to save.

event.serf_bridge_cartage.options.2.labe.context: Event serf_bridge_cartage, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Find a shorter way through the shallows.

event.serf_bridge_cartage.options.2.succ.context: Event serf_bridge_cartage, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: The ford holds, the timber arrives early, and others follow your track.

event.serf_bridge_cartage.options.3.desc.context: Event serf_bridge_cartage, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: Another household takes the mud; yours pays the coin.

event.serf_bridge_cartage.options.3.labe.context: Event serf_bridge_cartage, authored option 3, label, branch default.

source.text: Pay a carter to take your mark. ({money:3})

event.serf_bridge_cartage.text.default.context: Event serf_bridge_cartage, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Floodwater has bitten through the bridge piles. The steward apportions timber, carts, and labor by holding; your mark appears beside the longest haul.

event.serf_bridge_cartage.title.default.context: Event serf_bridge_cartage, title, faith branch default.

event.serf_common_oven.options.0.desc.de.context: Event serf_common_oven, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

event.serf_common_oven.options.0.label.d.context: Event serf_common_oven, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.serf_common_oven.options.1.desc.de.context: Event serf_common_oven, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Trade a day in the coppice for the baker’s share.

event.serf_common_oven.options.1.label.d.context: Event serf_common_oven, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Bring fuel and tend the fire instead.

event.serf_common_oven.options.2.desc.de.context: Event serf_common_oven, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: A small loaf leaves a long trail of smoke.

event.serf_common_oven.options.2.failure.context: Event serf_common_oven, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Smoke curls above the roof. The baker arrives before the loaf is cool.

event.serf_common_oven.options.2.label.d.context: Event serf_common_oven, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Bake beneath a covered pot after dark.

event.serf_common_oven.options.2.success.context: Event serf_common_oven, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: The coals cool before dawn, leaving bread and no witness.

event.serf_common_oven.text.default.context: Event serf_common_oven, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The village oven is hot, and the baker has raised the customary toll. He points to the cold clay ovens behind the cottages: none may bake while {lord}’s fire burns.

event.serf_common_oven.title.default.context: Event serf_common_oven, title, faith branch default.

event.serf_deadwood_amerced.options.0.de.context: Event serf_deadwood_amerced, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Keep the fuel and surrender the coin.

event.serf_deadwood_amerced.options.0.la.context: Event serf_deadwood_amerced, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.serf_deadwood_amerced.options.1.de.context: Event serf_deadwood_amerced, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Walk home cold rather than enter the forester’s book.

event.serf_deadwood_amerced.options.1.la.context: Event serf_deadwood_amerced, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.serf_deadwood_amerced.options.2.de.context: Event serf_deadwood_amerced, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Custom may shelter the poor, if anyone admits remembering it.

event.serf_deadwood_amerced.options.2.fa.context: Event serf_deadwood_amerced, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The forester calls custom a tale told by thieves. The fine doubles.

event.serf_deadwood_amerced.options.2.la.context: Event serf_deadwood_amerced, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Name the old right to fallen branches.

event.serf_deadwood_amerced.options.2.su.context: Event serf_deadwood_amerced, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: An elder confirms the right before the forester can close the question.

event.serf_deadwood_amerced.text.default.context: Event serf_deadwood_amerced, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The forester stops your sledge at the wood’s edge. You gathered only storm-fallen limbs, but he says even dead wood belongs first to {lord}.

event.serf_deadwood_amerced.title.defaul.context: Event serf_deadwood_amerced, title, faith branch default.

event.serf_extraordinary_tallage.options.context: Event serf_extraordinary_tallage, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Keep your body and your silence; lose the household reserve.

event.serf_extraordinary_tallage.options.context: Event serf_extraordinary_tallage, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Empty the purse into the tally chest.

event.serf_extraordinary_tallage.options.context: Event serf_extraordinary_tallage, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Pay the arbitrary demand in winter strength.

event.serf_extraordinary_tallage.options.context: Event serf_extraordinary_tallage, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Offer a month of added labor.

event.serf_extraordinary_tallage.options.context: Event serf_extraordinary_tallage, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Keep coin and strength; let defiance become the next debt.

event.serf_extraordinary_tallage.options.context: Event serf_extraordinary_tallage, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.serf_extraordinary_tallage.text.de.context: Event serf_extraordinary_tallage, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A sealed tally arrives without harvest, feast, or judgment to explain it. {lord} needs silver, the steward says, and an unfree household owes what its lord chooses to ask.

event.serf_extraordinary_tallage.title.d.context: Event serf_extraordinary_tallage, title, faith branch default.

event.serf_marriage_leave.options.0.desc.context: Event serf_marriage_leave, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Begin married life with an emptier purse and a closed tally.

event.serf_marriage_leave.options.0.labe.context: Event serf_marriage_leave, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.serf_marriage_leave.options.1.desc.context: Event serf_marriage_leave, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Let your back purchase what the wedding promised.

event.serf_marriage_leave.options.1.labe.context: Event serf_marriage_leave, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Work the fine in extra days.

event.serf_marriage_leave.options.2.desc.context: Event serf_marriage_leave, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Ask the lord to value a settled household over ready silver.

event.serf_marriage_leave.options.2.fail.context: Event serf_marriage_leave, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The petition is called ingratitude. The full fine grows by another coin.

event.serf_marriage_leave.options.2.labe.context: Event serf_marriage_leave, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.serf_marriage_leave.options.2.succ.context: Event serf_marriage_leave, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: The steward cuts the fine to two coins and calls it favor.

event.serf_marriage_leave.text.default.context: Event serf_marriage_leave, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The reeve comes after the wedding feast with a reminder: an unfree tenant does not marry beyond the household without {lord}’s leave, and leave has its price.

event.serf_marriage_leave.title.default.context: Event serf_marriage_leave, title, faith branch default.

event.serf_mill_multure.options.0.desc.d.context: Event serf_mill_multure, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Lose the grain and close the matter.

event.serf_mill_multure.options.0.label..context: Event serf_mill_multure, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.serf_mill_multure.options.1.desc.d.context: Event serf_mill_multure, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Pay the toll in grain, road, and aching shoulders.

event.serf_mill_multure.options.1.label..context: Event serf_mill_multure, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Carry the rest back to the lord’s mill.

event.serf_mill_multure.options.2.desc.d.context: Event serf_mill_multure, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: A boundary may hide what a quern cannot.

event.serf_mill_multure.options.2.failur.context: Event serf_mill_multure, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The flour is still warm from your quern. He seizes the sack and adds a fine.

event.serf_mill_multure.options.2.label..context: Event serf_mill_multure, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Swear the meal came from another manor.

event.serf_mill_multure.options.2.succes.context: Event serf_mill_multure, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: The miller cannot prove whose stones ground it and lets the sack go.

event.serf_mill_multure.text.default.context: Event serf_mill_multure, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The miller finds meal from a hand-quern in your bin. Grain from this holding must pass beneath {lord}’s millstones, with every lawful sack leaving a share behind.

event.serf_mill_multure.title.default.context: Event serf_mill_multure, title, faith branch default.

event.serf_officers_quartered.options.0..context: Event serf_officers_quartered, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: An empty larder may purchase a favorable word.

event.serf_officers_quartered.options.0..context: Event serf_officers_quartered, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.serf_officers_quartered.options.1..context: Event serf_officers_quartered, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Spare some food by yielding every comfort.

event.serf_officers_quartered.options.1..context: Event serf_officers_quartered, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Give them the hearth and sleep in the byre.

event.serf_officers_quartered.options.2..context: Event serf_officers_quartered, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: A bare shelf can lie more smoothly than its owner.

event.serf_officers_quartered.options.2..context: Event serf_officers_quartered, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: A trooper finds the false panel. They take the hidden food as well as the supper.

event.serf_officers_quartered.options.2..context: Event serf_officers_quartered, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Hide the best stores before they dismount.

event.serf_officers_quartered.options.2..context: Event serf_officers_quartered, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: They eat coarse bread, complain, and never find the smoked meat overhead.

event.serf_officers_quartered.options.3..context: Event serf_officers_quartered, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: Move the burden to a neighbor and live with the village’s memory.

event.serf_officers_quartered.options.3..context: Event serf_officers_quartered, authored option 3, label, branch default.

source.text: Send them toward a richer roof.

event.serf_officers_quartered.text.defau.context: Event serf_officers_quartered, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Mounted officers in {lord}’s colors claim your fire, fodder, supper, and bedding for the night. By custom they pay; by morning they may remember the custom differently.

event.serf_officers_quartered.title.defa.context: Event serf_officers_quartered, title, faith branch default.

event.serf_pannage_due.options.0.desc.de.context: Event serf_pannage_due, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A lean purse now for a fatter animal in winter.

event.serf_pannage_due.options.0.label.d.context: Event serf_pannage_due, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.serf_pannage_due.options.1.desc.de.context: Event serf_pannage_due, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Save the fee and spend the household’s own food instead.

event.serf_pannage_due.options.1.label.d.context: Event serf_pannage_due, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Keep the swine penned and feed them grain.

event.serf_pannage_due.options.2.desc.de.context: Event serf_pannage_due, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: The pigs know no law; the forester does.

event.serf_pannage_due.options.2.failure.context: Event serf_pannage_due, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: A bellwether squeals beneath the forester’s window. He takes the fattest pig as amercement.

event.serf_pannage_due.options.2.label.d.context: Event serf_pannage_due, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.serf_pannage_due.options.2.success.context: Event serf_pannage_due, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: By dawn the herd is round-bellied and back behind its wattle fence.

event.serf_pannage_due.text.default.context: Event serf_pannage_due, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Acorns lie thick beneath the lord’s oaks, enough to fatten every village pig. The forester waits at the wood’s edge to collect pannage before a snout crosses the ditch.

event.serf_pannage_due.title.default.context: Event serf_pannage_due, title, faith branch default.

event.serf_seed_grain_requisition.option.context: Event serf_seed_grain_requisition, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Feed the host now and meet winter with a hollow bin.

event.serf_seed_grain_requisition.option.context: Event serf_seed_grain_requisition, authored option 0, label, branch default.
Event serf_seed_grain_requisition, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Keep seed enough to sow by giving up the means to haul it.

event.serf_seed_grain_requisition.option.context: Event serf_seed_grain_requisition, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Surrender cart and draft gear instead.

event.serf_seed_grain_requisition.option.context: Event serf_seed_grain_requisition, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Make them move you before they move the sacks.

event.serf_seed_grain_requisition.option.context: Event serf_seed_grain_requisition, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.serf_seed_grain_requisition.text.d.context: Event serf_seed_grain_requisition, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The war has eaten the lord’s stores. Armed men break the seal on your granary and name its seed corn provisions for the host; what they leave will not sow every strip.

event.serf_seed_grain_requisition.title..context: Event serf_seed_grain_requisition, title, faith branch default.

event.serf_tithe_sheaf.options.0.desc.de.context: Event serf_tithe_sheaf, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Render the sacred share and tighten the household store.

event.serf_tithe_sheaf.options.0.label.d.context: Event serf_tithe_sheaf, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.serf_tithe_sheaf.options.1.desc.de.context: Event serf_tithe_sheaf, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Pay with shoulders where the granary cannot.

event.serf_tithe_sheaf.options.1.label.d.context: Event serf_tithe_sheaf, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Cart the parish grain in place of part of it.

event.serf_tithe_sheaf.options.2.desc.de.context: Event serf_tithe_sheaf, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Hide grain from the collector and the sin from yourself.

event.serf_tithe_sheaf.options.2.failure.context: Event serf_tithe_sheaf, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: A fork strikes the hidden bundle. The grain goes to the church with an amercement besides.

event.serf_tithe_sheaf.options.2.label.d.context: Event serf_tithe_sheaf, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Bury two sheaves beneath the straw.

event.serf_tithe_sheaf.options.2.success.context: Event serf_tithe_sheaf, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: The count ends two sheaves short, and no hand finds them.

event.serf_tithe_sheaf.text.default.context: Event serf_tithe_sheaf, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The tithe collector walks the stubble counting every tenth sheaf for the {temple}. The lord’s harvest is already gone, and winter has not yet shown its teeth.

event.serf_tithe_sheaf.title.default.context: Event serf_tithe_sheaf, title, faith branch default.

event.serf_weekwork_tally.options.0.desc.context: Event serf_weekwork_tally, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A day for the lord is a day stolen from your own ground.

event.serf_weekwork_tally.options.0.labe.context: Event serf_weekwork_tally, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.serf_weekwork_tally.options.1.desc.context: Event serf_weekwork_tally, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Silver works even when your back does not.

event.serf_weekwork_tally.options.1.labe.context: Event serf_weekwork_tally, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.serf_weekwork_tally.options.2.desc.context: Event serf_weekwork_tally, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Custom lives in witnesses, but stewards keep the ink.

event.serf_weekwork_tally.options.2.fail.context: Event serf_weekwork_tally, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Memory bends under questions. The new tally stands, with a penalty for delay.

event.serf_weekwork_tally.options.2.labe.context: Event serf_weekwork_tally, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Call neighbors who remember the old tally.

event.serf_weekwork_tally.options.2.succ.context: Event serf_weekwork_tally, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: Three elders repeat the same number. The steward restores the missing stroke.

event.serf_weekwork_tally.text.default.context: Event serf_weekwork_tally, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The steward measures every holding anew, then announces that your household owes one more day of week-work than the old tally showed.

event.serf_weekwork_tally.title.default.context: Event serf_weekwork_tally, title, faith branch default.

event.sergeant.options.0.desc.default.context: Event sergeant, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: More coin, more blame, a louder voice.

event.sergeant.options.0.effects.log.def.context: Durable event log for sergeant, authored option 0, effects.

event.sergeant.options.0.label.default.context: Event sergeant, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.sergeant.options.1.desc.default.context: Event sergeant, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Stay a spearman; let others carry the worry.

event.sergeant.options.1.label.default.context: Event sergeant, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Responsibility is a slower way to die.

event.sergeant.text.default.context: Event sergeant, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The captain needs a steady hand over the new levies. Your name is spoken.

event.sergeant.title.default.context: Event sergeant, title, faith branch default.

event.sermon.options.0.desc.default.context: Event sermon, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Good words, freely given, freely kept.

event.sermon.options.0.label.default.context: Event sermon, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.sermon.options.1.desc.default.context: Event sermon, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: The sermon will keep; your attention does not.

event.sermon.options.1.label.default.context: Event sermon, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.sermon.text.default.context: Event sermon, text, faith branch default.

source.text: {priest} preaches with unusual fire — of the rich man, the camel, and the needle’s eye.

event.sermon.title.default.context: Event sermon, title, faith branch default.

event.shop_fire.options.0.desc.default.context: Event shop_fire, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Brave the fire to save your stock — or lose more trying.

event.shop_fire.options.0.failure.text.d.context: Event shop_fire, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: You save your skin and little else.

event.shop_fire.options.0.label.default.context: Event shop_fire, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Fight the flames for your stock.

event.shop_fire.options.0.success.text.d.context: Event shop_fire, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: Scorched but standing. You saved the most of it.

event.shop_fire.options.1.desc.default.context: Event shop_fire, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Let yours burn; the town remembers who came.

event.shop_fire.options.1.label.default.context: Event shop_fire, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.shop_fire.text.default.context: Event shop_fire, text, faith branch default.

source.text: You wake to shouting and an orange glow. Fire is eating through the workshop quarter, leaping thatch to thatch.

event.shop_fire.title.default.context: Event shop_fire, title, faith branch default.

event.sibling_courtship_approach.options.context: Event sibling_courtship_approach, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Their own traits and Standing decide the answer; refusal is permanent.

event.sibling_courtship_approach.options.context: Event sibling_courtship_approach, authored option 0, label, branch default.
Event sibling_courtship_approach, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Withdraw before the question is asked; the day is still spent.

event.sibling_courtship_approach.options.context: Event sibling_courtship_approach, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.sibling_courtship_approach.text.de.context: Event sibling_courtship_approach, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Trust, appetite, ambition, and taboo have narrowed to one dangerous question. You can speak to your sibling now, but a refusal will end the matter forever.

event.sibling_courtship_approach.title.d.context: Event sibling_courtship_approach, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A Word That Cannot Be Recalled

event.sibling_courtship_exposed.options..context: Event sibling_courtship_exposed, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Break off the courtship and accept the lasting five-year separation.

event.sibling_courtship_exposed.options..context: Event sibling_courtship_exposed, authored option 0, label, branch default.
Event sibling_courtship_exposed, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Intrigue may quiet the story; discovery will deepen the scandal.

event.sibling_courtship_exposed.options..context: Event sibling_courtship_exposed, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The denial collapses. Now the secret and the lie are both common knowledge.

event.sibling_courtship_exposed.options..context: Event sibling_courtship_exposed, authored option 1, label, branch default.
Event sibling_courtship_exposed, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: Contradictory stories and careful pressure leave the gossips uncertain.

event.sibling_courtship_exposed.options..context: Event sibling_courtship_exposed, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Keep the courtship and bear the immediate public cost.

event.sibling_courtship_exposed.options..context: Event sibling_courtship_exposed, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.sibling_courtship_exposed.text.def.context: Event sibling_courtship_exposed, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A servant saw a hand linger; a cousin heard a door close. What passed for private devotion is becoming a public scandal.

event.sibling_courtship_exposed.title.de.context: Event sibling_courtship_exposed, title, faith branch default.

event.sibling_proposal_made.options.0.de.context: Event sibling_proposal_made, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Standing and their traits decide the answer. The reviewed rite or scandal costs apply only if they accept.

event.sibling_proposal_made.options.0.fa.context: Event sibling_proposal_made, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: At the final threshold, {suitor} refuses. The courtship is over and will never be renewed.

event.sibling_proposal_made.options.0.la.context: Event sibling_proposal_made, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.sibling_proposal_made.options.0.su.context: Event sibling_proposal_made, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: {suitor} accepts. Whatever the world calls it, the two of you will make a household.

event.sibling_proposal_made.text.default.context: Event sibling_proposal_made, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The courtship has survived its first impossible question. You ask {suitor} for vows that may be sanctified by a rare rite — or condemned as an irregular union.

event.sibling_proposal_made.title.defaul.context: Event sibling_proposal_made, title, faith branch default.

event.soldier_command_rearguard.options..context: Event soldier_command_rearguard, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Slow, thankless work — until it is suddenly very sharp.

event.soldier_command_rearguard.options..context: Event soldier_command_rearguard, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The wagons are saved, but the price is written in blood — some of it yours.

event.soldier_command_rearguard.options..context: Event soldier_command_rearguard, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Hold the crossing until the last cart is over.

event.soldier_command_rearguard.options..context: Durable event log for soldier_command_rearguard, authored option 0, success.effects.

source.text: Held the rearguard at the crossing.

event.soldier_command_rearguard.options..context: Event soldier_command_rearguard, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: You sell every yard of the causeway dearly. The wounded cross; the pursuers do not.

event.soldier_command_rearguard.options..context: Event soldier_command_rearguard, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Coin can be replaced. The captain will not see it that way.

event.soldier_command_rearguard.options..context: Event soldier_command_rearguard, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Abandon the baggage and save the men.

event.soldier_command_rearguard.text.def.context: Event soldier_command_rearguard, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The army crosses the marsh at first light, and someone must hold the baggage and the wounded against whoever comes sniffing after. The captain names you. “Nothing passes you. Nothing.”

event.soldier_command_rearguard.title.de.context: Event soldier_command_rearguard, title, faith branch default.

event.soldier_command_scouts.options.0.d.context: Event soldier_command_scouts, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A command of your own — and the first blades of the war.

event.soldier_command_scouts.options.0.f.context: Event soldier_command_scouts, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Enemy outriders find you first. You bring three riders home out of six, and an arrow’s kiss across the ribs.

event.soldier_command_scouts.options.0.l.context: Event soldier_command_scouts, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.soldier_command_scouts.options.0.s.context: Durable event log for soldier_command_scouts, authored option 0, success.effects.

source.text: Led a scouting party and returned with the truth.

event.soldier_command_scouts.options.0.s.context: Event soldier_command_scouts, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: You find the ford unguarded and the enemy’s horse-lines by dusk. The captain hears your report twice over and asks for your name again.

event.soldier_command_scouts.options.1.d.context: Event soldier_command_scouts, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Let someone hungrier take the risk.

event.soldier_command_scouts.options.1.l.context: Event soldier_command_scouts, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.soldier_command_scouts.text.defaul.context: Event soldier_command_scouts, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The army halts at the edge of unknown country. The captain needs the ground ahead read — fords, woods, and where the enemy’s outriders water their horses. His eye travels down the line and stops at you. “Take six riders. Bring me back the truth.”

event.soldier_command_scouts.title.defau.context: Event soldier_command_scouts, title, faith branch default.

event.soldier_muster_drill.options.0.des.context: Event soldier_muster_drill, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Hard days on the green; the village will thank you when it matters.

event.soldier_muster_drill.options.0.eff.context: Durable event log for soldier_muster_drill, authored option 0, effects.

event.soldier_muster_drill.options.0.lab.context: Event soldier_muster_drill, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.soldier_muster_drill.options.1.des.context: Event soldier_muster_drill, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Full pay for half the work.

event.soldier_muster_drill.options.1.lab.context: Event soldier_muster_drill, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Take the coin and go easy on them.

event.soldier_muster_drill.options.2.des.context: Event soldier_muster_drill, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: The levy can wait; the fire at home cannot.

event.soldier_muster_drill.options.2.lab.context: Event soldier_muster_drill, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Spend the season with your own household.

event.soldier_muster_drill.text.default.context: Event soldier_muster_drill, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Peace has come, and with it the green levy: boys from the lanes who hold a spear like a hoe. The sergeant asks you to knock them into shape before the next war does it for you.

event.soldier_muster_drill.title.default.context: Event soldier_muster_drill, title, faith branch default.

event.sparring_challenge.options.0.desc..context: Event sparring_challenge, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

event.sparring_challenge.options.0.failu.context: Event sparring_challenge, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: It is not about strength. You pay up, aching in new places — and wiser.

event.sparring_challenge.options.0.label.context: Event sparring_challenge, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.sparring_challenge.options.0.succe.context: Event sparring_challenge, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: You catch him older and slower than his stories. The garrison hoots; he pays with a grin.

event.sparring_challenge.options.1.desc..context: Event sparring_challenge, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Free lessons from the safe side of the yard.

event.sparring_challenge.options.1.label.context: Event sparring_challenge, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.sparring_challenge.text.default.context: Event sparring_challenge, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A grizzled sergeant taps your shoulder with a practice blade: “Young ones always think it’s about strength. Care to learn otherwise, for a wager?”

event.sparring_challenge.title.default.context: Event sparring_challenge, title, faith branch default.

event.spouse_council.options.0.desc.defa.context: Event spouse_council, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Two pairs of eyes miss fewer knives.

event.spouse_council.options.0.label.def.context: Event spouse_council, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.spouse_council.options.1.desc.defa.context: Event spouse_council, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

event.spouse_council.options.1.label.def.context: Event spouse_council, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.spouse_council.text.default.context: Event spouse_council, text, faith branch default.

event.spouse_council.title.default.context: Event spouse_council, title, faith branch default.

event.spring_sowing.options.2.desc.defau.context: Event spring_sowing, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Honored the life lived before taking up rule.

event.station_farewell.options.0.label.d.context: Event station_farewell, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.station_farewell.options.1.desc.de.context: Event station_farewell, authored option 1, desc, branch default.
