event.strange_bounty.options.1.desc.defa.context: Event strange_bounty, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Honesty is cheaper than a whipping, and sometimes rewarded.

event.strange_bounty.options.1.label.def.context: Event strange_bounty, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.strange_bounty.options.2.desc.defa.context: Event strange_bounty, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

event.strange_bounty.options.2.label.def.context: Event strange_bounty, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.strange_bounty.options.3.desc.defa.context: Event strange_bounty, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

event.strange_bounty.options.3.label.def.context: Event strange_bounty, authored option 3, label, branch default.

event.strange_bounty.options.4.desc.defa.context: Event strange_bounty, authored option 4, desc, branch default.

event.strange_bounty.options.4.label.def.context: Event strange_bounty, authored option 4, label, branch default.

event.strange_bounty.title.default.context: Event strange_bounty, title, faith branch default.

event.summer_storm.options.0.desc.defaul.context: Event summer_storm, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Take what the field offers before the sky takes it back.

event.summer_storm.options.0.label.defau.context: Event summer_storm, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.summer_storm.options.1.desc.defaul.context: Event summer_storm, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Prayer costs nothing; hail forgives nothing either.

event.summer_storm.options.1.failure.tex.context: Event summer_storm, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Hail like slingstones. The crop is battered flat.

event.summer_storm.options.1.label.defau.context: Event summer_storm, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.summer_storm.options.1.success.tex.context: Event summer_storm, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: The storm slides past. Your fields glitter, unharmed.

event.summer_storm.text.default.context: Event summer_storm, text, faith branch default.

event.summer_storm.title.default.context: Event summer_storm, title, faith branch default.

event.swarm_in_eaves.options.0.desc.defa.context: Event swarm_in_eaves, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Sweet gold hangs heavy — and stings.

event.swarm_in_eaves.options.0.failure.t.context: Event swarm_in_eaves, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The swarm takes offense and then takes flight.

event.swarm_in_eaves.options.0.label.def.context: Event swarm_in_eaves, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Hive them with smoke and patience.

event.swarm_in_eaves.options.0.success.t.context: Event swarm_in_eaves, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: The queen settles into the basket. By autumn there is honey enough to sell.

event.swarm_in_eaves.options.1.desc.defa.context: Event swarm_in_eaves, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Shared work, shared honey, stronger friendship.

event.swarm_in_eaves.options.1.label.def.context: Event swarm_in_eaves, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.swarm_in_eaves.options.2.desc.defa.context: Event swarm_in_eaves, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

event.swarm_in_eaves.options.2.label.def.context: Event swarm_in_eaves, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Give the first wax and honey to the {temple}.

event.swarm_in_eaves.options.3.desc.defa.context: Event swarm_in_eaves, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: Some gifts are more trouble than honey.

event.swarm_in_eaves.options.3.label.def.context: Event swarm_in_eaves, authored option 3, label, branch default.

event.swarm_in_eaves.text.default.context: Event swarm_in_eaves, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A cloud of bees settles beneath the eaves, heavy with promise and noise. Honey keeps; wax sells; stings swell.

event.swarm_in_eaves.title.default.context: Event swarm_in_eaves, title, faith branch default.

event.sworn_aid.options.0.desc.default.context: Event sworn_aid, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Oaths, it turns out, can be eaten.

event.sworn_aid.options.0.label.default.context: Event sworn_aid, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.sworn_aid.options.1.desc.default.context: Event sworn_aid, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Pride costs more than coin, and feeds less.

event.sworn_aid.options.1.label.default.context: Event sworn_aid, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.sworn_aid.text.default.context: Event sworn_aid, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Word of your hard times reaches {friend}. The oath you swore was not words only: they arrive with a purse and no speeches.

event.sworn_aid.title.default.context: Event sworn_aid, title, faith branch default.

event.tax_collector.options.0.desc.defau.context: Event tax_collector, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: The ledger closes, and the soldiers move on.

event.tax_collector.options.0.label.defa.context: Event tax_collector, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.tax_collector.options.1.desc.defau.context: Event tax_collector, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: One goat bleats twice as loud when coin is at stake.

event.tax_collector.options.1.failure.te.context: Event tax_collector, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Bleating betrays you. The fine stings worse than the tax.

event.tax_collector.options.1.label.defa.context: Event tax_collector, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.tax_collector.options.1.success.te.context: Event tax_collector, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: The ledger records one thin goat. The fat one chews safely in the wood.

event.tax_collector.options.2.desc.defau.context: Event tax_collector, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Empty hands may move him — or merely invite his.

event.tax_collector.options.2.failure.te.context: Event tax_collector, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: He takes your goods in lieu of coin.

event.tax_collector.options.2.label.defa.context: Event tax_collector, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.tax_collector.options.2.success.te.context: Event tax_collector, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: The collector sighs and moves on.

event.tax_collector.text.default.context: Event tax_collector, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The lord’s man arrives with his ledger and his soldiers, tallying hearths and hens alike.

event.tax_collector.title.default.context: Event tax_collector, title, faith branch default.

event.tend_sick.options.0.desc.default.context: Event tend_sick, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Their gratitude is likely; their fevers are catching.

event.tend_sick.options.0.failure.text.d.context: Event tend_sick, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

event.tend_sick.options.0.label.default.context: Event tend_sick, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.tend_sick.options.0.success.text.d.context: Event tend_sick, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

event.tend_sick.options.1.desc.default.context: Event tend_sick, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Pious, prudent, and a little hollow.

event.tend_sick.options.1.label.default.context: Event tend_sick, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Pray for them from a safe distance.

event.tend_sick.text.default.context: Event tend_sick, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Fever season fills the infirmary. The sick call for water, for prayers, for their mothers.

event.tend_sick.title.default.context: Event tend_sick, title, faith branch default.

event.testament_challenge.options.0.desc.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Memory under fire — one slip unravels all.

event.testament_challenge.options.0.fail.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: One phrase slips. The claimant drives a wedge into the uncertainty.

event.testament_challenge.options.0.labe.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.testament_challenge.options.0.succ.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: Question follows question; the wording never changes. The testament stands.

event.testament_challenge.options.1.desc.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Many tongues, one testament — if they hold.

event.testament_challenge.options.1.fail.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Under pressure, the witnesses remember different gifts.

event.testament_challenge.options.1.labe.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.testament_challenge.options.1.succ.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: Too many honest voices agree for the claimant to overcome them.

event.testament_challenge.options.2.desc.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Let the seals answer what grief cannot.

event.testament_challenge.options.2.fail.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: One seal is damaged. Suspicion swallows the rest of the evidence.

event.testament_challenge.options.2.labe.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Break the seal and read the inventory.

event.testament_challenge.options.2.succ.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: Nothing is missing and every mark is witnessed. The division proceeds.

event.testament_challenge.options.3.desc.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: Honest doubt costs little; false certainty costs more.

event.testament_challenge.options.3.labe.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 3, label, branch default.

source.text: Admit the proof is uncertain and refer it upward.

event.testament_challenge.options.4.desc.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 4, desc, branch default.

source.text: Pass the quarrel to a higher bench.

event.testament_challenge.options.4.labe.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 4, label, branch default.

source.text: Admit the witnesses are uncertain and refer it upward.

event.testament_challenge.options.5.desc.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 5, desc, branch default.

source.text: Let wiser heads weigh what yours could not.

event.testament_challenge.options.5.labe.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 5, label, branch default.

source.text: Admit the inventory is uncertain and refer it upward.

event.testament_challenge.options.6.desc.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 6, desc, branch default.

source.text: Keep the crooked bargain, and pray no one talks.

event.testament_challenge.options.6.fail.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 6, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Another witness names the bargain aloud. The court turns on you.

event.testament_challenge.options.6.labe.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 6, label, branch default.

event.testament_challenge.options.6.succ.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 6, success text, branch default.

source.text: Your chosen version becomes the court’s version. The claimant pays well.

event.testament_challenge.options.7.desc.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 7, desc, branch default.

source.text: Lose the coin, keep your soul.

event.testament_challenge.options.7.labe.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 7, label, branch default.

source.text: Repent and tell the court about the bribe.

event.testament_challenge.text.default.context: Event testament_challenge, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A kinsman rejects the last words and demands the goods. The local court wants something firmer than grief.

event.testament_challenge.title.default.context: Event testament_challenge, title, faith branch default.

event.title_request.options.0.desc.defau.context: Event title_request, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: The liege’s ear is open; his hand is another matter.

event.title_request.options.0.failure.te.context: Event title_request, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: “In time,” says the liege, meaning never. Courtiers hide their smiles.

event.title_request.options.0.label.defa.context: Event title_request, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.title_request.options.0.success.ef.context: Durable event log for title_request, authored option 0, success.effects.

source.text: Won new lands from the liege.

event.title_request.options.0.success.te.context: Event title_request, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: The liege nods slowly. “It is earned.” New lands are added to your charge — and a rich gift to the liege’s chest seals the investiture.

event.title_request.text.default.context: Event title_request, text, faith branch default.

source.text: You stand before your liege’s seat and ask, with every courtesy, for greater lands and title.

event.title_request.title.default.context: Event title_request, title, faith branch default.

event.tournament_invitation.options.0.de.context: Event tournament_invitation, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: The entry gift buys your place in the lists. The champion’s purse is {money:20}; the price of defeat is a hard fall.

event.tournament_invitation.options.0.fa.context: Event tournament_invitation, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: A lance like a siege-beam lifts you clean from the saddle. You wake staring at the clouds, ribs singing, while the stands cheer the other man.

event.tournament_invitation.options.0.la.context: Event tournament_invitation, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Ride in the joust. ({money:10} for harness and heralds)

event.tournament_invitation.options.0.su.context: Durable event log for tournament_invitation, authored option 0, success.effects.

source.text: Won the joust at a tourney.

event.tournament_invitation.options.0.su.context: Event tournament_invitation, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: Three courses, three splintered lances, and the herald cries your name. {lord} hangs the champion’s purse on your lance-tip with his own hands.

event.tournament_invitation.options.1.de.context: Event tournament_invitation, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Blunted steel in the press — a smaller prize, and softer falls.

event.tournament_invitation.options.1.fa.context: Event tournament_invitation, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: A mace you never saw ends your day early. The surgeon calls the bruises instructive.

event.tournament_invitation.options.1.la.context: Event tournament_invitation, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.tournament_invitation.options.1.su.context: Event tournament_invitation, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: You keep your feet while better-known men lose theirs. The melee’s captains will remember your name.

event.tournament_invitation.options.2.de.context: Event tournament_invitation, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Coin says another man bleeds for you.

event.tournament_invitation.options.2.fa.context: Event tournament_invitation, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Your man eats mud in the first pass. The stands find it hilarious.

event.tournament_invitation.options.2.la.context: Event tournament_invitation, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.tournament_invitation.options.2.su.context: Event tournament_invitation, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: Your man carries the field, and your purse comes home heavier.

event.tournament_invitation.options.3.de.context: Event tournament_invitation, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: A gift in place of a wager — here, generosity is its own bet.

event.tournament_invitation.options.3.la.context: Event tournament_invitation, authored option 3, label, branch default.

source.text: Make a gift to the host’s stable. ({money:5})

event.tournament_invitation.options.4.de.context: Event tournament_invitation, authored option 4, desc, branch default.

source.text: No lance, no risk — good company and better talk.

event.tournament_invitation.options.4.la.context: Event tournament_invitation, authored option 4, label, branch default.

source.text: Watch from the stands as {lord}’s guest.

event.tournament_invitation.options.5.de.context: Event tournament_invitation, authored option 5, desc, branch default.

source.text: A quiet day at home, and a faintly cooler hall.

event.tournament_invitation.options.5.la.context: Event tournament_invitation, authored option 5, label, branch default.

event.tournament_invitation.text.default.context: Event tournament_invitation, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Word rides ahead of the heralds: {lord} proclaims a tourney for the dry roads — bright harness, blunted lances, a melee for the young swords, and a champion’s purse. Every ambitious blade in the province means to be there. Will you ride in the lists?

event.tournament_invitation.text.muslim.context: Event tournament_invitation, text, faith branch muslim.

source.text: Word rides ahead of the heralds: {lord} proclaims a furusiyya contest for the dry roads — fine horses, lance and sword from the saddle, and rich prizes for the finest rider. Every bold young blade in the province means to show his horsemanship. Will you ride?

event.tournament_invitation.text.pagan.context: Event tournament_invitation, text, faith branch pagan.

source.text: Word rides ahead of the heralds: {lord} proclaims great games for the dry roads — horse-combats, blunted spears, and an honor-price for the boldest rider. Every young spear in the province means to make a name. Will you ride?

event.tournament_invitation.title.defaul.context: Event tournament_invitation, title, faith branch default.

event.tournament_invitation_lord.options.context: Event tournament_invitation_lord, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Your entry gift and fees stake {money:25} against the {money:40} purse — and against a very public fall.

event.tournament_invitation_lord.options.context: Event tournament_invitation_lord, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The crowd’s roar turns to a gasp as you go over the crupper, helm ringing. They carry you from the lists with honor — and with a headache for the ages.

event.tournament_invitation_lord.options.context: Event tournament_invitation_lord, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Enter the joust. ({money:25} in harness and herald’s fees)

event.tournament_invitation_lord.options.context: Durable event log for tournament_invitation_lord, authored option 0, success.effects.

source.text: Carried the lists at a great tourney.

event.tournament_invitation_lord.options.context: Event tournament_invitation_lord, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: Course after course your lance strikes true, and the field yields to you. {lord} names you champion before the assembled houses, and even the beaten men cheer.

event.tournament_invitation_lord.options.context: Event tournament_invitation_lord, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Lead your sworn swords into the press — glory shared is glory still.

event.tournament_invitation_lord.options.context: Event tournament_invitation_lord, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The press swallows your banner in the first charge. You are ransomed back your own dented helm with as much grace as you can muster.

event.tournament_invitation_lord.options.context: Event tournament_invitation_lord, authored option 1, label, branch default.
Event tournament_invitation_lord, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: Your knot of riders holds the center of the field until the horns call it done. The captains salute you as one of their own.

event.tournament_invitation_lord.options.context: Event tournament_invitation_lord, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: A lord’s wager, loudly made — the stands will remember either way.

event.tournament_invitation_lord.options.context: Event tournament_invitation_lord, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Your champion folds in the second course. You pay out while the stands pretend not to watch.

event.tournament_invitation_lord.options.context: Event tournament_invitation_lord, authored option 2, label, branch default.
Event tournament_invitation_lord, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: Your eye for horseflesh proves sound. The losers pay up with pinched smiles.

event.tournament_invitation_lord.options.context: Event tournament_invitation_lord, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: Stake a young blade’s harness and entry — patronage outlasts any wager.

event.tournament_invitation_lord.options.context: Event tournament_invitation_lord, authored option 3, label, branch default.
Event tournament_invitation_lord, authored option 4, desc, branch default.

source.text: Be seen, be gracious, and let younger backs take the blows.

event.tournament_invitation_lord.options.context: Event tournament_invitation_lord, authored option 4, label, branch default.

source.text: Grace the stands and the feast.

event.tournament_invitation_lord.options.context: Event tournament_invitation_lord, authored option 5, desc, branch default.

source.text: Duty keeps you home; the hall will understand.

event.tournament_invitation_lord.options.context: Event tournament_invitation_lord, authored option 5, label, branch default.

event.tournament_invitation_lord.text.de.context: Event tournament_invitation_lord, text, faith branch default.

source.text: {lord} proclaims a great tourney and begs the honor of your presence: two days of lances when the spring roads dry, a melee for the young swords, and a champion’s purse of {money:40}. Landless knights and lords’ heirs will ride from three provinces away. Will you enter the lists?

event.tournament_invitation_lord.text.mu.context: Event tournament_invitation_lord, text, faith branch muslim.

source.text: {lord} proclaims a great furusiyya contest and begs the honor of your presence: two days of mounted lance and sword when the spring roads dry, and a champion’s prize of {money:40}. Riders of name will come from three provinces away. Will you enter the maydan?

event.tournament_invitation_lord.text.pa.context: Event tournament_invitation_lord, text, faith branch pagan.

source.text: {lord} proclaims great games and begs the honor of your presence: two days of horse-combat when the spring roads dry, a spear-press for the young warriors, and an honor-price of {money:40}. Famous riders will come from three provinces away. Will you ride?

event.tournament_invitation_lord.title.d.context: Event tournament_invitation_lord, title, faith branch default.

event.town_elder.options.0.desc.default.context: Event town_elder, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A seat on the bench, if the town will have you.

event.town_elder.options.0.failure.text..context: Event town_elder, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: An older name edges you out. Next time.

event.town_elder.options.0.label.default.context: Event town_elder, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.town_elder.options.0.success.effec.context: Durable event log for town_elder, authored option 0, success.effects.

event.town_elder.options.0.success.text..context: Event town_elder, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: They raise you to the council bench. Small power, but power.

event.town_elder.options.1.desc.default.context: Event town_elder, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

event.town_elder.options.1.label.default.context: Event town_elder, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.town_elder.text.default.context: Event town_elder, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The townsfolk mutter that the council needs a man of sense — your name comes up more than once.

event.town_elder.title.default.context: Event town_elder, title, faith branch default.

event.travel_arrival_choice.options.0.de.context: Event travel_arrival_choice, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Time will pass normally, with local work stories while you remain.

event.travel_arrival_choice.options.0.ef.context: Durable event log for travel_arrival_choice, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Began a season of work in {destination}.

event.travel_arrival_choice.options.0.la.context: Event travel_arrival_choice, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.travel_arrival_choice.text.default.context: Event travel_arrival_choice, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Your purpose in {destination} is complete, but a traveler cannot know a place in a day. You will stay and find local work for at least three months before choosing the road home.

event.travel_arrival_choice.title.defaul.context: Event travel_arrival_choice, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A Season in a New Place

event.travel_arrival_choice_frontier.opt.context: Event travel_arrival_choice_frontier, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Time passes normally; frontier survival and work stories while you remain.

event.travel_arrival_choice_frontier.opt.context: Durable event log for travel_arrival_choice_frontier, authored option 0, effects.
Event travel_arrival_choice_frontier, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.travel_arrival_choice_frontier.tex.context: Event travel_arrival_choice_frontier, text, faith branch default.

source.text: There is no lodging to find in {destination}, no lane to be known in — only what your hands raise. A year of living from this land, and enough real work to prove it, could make the homestead permanent. Or the road home waits, once the season’s turn allows it.

event.travel_arrival_choice_frontier.tit.context: Event travel_arrival_choice_frontier, title, faith branch default.

event.travel_arrival_choice_relationship.context: Event travel_arrival_choice_relationship, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Time passes normally, and personal attention advances while you remain together.

event.travel_arrival_choice_relationship.context: Durable event log for travel_arrival_choice_relationship, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Began an extended visit with {visitname} in {destination}.

event.travel_arrival_choice_relationship.context: Event travel_arrival_choice_relationship, authored option 0, label, branch default.
Event travel_arrival_choice_relationship, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A meaningful visit cannot be hurried. You will remain near {visitname} for at least three months, sharing the ordinary days in which Standing is won.

event.travel_arrival_choice_relationship.context: Event travel_arrival_choice_relationship, title, faith branch default.

event.travel_arrival_choice_ruler.option.context: Event travel_arrival_choice_ruler, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Time passes normally, with court and household stories while you remain.

event.travel_arrival_choice_ruler.option.context: Durable event log for travel_arrival_choice_ruler, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Began a season in residence at {destination}.

event.tut_welcome.options.1.desc.default.context: Event tut_welcome, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

event.visit_city.options.0.desc.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

event.visit_city.options.0.failure.text..context: Event visit_city, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

event.visit_city.options.0.label.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.visit_city.options.0.success.text..context: Event visit_city, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: The great market swallows all you brought and asks for more.

event.visit_city.options.1.desc.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: The city keeps wisdom for those who ask.

event.visit_city.options.1.label.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.visit_city.options.2.desc.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: A name in the right ledger opens doors.

event.visit_city.options.2.failure.text..context: Event visit_city, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Stewards and secretaries, all day. The great remain unseen.

event.visit_city.options.2.label.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.visit_city.options.2.success.text..context: Event visit_city, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: A door opens; a name is taken down. Doors remember.

event.visit_city.options.3.desc.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: Good pay, if harder men don’t want it too.

event.visit_city.options.3.failure.text..context: Event visit_city, authored option 3, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The work went to harder men — after one of them rearranged your face.

event.visit_city.options.3.label.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 3, label, branch default.

event.visit_city.options.3.success.text..context: Event visit_city, authored option 3, success text, branch default.

source.text: Three nights guarding a nervous silk merchant. The pay is very good.

event.visit_city.options.4.desc.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 4, desc, branch default.

source.text: Stone raised to heaven lifts the heart with it.

event.visit_city.options.4.label.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 4, label, branch default.

event.visit_city.options.5.desc.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 5, desc, branch default.

source.text: A city market always has serviceable gear for sale.

event.visit_city.options.5.label.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 5, label, branch default.

event.visit_city.options.6.desc.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 6, desc, branch default.

event.visit_city.options.6.label.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 6, label, branch default.

event.visit_city.options.7.desc.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 7, desc, branch default.

source.text: Wine, music, and thinner pockets by morning.

event.visit_city.options.7.label.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 7, label, branch default.

event.visit_city.options.8.desc.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 8, desc, branch default.

event.visit_city.options.9.desc.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 9, desc, branch default.

event.visit_city.text.default.context: Event visit_city, text, faith branch default.

event.visit_town.options.0.desc.default.context: Event visit_town, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

event.visit_town.options.0.failure.text..context: Event visit_town, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

event.visit_town.options.0.success.text..context: Event visit_town, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

event.visit_town.options.1.failure.text..context: Event visit_town, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

event.visit_town.options.1.success.text..context: Event visit_town, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

event.visit_town.options.2.desc.default.context: Event visit_town, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

event.visit_town.options.2.label.default.context: Event visit_town, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.visit_town.options.3.desc.default.context: Event visit_town, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

event.visit_town.options.3.failure.text..context: Event visit_town, authored option 3, failure text, branch default.

event.visit_town.options.3.label.default.context: Event visit_town, authored option 3, label, branch default.

event.visit_town.options.3.success.text..context: Event visit_town, authored option 3, success text, branch default.

source.text: A merchant train needs spears for the road. Easy duty, fair pay.

event.visit_town.options.4.desc.default.context: Event visit_town, authored option 4, desc, branch default.

source.text: An hour of good words costs nothing.

event.visit_town.options.4.label.default.context: Event visit_town, authored option 4, label, branch default.

event.visit_town.options.5.desc.default.context: Event visit_town, authored option 5, desc, branch default.

source.text: Useful names are learned over wine.

event.visit_town.options.5.label.default.context: Event visit_town, authored option 5, label, branch default.

event.visit_town.options.6.desc.default.context: Event visit_town, authored option 6, desc, branch default.

source.text: A town market keeps ordinary gear within reach.

event.visit_town.options.6.label.default.context: Event visit_town, authored option 6, label, branch default.

event.visit_town.options.7.desc.default.context: Event visit_town, authored option 7, desc, branch default.

source.text: The stallkeepers spread their season’s stock — buy gear, or sell what the armory no longer needs.

event.visit_town.options.7.label.default.context: Event visit_town, authored option 7, label, branch default.

event.visit_town.options.8.desc.default.context: Event visit_town, authored option 8, desc, branch default.

event.visit_town.text.default.context: Event visit_town, text, faith branch default.

event.visit_village.options.5.desc.defau.context: Event visit_village, authored option 5, desc, branch default.

event.visit_village.options.6.desc.defau.context: Event visit_village, authored option 6, desc, branch default.

policy.religious_tolerance.desc.default.context: policy religious_tolerance, desc, faith branch default.

source.text: The crown’s standing law for subjects who keep another faith. No proclamation rewrites a county’s faith; the law decides only how the realm treats the difference.

policy.religious_tolerance.levels.0.desc.context: policy religious_tolerance, level 1, desc, faith branch default.

source.text: The minority faith is harried: gatherings dispersed, houses of prayer closed, informers paid. The clergy approve and the treasury takes its fines; the persecuted nurse a grievance that outlives the reign.

policy.religious_tolerance.levels.0.name.context: policy religious_tolerance, level 1, name, faith branch default.

policy.religious_tolerance.levels.1.desc.context: policy religious_tolerance, level 2, desc, faith branch default.

source.text: The customary peace: the realm’s faith holds first place in law and custom, and other faiths keep their parishes without the crown’s protection or its particular attention.

policy.religious_tolerance.levels.1.name.context: policy religious_tolerance, level 2, name, faith branch default.

policy.religious_tolerance.levels.2.desc.context: policy religious_tolerance, level 3, desc, faith branch default.

source.text: Other faiths worship openly under the king’s peace. Their markets and workshops prosper; the stricter clergy grumble.

policy.religious_tolerance.levels.2.name.context: policy religious_tolerance, level 3, name, faith branch default.

policy.religious_tolerance.levels.3.desc.context: policy religious_tolerance, level 4, desc, faith branch default.

source.text: Minority congregations receive the crown’s written protection: worship, persons, and market rights guaranteed by charter. Withdrawing the charter before its protected term is an unlawful revocation.

policy.religious_tolerance.levels.3.name.context: policy religious_tolerance, level 4, name, faith branch default.

policy.religious_tolerance.name.default.context: policy religious_tolerance, name, faith branch default.

policy.revocation_consent.desc.default.context: policy revocation_consent, desc, faith branch default.

policy.revocation_consent.name.default.context: policy revocation_consent, name, faith branch default.

policy.scutage.desc.default.context: policy scutage, desc, faith branch default.

policy.settlement_policy.desc.default.context: policy settlement_policy, desc, faith branch default.

source.text: The crown’s standing law for newcomers: who may cross the boundary stones to settle, work, and trade in your counties.

policy.settlement_policy.levels.0.desc.d.context: policy settlement_policy, level 1, desc, faith branch default.

source.text: Strangers are turned back at the boundary stones. The villages approve of work and land kept for their own sons; the markets thin and the roads empty.

policy.settlement_policy.levels.0.name.d.context: policy settlement_policy, level 1, name, faith branch default.

policy.settlement_policy.levels.1.desc.d.context: policy settlement_policy, level 2, desc, faith branch default.

source.text: The customary rule: a newcomer with a lord’s license, a craft, or a merchant’s surety may settle; the shiftless are moved along. Neither gate nor bounty.

policy.settlement_policy.levels.1.name.d.context: policy settlement_policy, level 2, name, faith branch default.

policy.settlement_policy.levels.2.desc.d.context: policy settlement_policy, level 3, desc, faith branch default.

source.text: The crown pays to plant newcomers on waste and street: posted protections, seed grain, and remitted dues draw settlers, specialists, and refugees — at a standing seasonal cost in every county you hold.

policy.settlement_policy.levels.2.name.d.context: policy settlement_policy, level 3, name, faith branch default.

policy.settlement_policy.name.default.context: policy settlement_policy, name, faith branch default.

A Cardinal belongs to the Papal college and can shape or contest an election.
A baron must first hold a county before waging a foreign war.
A bishop governs a non-hereditary church see beside the playable dynasty.
A captive cannot enter or arrange a marriage.
A captive cannot receive a relationship visit.
A captive cannot seek a new guild office.
A career record keeps rank and experience even while inactive.
A claimant cannot issue a sentence against himself.
A county and its settlements now anchor your territorial house.

A couple sharing a faith with the xwēdōdah doctrine may use its recognized rite for 75 piety and {money:25}. Otherwise an illicit courtship risks exposure each season, and an irregular wedding costs 75 piety and 25 prestige, lowers Common Voice and liege Standing, and gives both spouses Scandalous Union.

A declaration must still be won on the map. March the host to the named prize and hold it — the works advance each season the host stands there. An unfortified county needs three siege steps; a fort adds one to four, pins onward movement, requires enough uncontested besiegers, and inflicts seasonal attrition. Field victories can produce peace offers but do not transfer the target by themselves.
A defensive alliance may be offered only to an adjacent sovereign.
A defensive alliance requires another sovereign king or emperor.
A focus repeats each day until changed. A deed is a one-shot act and normally spends the day. Events pause time until you choose.
A gift courier is already traveling for this recipient.
A gift courier is already traveling for this ruler.

A head aged {age} or older may instead retire through the Hand over the house deed: an adult successor takes over without death dues, and the retired elder remains visible family at home, no longer under your control.
A host on the march must halt before it divides.
A house name can be at most twenty letters long.
A house name needs at least two letters.
A journey has outbound, stay, and return phases. The Deeds commitment row shows its current state, and some purposes add decisions while away.
A landed ruler keeps the calling as biography and cannot seek a local guild office.
A learned religious vocation advances through study, service, and the rules of the current faith.
A living lawful heir is required to continue the story.
A modest 10% lading fee covers pack supplies and handling. The cargo will be sold in {home} upon your return.
A motion is already being campaigned before the Estates.
A named heir moves an already eligible candidate to the front. It cannot make a spouse, dead relative, different-house relative, or blocked branch eligible.
A pact envoy costs {money:10}. Kings and emperors may offer a {money:25} alliance at Standing 60+.
A peace envoy must address a living sovereign court.
A peace pact with this realm is already active.
A permanent home can be considered after {days} more days here.
A permanent home is not yet possible here.
A petition requires 60 guild standing; currently {standing}.
A plot uses your daily focus until it resolves. Its target, method, chance, cost, duration, and exposure are shown before you commit.
A preferred domain is chosen first; if none is eligible, automation uses the cheapest eligible technology from another domain.
A prisoner cannot hand over the house.
A prisoner cannot organize a trade venture.
A prisoner cannot organize return cargo.
A public religious vocation combines worship, teaching, law, and care of souls.
A rare player-only route uses traits, one irreversible approach, and severe social or religious costs.
A renewal petition has already been made for this term.
A required national technology has not been completed.
A sacred office forbids this marriage.
A separate condemnation confirmation appears before war can begin.
A serf household cannot yet maintain paid servants.
A session or motion is pending
A sibling must first accept the exceptional approach.
A sworn peace pact protects the Caliph’s realm.
A sworn peace pact protects this realm.
A town or city market is required.
A traveler cannot organize another venture.
A vassal holds the land in your name, pays taxes each season, sends part of its levy to your host, and remembers the grant in their Standing. Your dignity still counts land held through vassals.
Abandon the journey and retrace the road. Nothing is refunded.
Abdicate and continue as the heir
Accept the consequences and declare war
Accepting attaches this foreign grant to your existing sovereign realm.
Accepting founds a new playable landed realm for your household.
Accepting makes you sovereign of the new kingdom and unites it with your existing lands.
Accepting returns your old demesne and title to its liege, then relocates your playable household to the new grant.
Active charters cannot be renewed, revoked, or replaced before they end. Matching incoming and outgoing enterprise bonuses add together, capped at +50%.
Adds or refreshes {modifier} in {province} {duration}: {effects}; {upkeep}. It stays with the county after transfer.
Adds or refreshes {modifier} {duration}: {effects}; {upkeep}. It applies only to this great holy war.
Adds {percent}% levy for one year and lowers Standing by 15. (spends the day)
Adds {percent}% of this vassal’s levy for one year, lowers Standing by 15, and spends the day.

Administration, Medicine, and Scholarship teach letters during their trainee stage. Licensed practice and permanent specializations require Lettered, Learning, vocational years, technology, fees, and a professional examination whose chance rises with skill.
Advance an eligible household worker through the guild, then assign that worker here.
After a year of local life, permanent settlement may become available. Each character can relocate the household only once in their lifetime.
After arrival you must stay at least {days} days, but you may remain longer. Outbound and return travel do not advance Standing.
All political attention is assigned. Set another court to Neutral before choosing a new direction here.
All {capacity} political-attention assignments are in use. Set another court to Neutral first.

An accepted suit uses ordinary personal attention and needs +80 Standing before proposal. A rejected proposal is permanent; breaking off an accepted suit prevents renewal for five years. No sibling match ever creates a dowry, royal compact, or alliance.
An accomplice is optional. Acceptance is rolled only after confirmation; a refusal may leak the scheme.
An active mod has an invalid currency definition. The default currency is being used.
An alliance envoy requires {money:25} in gifts.
An alliance envoy requires {money:cost}; you have {money:current}.
An appointed Castellan holds no county from which to wage a foreign war.
An emergency subsidy can only be moved while the liege is at war.
An envoy requires {money:cost} in gifts; you have {money:current}.
An envoy without {money:10} in gifts insults his host.
An established personal relationship grants direct access.
An existing introduction grants access; class distance leaves influence at {percent}% of its usual strength.
An independent landed ruler has no superior to petition.
An item or market offer changes
Another election campaign is already active.
Another sentence may be issued in {days} days.
Any direction chosen here remains assigned but is suspended until the war ends.
Applies to directly held counties outside the realm’s faith — {count} now. A county’s faith itself never changes.
Applies to every county you hold directly.
Appoint officers, replace holders, dismiss councillors, and offer gifts.
Appointments, replacements, gifts, and dismissals keep their existing Standing and crown-authority effects.

Arrival begins a year of survival and work, not an immediate move. With {days} days of residence and {count} proven frontier works, the homestead can become a permanent development-1 county under the lord of {gateway} — a commoner home with a starter land plot, never a title.
Ask for another ten years. Current chance: {chance}%.
Ask for greater lands and higher style.
Ask for greater lands. Only the crown can raise you to duke.
Ask local kin and gossips about an additional spouse. {current} of {limit} spouse places are filled.
Ask local kin and gossips to find a spouse among the county’s communities.
Ask local kin and gossips to find another prospective spouse among the county’s communities.
Ask the Pope to lift your excommunication. Costs {money:gold} and {piety} piety; Standing with Catholic rulers recovers by {standing}.
Ask the liege to strip a disgraced neighbor and invest you with his county. Service in the liege’s wars: {service}.
Ask {grantor} for a {years}-year monopoly: +{enterprise}% matching enterprise profit. Pay {money:25} or rely on Diplomacy.
Ask {lord} for lands and a banner.
Assault settlements and shrines for high plunder and captives; risks defender resistance.
Assign or train an eligible household member in this occupation, then return to choose that worker.
Assign personal attention for +{rate} Standing each ordinary day. This costs no day.
At +{rate} Standing per day together, reaching +{threshold} is estimated to take {activeDays} days in one another’s company—about {totalDays} days from departure.
At least {days} days away. Personal work pauses; at the market you choose a guaranteed cautious return or a bold bargain (currently {chance}% success).
At least {minimum} men must answer before a field host can form; only {men} are available. Hire mercenaries before mustering again.
At the current daily rate, Standing is not advancing toward +{threshold}.
At the destination you must remain in guest residence for at least {days} days before returning home.
At the destination you must stay and find local work for at least {days} days before returning home.
At war with {realm} — policy is suspended
Attach the vacant Sunni office to your realm. Requires {prestige} prestige and a demesne of {counties} counties, and spends {piety} piety.
Attend a bounded market auction for one rare lot. Three bids decide the sale; losing spends no coin.
Balance direct land, vassals, liege demands, and succession.

Barons and higher rulers compare available conquests through Declare war. A bordering de jure right, a fabricated claim, or a crown-restoration right is recognized; pacts and defensive alliances can still block the declaration.
Begin a courtship before making a proposal.
Begins a visible confirmation election. Appointment and its protected fixed term occur only if the nominee wins.
Belongs to the county and follows it through conquest
Best current progress toward a {kind}: {name}, {have} of {total}; {need} required.
Bind your friend to your house by oath — for life.
Bind {name} to your house by oath — for life.
Blood lines run downward — each brood hangs beneath its parents. † marks the dead. Click a face to open their sheet; hover it for details. Drag the open background to move around.
Blood lines run downward — each brood hangs beneath its parents. † marks the dead. Tap a face to open their sheet.
Both siblings must be at least sixteen.
Bound to the direct liege relationship with {grantor}
Bread and coin for the poor at the {temple} gate. ({money:10})
Break the unfinished vow for {piety} piety and {prestige} prestige.
Bring your piety to the {temple} and ask for grace.
Build a complete proposal that skips reserved counties and keeps your capital and home county.
Build goodwill at this court every season.
Build more of a life here through local work before settling permanently.
Build piety and relationships with religious authorities.
Buildings that grant development identify the immediate amount when raised. National technologies can raise every county’s development ceiling in that nation above its base of 10.
Buy your freedom, then your first land plot
Campaign condition, leadership, and refits tilt every field battle; live troop totals change only when a loss names the host.
Cancel the march and stand fast; the automated stances leave a held host alone.
Canceling here changes nothing. After peace, an active Pope may grant costly absolution.
Captivity blocks travel, marriage, new offices, and plots. Ransom, mercy, and leverage actions always show their terms before they act.
Careful packing and cautious transport. Delivers return cargo reliably at 1.20× margin.
Cash and item gifts share this recipient’s cooldown. Ready in {days} days.
Cash costs {money:cost} for +{standing} Standing; eligible armory items show their access-adjusted value. The recipient cooldown is {days} days and accepting a gift spends the day.

Catalogue search includes technology names, descriptions, effects, prerequisite labels, and every authored unlock. Details distinguish prerequisites that require all listed technologies from those that accept any one.
Cautious returns 1.2×; bold returns 2.5× on success or 0.3× on failure.
